title: Mechanical Supervisor
description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The TE systems are part of the scope of the Marine team as temporary measures to facilitate the immersion of the elements. In total, 79 standard (220m long, 9m high, 45m wide) and 10 special elements (38m long, 12,5m high, 50m wide) will connect the Femern Belt Tunnel to both Germany and Denmark.

To be able to float up, transport and immerse the Tunnel Elements, the elements require temporary installations. These installations ensure that the elements float, stay balanced, immerse and can connect to the preceding element. A team of mechanics and electricians will install and test these installations.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Execute the TE systems works whilst coordinating closely and effectively with the involved (internal) stakeholders to optimize efficiency.

Plan, execute and register maintenance & repairs to the TE systems equipment:

o Pumps / Piping / Valves

o Electrical components

o Subsea sensors

o Hydraulic cylinders / Powerpacks / manifolds

o Umbilical winches / Sliprings

o Rolling equipment

Thereby ensuring operational equipment in compliance with legislative-, safety- and user requirements.

You will lead the team of technicians installing, maintaining and repairing the Tunnel Elements systems during the preparation, transport and installation phase of Tunnel Elements. Understand the functionality of the Tunnel Element systems. Troubleshoot system during installation and operation. Maintain and organize the work area (workshop and yard facilities) to ensure an orderly and safe workplace in compliance with Danish regulation, company procedures, and good work practice. Set up, select and support the TE systems team of technicians to ensure effective and reliable production cycle.

In the role of the Mechanical Supervisor, there will be interface with subcontractors, Operational departments of various disciplines and operations staff.

Qualifications:

The TE systems Mechanical Supervisor:

- Has the ability to read and understand technical drawings, working methods and working procedures.

- Plans the work ahead.

- Manages daily interface with other TE outfitting parties.

- Communicates in English (minimum B2 level) both written and spoken.

- Optimizes the usage of the TE systems team capabilities.

- Supports and coaches the TE systems technicians.

- Has excellent interpersonal skills

- Organizes daily toolbox / pre-start meetings.

- Connects the tasks to the bigger picture.

- Provides support and input on risk assessments for TE mobilization / demobilization, general tasks.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company. 

FLC offers attractive employment conditions on a Danish contract according to The Danish Salaried Employees Act (Funktionærloven). Pension health insurance and lunch arrangement will be available. 

Workplace:

Rødbyhavn Denmark

Application:

We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.

Contact:

For questions related to the position, please contact tri@flc-jv.com, lge@flc-jv.com

title: Positioning Specialist - Immersion Pontoon
description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challengeand the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The FLC Survey Department plays a key role in supporting the construction of this immersed tunnel project. The marine survey team delivers positioning, navigation, monitoring, and hydrographic survey services for offshore construction activities using advanced technologies such as multibeam echo sounders, Inertial Navigation systems, LBL and USBL systems, Fibre Optic Gyroscopes and many more. Together with over 60 hydrographic and topographic survey professionals from more than 15 countries, the department ensures accurate survey data for all project phases. The topographic survey teams support construction through stake-out, control, and as-built surveys, utilizing state-of-the-art equipment including Total Stations, GNSS, drones, laser scanners, and specialist software for planning, execution, and data processing.

Within the marine survey team, the Positioning Specialists play a key role in the immersion of tunnel elements. They install, configure and operate advanced positioning systems, combining GNSS, INS, LBL, tautwire, and distance sensor technologies to ensure the precise placement of tunnel elements.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Prepare positioning systems for (re-)installation operations by performing maintenance, calibration, and configuration of the hard- and software.

Configure positioning software in preparation for positioning operations, such as Qinsy, Delph SP and Delph INS and project specific software.

Operate and monitor the positioning systems during tunnel element installation operations, such as GNSS (Septentrio), INS (Exail), LBL (Exail), SVP (AML) and a project specific Light Tautwire and Distance Sensor system.

Remote or on-board troubleshooting of positioning system issues.

Analyse positioning data of tunnel installation process.

Write installation-, configuration- and commissioning reports for positioning systems.

Create reports for ‘as-installed’ and ‘as-configured’ survey set-ups.

Create ‘as-installed’ reports for installed tunnel elements

Cooperate with the operational team to schedule installation and removal of survey systems.

Cooperate with pontoon and vessel crews during remote- or on-board troubleshooting.

Concise communication with the immersion master during installation of the tunnel elements.

Qualifications:

Degree, diploma, or equivalent professional experience in Hydrographic Surveying, Geomatics or Geodesy, Survey Engineering, Offshore Engineering, Marine Technology, Navigation, Positioning, or a related technical discipline

Minimum 5 years of experience with surface and/or subsea positioning systems.

Proven experience configuring, maintaining, and operating marine positioning systems during offshore operations.

Experience with working with Qinsy survey software.

Experience with USBL and/or LBL positioning systems.

Ability to configure, calibrate, and troubleshoot complex positioning systems.

Strong capability in quality control, analysis, and interpretation of positioning data.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Able to remain calm and make sound decisions during critical offshore operations.

Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly when coordinating with immersion masters, vessel crews, engineers, and survey teams.

Conditions:

title: Experienced Thai Cook for BanThai Restaurant
description:
Experienced Thai Cook for BanThai Restaurant

About the position

BanThai Restaurant & TakeAway ApS in Ringsted is looking for an experienced and motivated cook with solid knowledge of authentic Thai and Asian cuisine.

You will become part of our kitchen team and work closely with the kitchen management and other employees to ensure efficient daily operations, consistent quality and a high standard of food preparation.

The position is full-time and includes both preparation and cooking duties. We are looking for a reliable and professional employee who can work independently, cooperate with colleagues and contribute positively to the development of our kitchen.

Main responsibilities

Your duties will include, among other things:

  • Preparing ingredients for daily kitchen operations, including washing, cutting, portioning and correct storage.

  • Preparing and cooking authentic Thai and Asian dishes according to the restaurant’s recipes and quality standards.

  • Ensuring consistent taste, quality, portion sizes and presentation.

  • Maintaining a clean, organised and efficient kitchen station.

  • Assisting with daily preparation and service in both smaller and larger kitchen operations.

  • Following instructions from kitchen management regarding production, preparation and daily priorities.

  • Monitoring stock levels and informing management when ingredients need to be ordered.

  • Receiving, checking and correctly storing food deliveries.

  • Ensuring proper labelling, date marking, storage and rotation of ingredients.

  • Following all hygiene, HACCP, food safety and workplace safety procedures.

  • Cleaning kitchen equipment, utensils and work areas.

  • Cooperating with the kitchen team to ensure efficient and smooth service.

  • Assisting with other naturally occurring kitchen duties when required.

The list of duties is not exhaustive, and tasks may vary depending on the restaurant’s operational needs. Opgaverne er baseret på arbejdsbeskrivelsen i den tidligere kontrakt.

Qualifications

We expect that you:

  • Have documented professional experience as a cook.

  • Have strong experience with Thai cuisine and other Asian cooking traditions.

  • Understand traditional Thai ingredients, preparation methods, flavours and presentation.

  • Have experience working in a professional restaurant kitchen.

  • Can work independently and as part of a team.

  • Can maintain quality and overview during busy service periods.

  • Have good knowledge of food hygiene and safe food handling.

  • Are reliable, flexible and responsible.

  • Are willing to work mornings, evenings, weekends and public holidays when scheduled.

  • Can communicate in Thai and English.

  • Danish language skills are an advantage but not a requirement.

Relevant culinary education, certificates and documented work experience will be considered an advantage.

Employment conditions

BanThai is a Thai restaurant and takeaway in Ringsted focusing on authentic Thai food, traditional preparation methods and dishes inspired by different regions of Thailand.

title: Rengøringsleder til Renseri
description:
Vi søger en engageret og struktureret Rengøringsleder til vores renseri hos Renserierne.DK ApS, ,Vester Farimagsgade 3 , 1606 København V

Som Rengøringsleder får du en central rolle i den daglige drift, hvor du sikrer, at arbejdsopgaver planlægges, koordineres og udføres effektivt. Du bliver bindeled mellem virksomhedens ejer og medarbejderne og bidrager til en høj kvalitet i både driften og kundeservicen.

Stillingen er en driftskoordinerende funktion uden personale- eller HR-ansvar. Du har ikke ansvar for ansættelser eller afskedigelser, men du har ansvar for at sikre en effektiv daglig drift, høj service og et godt samarbejde mellem medarbejderne.

Ansættelsen forudsætter, at du til enhver tid har gyldig arbejdstilladelse, hvis dette kræves.

Arbejdsopgaver

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Overvåge og koordinere virksomhedens daglige driftsaktiviteter for at sikre en smidig og effektiv arbejdsgang.

  • Koordinere medarbejdernes arbejdsplaner og sikre tilstrækkelig bemanding i forhold til den daglige drift og kundernes behov.

  • Vejlede og støtte medarbejderne i det daglige arbejde for at sikre høj kvalitet og effektiv kundeservice.

  • Modtage og betjene kunder, besvare henvendelser samt modtage servicebestillinger.

  • Håndtere kundefeedback og klager professionelt og sikre hurtig opfølgning.

  • Sikre en effektiv kommunikation mellem medarbejderne og virksomhedens ejer om den daglige drift.

  • Overvåge virksomhedens kundeservice og den samlede driftseffektivitet.

  • Følge kundetilfredsheden og komme med forslag til forbedringer af kundeoplevelsen.

  • Identificere daglige driftsmæssige udfordringer og foreslå praktiske løsninger, der styrker den operationelle effektivitet.

  • Bidrage med idéer til salgsfremmende aktiviteter og forretningsudvikling med henblik på at tiltrække nye kunder og understøtte virksomhedens vækst.

  • Sikre, at de daglige arbejdsopgaver udføres rettidigt og bidrage til et organiseret, sikkert og effektivt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Repræsentere virksomheden professionelt i kontakten med kunder.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har erfaring fra renseri, vaskeri, rengøringsbranchen eller en anden servicevirksomhed.

  • Er struktureret og god til at koordinere den daglige drift.

  • Har stærke samarbejds- og kommunikationsevner.

  • Er serviceminded og sætter en ære i at levere en høj kundeservice.

  • Er løsningsorienteret og arbejder selvstændigt.

  • Kan bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag og sikre, at opgaver bliver løst effektivt.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og alsidig stilling med ansvar for den daglige drift.

  • Mulighed for at bidrage til udviklingen af virksomhedens arbejdsgange og kundeoplevelse.

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med korte beslutningsveje.

  • Et tæt samarbejde med virksomhedens ejer.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til vores kontaktperson, da vi akut har brug for en medarbejder i teamet.

We are looking for a dedicated and well-organised Cleaning Supervisor to join our dry-cleaning business at Renserierne.DK ApS, ,Vester Farimagsgade 3 , 1606 København V.

As a Cleaning Supervisor, you will play a key role in coordinating and overseeing the daily operations of the business. You will ensure that daily activities are carried out efficiently, customer service standards remain high, and communication between employees and the business owner runs smoothly.

  • Provide day-to-day guidance and support to employees to ensure efficient customer service and smooth operations.

  • Handle customer feedback and complaints professionally and ensure timely resolution.

  • Maintain effective communication between employees and the business owner regarding daily operations.

  • Monitor customer service performance and the overall efficiency of daily operations.

  • Monitor customer satisfaction and recommend improvements to enhance the customer experience.

  • Identify operational challenges and recommend practical solutions to improve efficiency.

  • Suggest practical business development ideas and sales initiatives to support business growth and attract new customers.

  • Ensure daily tasks are completed on time while maintaining a well-organised and efficient working environment.

  • Represent the company professionally in all customer interactions.

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has experience in a dry-cleaning, laundry, cleaning or similar service business.

  • Is organised and capable of coordinating daily operations.

  • Has strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Is customer-focused and committed to delivering excellent service.

  • Is proactive, reliable and solution-oriented.

  • Can work independently while maintaining an overview in a busy working environment.

We Offer

  • A varied and responsible position with a key role in daily operations.

  • A friendly working environment with short decision-making processes.

  • Close collaboration with the business owner.

  • Salary based on qualifications and experience.

How to Apply

Please submit your application and CV as soon as possible to our contact person as we have an immediate need of getting the position filled.

English version:

Experienced Butchers – Shoulder Deboning

Work in Denmark as a butcher– attractive salary, flexibility and stable working conditions

For our customer, Danish Crown - one of Europe’s largest food companies - we are looking for experienced pork butchers for shoulder deboning (pork front ends) at abattoirs in Blans, Denmark.

Working in Denmark means clear employment conditions under collective agreements, pension schemes, paid holidays and stable working conditions. At Danish Crown you will join an international workplace with colleagues from many different countries.

The work is guided by clear values. Safety first is the most important principle – employees must always be able to work safely and return home safely every day.

Danish Crown is also focusing strongly on employee well-being and development. Employees should feel comfortable in their work, understand their role in the production and see how their contribution creates value for the company.
The company culture is based on teamwork, responsibility and mutual respect, where colleagues support each other and everyone is treated fairly.

Please note: You will be employed directly by Danish Crown from your first day of work

Job tasks

• Deboning of pork shoulders (front ends)
• Knife work in high-volume pork production
• Ensuring correct cutting and optimal meat yield
• Following hygiene and safety procedures
• Supporting other tasks in the cutting room when required

Candidate requirements

• Experience with deboning
• Preferably experience with pork shoulders / front ends
• Good knife skills
• Experience from a abattoirs or meat processing plant
• Ability to work in a fast-paced production environment
• Physically fit and reliable

Candidates must be able to work independently with deboning from the first working days.

Salary and working conditions

• Hourly wage according to the collective agreement: DKK 176.10 plus a flexible benefits allowance of 12.20% = DKK 197.58 per hour.

• After a short accomodation period, the salary will switch to piecework (akkord), where the hourly rate will increase significantly.

• Possibility of higher earnings depending on function and performance

• Flexible benefit scheme (extra pay or extra time off)

• Canteen facilities

• Opportunities for training and development

We also offer:

• Admininstrative assistance with CPR number, tax card, healt insurance, and more.

• Help with accomodation near the working place.

• Support in multiple languages ( English, Danish, Romanian, Polish, more)

• Guidance regarding Danish work and living culture.

Working hours

Day shift
Monday – Friday

40 hours per week

Employees accumulate additional hours that can be used for time off.
If flexible benefits and accumulated hours are used for time off, employees can potentially have up to around 10 weeks of time off per year.

Evening shift
32-hour work week distributed across 4 working days.

Employees on the evening shift do not accumulate extra hours, but instead have a weekly rotating day off, which means that approximately every fifth weekend they can have both Friday and Monday off.

Evening shift employees also receive additional evening pay for many of their working hours.

Application
If you are interested in the job, please complete the application form and attach your CV as soon as possible.

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Ewa Pedersen email ewape@jks.dk telefon: +45.61204070.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: We Are Hiring – Experienced Chef
description:
EU/EEA citizenship or valid right to work in Denmark required

Ærø Hotel is looking for an experienced, skilled and reliable Chef to join our international kitchen team.

We are located on the beautiful Danish island of Ærø, in the maritime town of Marstal. We are looking for an experienced chef who enjoys working in a structured professional kitchen, preparing good-quality food for a large number of hotel guests.

We have 1 position available.

About the position

You will become part of our evening kitchen team, which consists of five chefs working closely together.

Ærø Hotel does not operate an à la carte restaurant.

Our kitchen is based on planned production and pre-arranged menus for our hotel guests. We serve between approximately 100 and 200 guests every day.

During the day, we prepare and serve lunches, while dinner consists of pre-booked and predetermined two-course menus.

Our dinner concept follows a fixed rotation of four different two-course menus. After the fourth menu, the rotation starts again on day five.

This means that our kitchen operation is highly structured, allowing the team to focus on good preparation, consistency, quality and efficient service.

We are therefore looking for an experienced chef who is comfortable preparing food in larger quantities and who understands the importance of planning, organisation and consistency when serving many guests.

The primary working language in our kitchen is Spanish, while English is the common language throughout the rest of the hotel.

Your main responsibilities

  • Preparing lunches and evening meals for our hotel guests

  • Preparing and cooking food for approximately 100–200 guests per day

  • Working with our fixed rotation of pre-planned two-course dinner menus

  • Taking responsibility for your own tasks and preparation

  • Working closely with our team of five evening chefs

  • Ensuring consistent quality, taste and presentation

  • Planning and organising preparation efficiently

  • Contributing to a smooth and well-organised dinner service

  • Maintaining high standards of cleanliness and hygiene

  • Following Danish food safety and hygiene regulations

  • Supporting your colleagues and contributing to a professional and positive working environment

We are looking for someone who

  • Has solid professional experience working as a chef

  • Is experienced in preparing food for larger groups of guests

  • Is comfortable with high-volume food production

  • Is able to work independently and take responsibility

  • Understands the importance of planning, preparation and consistency

  • Works efficiently and remains organised during busy periods

  • Speaks Spanish and is able to communicate in English

  • Is reliable, responsible and flexible

  • Takes pride in food quality and presentation

  • Enjoys working as part of a professional kitchen team

  • Has EU/EEA citizenship or another valid right to work in Denmark

Previous professional experience as a chef is essential for this position.

Salary and employment conditions

Salary: DKK 180 per hour before tax.

Holiday allowance is paid in addition to the hourly salary in accordance with Danish regulations.

We offer attractive working hours and the opportunity to become part of an established and experienced kitchen team.

Start date: As soon as possible

Location: Ærø Hotel, Marstal, Denmark

Staff accommodation

If needed, we can offer staff accommodation close to the hotel.

The current accommodation consists of private bedrooms with shared kitchen and bathroom facilities.

Rent is DKK 750 per week and includes:

  • Electricity

  • Water

  • Heating

  • Internet

During the coming winter, the staff accommodation will undergo a complete renovation. After the renovation, each room will have its own private bathroom and small kitchen.

Accommodation is optional and paid by the employee.

About Ærø Hotel

Ærø Hotel is a well-established hotel located in Marstal on the island of Ærø in southern Denmark.

We welcome guests from Denmark and abroad and have an international team of employees from several different countries.

Our kitchen is an important part of the hotel experience. Because most of our guests stay with us as part of organised hotel packages, we know in advance how many guests we are cooking for and which menus will be served.

This gives us a structured way of working, where good preparation, teamwork and consistency are essential.

You will become part of an experienced kitchen team where everyone works together to ensure that between 100 and 200 guests receive a good dining experience every day.

Life on Ærø

Ærø is one of Denmark’s most beautiful and distinctive islands.

The island is known for its beautiful coastline, beaches, historic towns, colourful houses, maritime atmosphere and relaxed way of life.

Marstal has a strong maritime tradition and is a lively small town with shops, cafés and the everyday facilities needed when living on the island. At the same time, the sea and nature are always close by.

Working at Ærø Hotel gives you the opportunity to combine a professional job with life in a safe, peaceful and welcoming island community.

For the right person, Ærø offers much more than just a workplace. It is an opportunity to become part of an international team while experiencing a very special part of Denmark.

If you are an experienced chef and would like to become part of our team at Ærø Hotel, we would be very pleased to hear from you.

Please send us your CV together with a short introduction about yourself, your professional kitchen experience and when you would be available to start.

Key Responsibilities • Developing and implementing an SEO strategy for the company’s websites. • Promoting websites in Google for commercial and informational search queries. • Conducting technical SEO audits and monitoring the resolution of identified issues. • Analysing website structure, URLs, indexation, canonical tags, robots.txt, sitemaps and internal links. • Working with Google Search Console and Google Analytics. • Collecting and clustering the semantic core / keyword set. • Conducting keyword research and analysing search intent. • Analysing competitors and their SEO strategies. • Developing content plans together with editors and writers. • Preparing SEO briefs and technical specifications for new pages and articles. • Optimising existing content and landing pages. • Working with title tags, meta descriptions, H1–H3 headings, internal linking and page structure. • Monitoring the indexation and search visibility of newly published content. • Identifying opportunities to increase the websites’ topical authority. • Developing and implementing an off-page SEO and link-building strategy. • Analysing the backlink profiles of the company’s websites and competitors. • Monitoring rankings, organic traffic, CTR and conversions from organic search. • Preparing regular SEO reports.

We offer: • Flexible working arrangements (full-time or part-time).
• Remote work opportunities. • Long-term cooperation. • Competitive remuneration depending on experience and qualifications. • High salary.

Other requirements: Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a person who can work systematically with technical SEO, content, semantics, backlink profiles, analytics and search visibility. We are not looking for a specialist whose role is limited to placing keywords or purchasing links, but for a team member who wants to develop together with the company. The key result of the role is sustainable growth in high-quality organic traffic, rankings for commercially important queries and the company website’s overall search visibility. What We Expect from the Candidate • Practical SEO experience. • A strong understanding of how Google Search works. • Experience conducting technical SEO audits. • Experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics. • Ability to conduct keyword research and competitor research. • Understanding of on-page and off-page SEO. • Understanding of link-building principles. • Experience working with large content-driven websites will be an advantage. title: Pitsameister
description:
Tööülesanded: Tööülesandeks on Adavere Tuuliku Toidutänava pitsa suuna iseseisev käivitamine, korraldamine ja arendamine. Pitsameister vastutab pitsa kvaliteedi ja valmistamise eest, alustades taigna ja tooraine ettevalmistamisest kuni valmis pitsa serveerimiseni. Töö hõlmab kvaliteetse tooraine valimist, retseptide ja valmistamisstandardite väljatöötamist ning pitsa menüü koostamist ja arendamist.
Oluline on tagada ühtlane kõrge kvaliteet, hea maitse, kiirus ja korrektne töökorraldus ka suurema klientide arvu korral. Samuti tuleb jälgida tooraine varusid ja kvaliteeti, vähendada toidukadu ning hoida köök ja töövahendid puhtad ja korras. Pitsameister osaleb uute toodete ja ideede väljatöötamisel ning aitab arendada pitsa suunda vastavalt klientide tagasisidele ja müügitulemustele. Vajadusel tuleb juhendada teisi töötajaid ning tagada, et kõik pitsa valmistamisega seotud tööprotsessid vastaksid kokkulepitud kvaliteedistandarditele. Ootame iseseisvat ja ettevõtliku mõtteviisiga professionaali, kes ei tegele ainult pitsa valmistamisega, vaid soovib võtta vastutuse kogu pitsa suuna kvaliteedi, arendamise ja tulemuste eest.

Omalt poolt pakume: Pakume alustuseks kokkulepitud põhitöötasu vastavalt pitsa meistri kogemustele, oskustele ja professionaalsele tasemele. Töö ja tulemuste paranedes on võimalik töötasu on kuni 15 eurot/tund ning lisaks põhitöötasule teenida tulemustasu vastavalt pitsa suuna käibele, klientide rahulolule, positiivsele tagasisidele, reitingule ja püsikliendibaasi kasvule.
Meie eesmärk on, et tugeva ja tulemusliku töötaja sissetulek ei jääks pikaajaliselt ainult põhitöötasu tasemele. Mida suurem on inimese panus, vastutus ja saavutatud tulemus, seda suuremaks võib kujuneda ka tema teenistus. Pakume võimalust olla Adavere Tuuliku Toidutänava pitsa suuna ülesehitamisel oluline võtmeisik. Vajadusel on võimalik pakkuda majutust Adavere Tuuliku juures, kuid majutuskoht vajab eelnevalt remonti ja korrastamist. Parimatele töötajatele on võimalik pakkuda ka võimalust töötada Tenerifel ettevõtte baaris, kohvikus ja teistes toitlustusprojektides. Tenerifel töötamise korral on samuti võimalik pakkuda majutust. Töötajaga sõlmitakse tööleping Property Deals OÜga ning lähetatakse. Väga heade ja pikaajaliste tulemuste korral võib tulevikus avaneda võimalus saada ettevõttes suurem vastutus, võtmeroll või osalus ning osaleda ettevõtte edus sarnaselt partneriga.

description:
After nearly nine years of technology development, we are entering an important stage of growth. We are transitioning from low-rate engineering builds towards industrialisation, pre-series manufacturing and serial production.

Work tasks: Lead the transition from engineering builds through pre-series and into scalable serial production
Establish and scale Golbriak Space’s manufacturing, assembly, integration and testing capability in Estonia Develop repeatable production processes, routings, work instructions, acceptance criteria and engineering-to-production transfer practices Define production layouts, workstations, tooling, fixtures, equipment and test infrastructure Own the end-to-end manufacturing flow, from incoming inspection and material planning to final acceptance and shipping Implement production planning, capacity management, inventory control, ERP/MRP tools and relevant manufacturing metrics Oversee optical, electronic, mechanical and system-level assembly, integration, verification and testing Define and manage supplier, outsourcing and make-or-buy strategies for components and manufacturing activities Establish production and quality processes aligned with ISO 9001 principles, including traceability, change control and non-conformance management Identify and resolve manufacturing, testing, capacity and supply-chain risks and bottlenecks Drive continuous improvement across quality, yield, cycle time, cost and delivery performance Build, lead and develop the manufacturing and operations team as production scales

The opportunity to build a production facility and manufacturing capability from the ground up Direct involvement in taking advanced optical communication technology into serial production Close cooperation with the founders and a multidisciplinary engineering team A high level of autonomy and the ability to shape manufacturing systems, facilities, supplier strategy and team capability An international, technically ambitious and hands-on working environment A monthly gross salary of €4,655–€5,985, depending on experience and Relocation support to Estonia if required Flexible working hours, consistent with operational and team needs

Other requirements: Proven experience establishing or significantly scaling a manufacturing facility or function
Experience transferring complex hardware products from engineering builds through pre-series and into repeatable production Hands-on experience with industrialisation, production ramp-ups, assembly, integration and testing Strong understanding of production workflows, manufacturing-process development, test infrastructure and production readiness Experience defining production layouts, workstations, tooling, fixtures and equipment requirements Experience introducing work instructions, routings, production records, traceability and configuration controls Experience with production planning, capacity analysis, inventory management, material flow and ERP/MRP systems Experience developing make-or-buy strategies and managing specialised suppliers or contract manufacturers Knowledge of structured production and quality processes aligned with ISO 9001 or an equivalent framework Understanding of non-conformance management, corrective actions and controlled engineering changes Experience building, leading and developing manufacturing or operations teams Ability to demonstrate your personal contribution and measurable results from previous industrialisation or production scale-up work Ability to operate effectively at both strategic and hands-on levels Strong cross-functional coordination, prioritisation and problem-solving skills A builder’s mindset and motivation to create new manufacturing capability Professional fluency in English Willingness to reside in Estonia and work primarily onsite in Tallinn Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate results such as establishing a production facility, transferring hardware into serial production, increasing capacity or throughput, improving quality and delivery performance, implementing manufacturing systems, developing test infrastructure, qualifying suppliers or building a production team.

title: Toolmaker / Mold Maintenance Technician (Injection Molding)
description:
Aquaphor International OÜ is looking for an experienced Toolmaker / Mold Maintenance Technician (Injection Molding) to join our team.

Work tasks: Job description
Repair, service, and maintain injection molds. Perform preventive maintenance and keep molds production-ready. Diagnose mold and tooling issues and carry out necessary repairs. Disassemble, inspect, repair, and assemble molds and their components. Repair and manufacture tooling, mold components, and production fixtures. Support mold trials and troubleshoot mold-related issues in production. Preferred candidate profile Technical or vocational education in toolmaking, machining, mechanical engineering, industrial maintenance, or a related field. At least 3 years of hands-on experience in toolmaking, mold assembly, maintenance, or repair of injection molds. Good understanding of injection mold construction, components, mechanisms, and operating principles. Ability to repair and maintain injection molds of varying complexity, including cold runner and hot runner systems. Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings for molds and tooling. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Responsible, precise, and quality-focused approach to work. Good working knowledge of technical English.

We offer: Fixed-term contract for 12 months, with the possibility of extension
4-month probation period. Full-time position, 40 hours per week. Work location: Tallinn, Estonia. Employer-provided health insurance. 28 calendar days of annual leave. Company-provided workwear and personal protective equipment. A performance-based bonus system.

Option to work from home: No

title: Liiklusmärkide paigaldaja
description:
Pärnu

Tööülesanded: Meie eesmärk on tagada oma klientidele ja partneritele kõige turvalisemad ja eeskujulikumad töömaad Eestis. Selleks otstarbeks kasutame parimaid ja kvaliteetsemaid liikluskorraldus- ja ohutusvahendeid: ajutised liiklusmärgid, teepiirded, ehitusaiad, käigu- ja sõidusillad, teekünnised ja pinnasekaitsematid - need on vaid mõned tootegrupid millega igapäevaselt tegeleme.
Aga parimatest toodetest üksi ei piisa, vaja on ka professionaalseid paigaldajaid, kes tooteid eeskujulikult ning professionaalselt klientide töömaale kohale viiks ning paigaldaks. Töö iseloom ei ole kindlasti lihtsaimate killast - on pikki tööpäevi ja suuri raskuseid mida tõsta. Sinu ülesandeks on erinevatel objektidel liikluskorraldustööde teostamine. Sealhulgas: - ajutise liikluskorralduse üles seadmine vastavalt seaduses sätestatud punktidele; - liiklusmärkide ja muude liikluskorraldusvahendite transport ning paigaldamine; - objektide kontrollimine ja korrashoid (märkide ümbertõstmine, asendamine jms.); - lisaks muud liikluskorralduse ning töömaaohutusega seotud ülesanded.

Omalt poolt pakume: - konkurentsivõimeline palk;
- toetav ja tore meeskond; - head töötingimused ja -vahendid; - meeleolukad ühisüritused; - koolitus ja väljaõpe on kohapeal; - sporditoetused ja nii mõnigi muu hüve veel.

Muud nõuded: kiire õppimisvõime; kohusetundlikkus ja täpsus; hea füüsiline vorm; töötahe ning võime iseseisvalt tegutseda; eesti keele oskus; B-kategooria juhiloa olemasolu; valmisolek töötada ka õhtuti ja nädalavahetustel. Eelised: eelnev töökogemus liikluskorralduse või teedeehituse valdkonnas; BE-, C- või CE-kategooria juhiloa olemasolu.

Tegevusjuhendaja on vahetu teenuse osutaja, kelle tegevuse eesmärk on luua turvaline, struktureeritud ja toetav keskkond, mis arvestab kliendi individuaalsete eripäradega. Come work with a multidisciplinary engineering team focused on delivering world-class optical telecommunication systems for space, airborne and ground applications.

Work tasks: Key Responsibilities:
Develop, maintain and improve RTL modules in VHDL Implement high-speed digital logic for communication systems Create simulations and testbenches to verify RTL behaviour Verify and validate designs against technical and system requirements Use Quartus, GHDL and GTKWave as part of the development and verification workflow Investigate and resolve RTL, integration and system-level issues Maintain clear code documentation and verification records Debug and validate FPGA designs on physical hardware Support board bring-up and hardware integration Work with LVDS, Ethernet and other high-speed digital interfaces Support integration between Altera FPGAs and STM32 microcontrollers through CAN interfaces Use laboratory equipment, including high-speed oscilloscopes, power supplies and multimeters Support system-level testing, verification and product qualification Contribute to the integration of custom software-defined radio functionality Work closely with electronics, embedded software and systems engineers Coordinate with electronics engineers on FPGA pinout integration and chip interconnections Translate system and communication requirements into practical RTL implementations Maintain FPGA architecture, interface, verification and code documentation Provide practical input into the development and improvement of the communication system

We offer: We offer a competitive salary
Work/life balance with the possibility of flexible hours Bonuses based on performance The opportunity to work in a talented and dynamic startup environment.

Other requirements: Requirements:
A bachelor’s degree in electronics, computer engineering, telecommunications or another relevant technical field At least one year of practical RTL or FPGA development experience Practical experience with RTL design in VHDL Experience maintaining, improving and developing RTL modules Experience creating and using simulations and testbenches Experience debugging FPGA designs on physical hardware Experience designing long, high-speed processing pipelines Understanding of clock recovery and high-speed digital data paths Understanding of digital communication systems and network protocol layers Familiarity with FPGA-based communication interfaces Ability to use technical documentation, electronic schematics and component datasheets A structured approach to verification, debugging and technical documentation Ability to work independently while recognising when collaboration or support is needed Readiness to work in a startup environment where priorities and technical requirements may evolve Professional working proficiency in English at C1 level or equivalent University or personal projects may be considered as relevant experience when they include substantial FPGA-based development, such as developing a software-defined radio or a similarly complex system. title: Administraator
description:
Vastuvõtu administraator

Tööülesanded: Administraatori tööülesannete alla kuulub eelkõige külalistega ladus suhtlemine ja abivalmis hoiak. Tuleb külalisi sisse- kui ka välja registreerida, hoida silm peal e-mailidel ning aidata kliente ka telefoni teel.
Ootame kandidaadilt täpsust maksete ja broneeringusüsteemide haldamisel ning oskust olla vahelüliks erinevate osakondade vahel. Loodame leida vastutustundlikku ja rõõmsameelset inimest, kes oskaks ennast vabalt väljendada nii eesti kui ka inglise keeles. Suhtlustasemel vene keel ja muud võõrkeeled tulevad kasuks.

Omalt poolt pakume: Pakume graafiku alusel tööd ajavahemikul 7:00 - 23:00. Sõltuvalt hooajast ning vajadustest 8-10 tunnised vahetused, kas hommikul alates 7:00 või 12:30. Valmis tuleb olla ka pühadel ja nädalavahetustel töötamiseks.
Toimib igakuine motiveeriv boonussüsteem kus töötasu sõltub tööülesannete korrektsest täitmisest, meeskonnatööst ning klientide tagasisidest. Huvitav ja vaheldusrikas töö, sõbraliku ning üksteist toetava kollektiiviga, kellega tehakse koos ka ühisüritusi. Kontor asub vanalinnas. Võimalus töötada osalise tööajaga.

Muud nõuded: Sobivalt kandidaadilt ootame:
Valmisolekut meeskonnatööks; Head eesti ja inglise keele oskust, suhtlustasemel vene keelt; Positiivset ja avatud suhtlemist; Valmisolek mõnel korral nädalas olema peale tööpäeva telefoni valves; Valmisolekut töötamiseks päevasel ajal graafiku alusel, vahetustega (kaasaarvatud pühad ja nädalavahetused); Kohusetundlikkust, täpsusust.

title: Server
description:
Work tasks: Main areas of work:
- Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages. - Prepare and serve food, and hot and cold drinks to established standards, ensuring quality and consistency. - Organize workstations, operate tools and appliances in the serving and work area, and notify the kitchen of low stock levels as needed. - Maintain cleanliness and sanitation in serving and work areas, tools, and equipment; adhere to food safety laws and hygiene protocols - Operate the POS system to process cash, card, and digital payments accurately, providing receipts and resolving customer payment inquiries professionally. - Ensure cleanliness and hygiene by washing dishes, clearing tables, and maintaining dining areas, inspecting and monitoring products to ensure freshness and presentation consistency in accordance with company procedures. - Adhere to food safety, hygiene, and workplace safety protocols, including proper food handling, storage, and waste disposal. - Collaborate with team members, manage multiple tasks efficiently, especially during peak service times to ensure smooth operations, and assist with replenishing stock and supplies. - Provide support during staff absences or high-demand periods, performing duties as assigned to meet business needs. - Perform tasks assigned by the Manager adhering to schedules and deadlines. - Follow company regulations, procedures, and technical guidelines, participate in quality control checks, report issues promptly, and provide updates or reports as required.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: - Friendly, professional, and customer-oriented with strong communication skills to provide exceptional service and create a welcoming atmosphere.
- Detail-oriented and proactive, and flexible ensuring accuracy in orders, presentation standards, and anticipating customer needs. - Demonstrates integrity, and punctuality, a reliable team player with strong problem-solving skills, capable of working independently and collaboratively to ensure smooth operations. - Health-conscious and committed to upholding food safety, hygiene, and workplace safety protocols. - Proficiency in coffee preparation (espresso machines) and knowledge of basic alcoholic drink recipes and responsible service practices (preferred). - Experience in operating POS systems, handling payments, and managing accurate transactions efficiently (preferred). - A valid health certificate is required for food handling. - Physical stamina to stand, walk, and carry trays or supplies for extended periods. - Legal eligibility to meet age requirements for serving alcohol. - Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as required. Details about the schedules will be provided during the recruitment process.

Option to work from home: No

Seadmete kontroll ja hooldus: pesumasinad, boilerid, konditsioneerid, ventilatsioon. Vajalike materjalide ja varuosade ostmine. Objektide üldine tehniline korrashoid ja väiksemad ennetavad tööd.

description:
AJONEUVOASENTAJA / KORJAAMOPÄÄLLIKKÖ

**ModHaus Autokorjaamo Oy – Hyvinkää**

ModHaus Autokorjaamo Oy on uusi, kasvava ja kehittyvä autokorjaamo Hyvinkäällä. Haemme nyt joukkoomme **kokenutta ajoneuvoasentajaa / korjaamopäällikköä**, joka haluaa ottaa vastuuta korjaamon päivittäisestä toiminnasta ja olla mukana rakentamassa yrityksestä juuri sellaisen kuin siitä parhaimmillaan voi tulla.

Tässä tehtävässä et ole vain asentaja muiden joukossa. Etsimme henkilöä, joka haluaa **ottaa vastuuta, kehittää toimintaa ja vaikuttaa siihen, mihin suuntaan yritys tulevaisuudessa menee.**

TEHTÄVÄ

Korjaamopäällikkönä vastaat korjaamon päivittäisestä toiminnasta yhdessä toimitusjohtajan kanssa. Työhön kuuluu sekä käytännön korjaamotyötä että korjaamon johtamiseen ja kehittämiseen liittyviä tehtäviä.

Tehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- Ajoneuvojen vianhaku, diagnostiikka ja korjaaminen

- Huolto- ja korjaustöiden suunnittelu ja työnjohto

- Asiakaspalvelu ja asiakkaiden kanssa asiointi

- Tarjouslaskenta ja töiden hinnoittelu

- Työmääräysten tekeminen ja töiden aikataulutus

- Varaosien ja tarvikkeiden tilaaminen

- Korjaamon päivittäisen toiminnan organisointi

- Työn laadun ja tehokkuuden seuranta

- Reklamaatioiden ja haastavien asiakastilanteiden hoitaminen

- Korjaamon toimintatapojen, palveluiden ja työskentelyn kehittäminen

- Työkalujen, laitteiden ja muiden hankintojen suunnittelu

- Muut korjaamopäällikön tehtävät


Tehtävässä pääset siis tekemään monipuolisesti **sekä käsillä että päällä**.

MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on vähintään noin **2–5 vuoden kokemus ajoneuvoalalta** ja joka pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti.

Sinulta odotamme erityisesti:

- Vahvaa ajoneuvojen teknistä osaamista

- Kykyä itsenäiseen vianhakuun ja vaativampienkin korjausten tekemiseen

- Oma-aloitteisuutta

- Vastuuntuntoa

- Hyviä asiakaspalvelu- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- Ongelmanratkaisukykyä

- Kykyä organisoida ja priorisoida työtehtäviä

- Halua kehittää sekä itseäsi että työpaikkaa

- Yrittäjähenkistä ja rakentavaa asennetta


**VAG-osaaminen katsotaan erityiseksi eduksi**, mutta haemme ennen kaikkea hyvää ja monipuolista ajoneuvoalan ammattilaista.

B-ajokortti on tehtävässä välttämätön.

MITÄ ME TARJOAMME?

ModHaus on uusi yritys, joten tässä tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan asioihin tavalla, joka ei välttämättä ole mahdollista suuremmissa ja valmiiksi organisoiduissa korjaamoissa.

**Sinun ei tarvitse vain sopeutua valmiisiin toimintatapoihin – pääset rakentamaan niitä kanssamme.**

Kuuntelemme työntekijöiden kehitysehdotuksia ja haluamme antaa korjaamopäällikölle mahdollisimman hyvät mahdollisuudet kehittää toimintaa. Keskustelemme asioista yhdessä toimitusjohtajan kanssa, mutta tehtävässä on **suhteellisen vapaat kädet viedä korjaamoa haluttuun suuntaan**.

Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan esimerkiksi:

- Korjaamon toimintatapoihin

- Työkaluihin ja laitteisiin

- Palveluiden kehittämiseen

- Varaosahankintoihin ja yhteistyökumppaneihin

- Hinnoitteluun ja työn tehokkuuteen

- Asiakaspalveluun

- Korjaamon tulevaisuuden suuntaan


Ja mikä tärkeintä, **onnistuessasi sinulla on mahdollisuus kasvaa yrityksen mukana.**

MAHDOLLISUUS OSAKKUUTEEN

Tehtävässä on **mahdollisuus myöhemmässä vaiheessa yrityksen osakkuuteen**.

Etsimme siis henkilöä, joka ei välttämättä halua olla vain työntekijä, vaan jolla on halua ja kiinnostusta olla rakentamassa ModHausista pitkäjänteisesti menestyvää yritystä.

TYÖSUHDE

- **Tehtävä:** Ajoneuvoasentaja / Korjaamopäällikkö

- **Työsuhde:** Vakituinen

- **Työaika:** 37,5 h / viikko

- **Aloitus:** Mahdollisimman pian

- **Palkkaus:** Sopimuksen ja kokemuksen mukaan

- **Työpaikka:** Hyvinkää


KIINNOSTUITKO?

Jos kuulostaa siltä, että tämä voisi olla sinun paikkasi, **lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro meille itsestäsi, työkokemuksestasi sekä siitä, millaisena näet hyvän ja toimivan autokorjaamon.**

Hakemuksen voit lähettää sähköpostitse osoitteeseen:

**sami@modhaus.fi**

Voit hakea myös suoraan ilmoituksen hakulinkin kautta.

**ModHaus Autokorjaamo Oy**_Rakennetaan yhdessä korjaamo, jossa haluaisimme itsekin asioida._

title: Technical Writer, Espoo
description:
About the role

This role is central to our client's product development, focusing on creating and maintaining high-quality technical documentation. You will collaborate closely with various teams, translating complex technical information into clear, accurate, and engaging content for both internal and external audiences.

You are offered Flexible working arrangements, including remote work options, alongside comprehensive training opportunities.

Work tasks

This role involves producing high-quality technical documentation, from initial composition and illustration to writing and editing. You will collaborate with subject matter experts to gather information and create a variety of product and service documents, ensuring accuracy and adherence to style guides.
- Perform technical publications production duties including composition, illustration, and technical writing and editing.
- Develop clear written materials to support product development activities.
- Work cross-functionally with Subject Matter Experts to collect product information and specifications.
- Create, develop, update, and publish highly accurate product and service documents.
- Collect and organize technical information and product images, coordinating layout for publication.
- Develop and author technical documentation adhering to publication processes and style guides.
- Write, structure, and publish technical content using DITA XML.

We are looking for

- Advanced knowledge in Technical Writing
- Advanced knowledge in Technical Illustration
- Fluent written and spoken skills in English and Finnish languages
- Strong interpersonal skills
- Strong aptitude for learning new technical concepts

It is meritorious if you have
- Good knowledge of DITA XML
- Good knowledge of FrameMaker
- Good knowledge of Photoshop or photo illustration tools
- Good understanding of Mechanical Engineering principles

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
- Change oriented
- Trustful
- Supportive
- Goal oriented
- Social
- Responsible
- Intellectually curious

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Contract Manager @ Davie Shipyards in Finland
description:
**Calling all experienced contract managers who are ready for their next challenge!**

Are you a customer-centric and commercially minded contract management professional? Do you have exposure to working with complex and high-value projects? Are you motivated by taking ownership in a growth-seeking business environment?

If you answered **YES**, please keep reading, because you could be the one we are looking for to join **Davie Shipyards in Finland** as their very first **Contract Manager**!

This newly established role will be part of the Legal team and offers a unique opportunity to help shape contract management practices and work at the interface between Projects, Procurement, Legal and Business teams. Due to a strong order book and the strategic decision to pursue growth, the operations of Davie Shipyards in Finland are expanding rapidly, making this a particularly exciting time to join the team!

_Davie Shipyards in Finland brings together Helsinki Shipyard in Helsinki and SATA Shipbuilding in Pori, combining internationally recognised Finnish shipbuilding expertise with some of the world's most demanding maritime projects. Davie, a privately held international marine group with operations in Canada, Finland, and the United States_, _is one of the world's leading builders of icebreakers, specialised vessels and offshore structures. As part of Davie, Davie Shipyards in Finland works on complex projects in Finland and internationally. You can learn more about Davie Shipyards in Finland athttps://helsinkishipyard.fi/company/helsinki-shipyard-oy/._

**In this role,** you will contribute to the successful delivery of complex international shipbuilding projects in direct customer-interface. In more practical terms, you will:

- Identify and manage contractual and commercial risks

- Serve as the first point of contact towards customers, ensuring that that they remain updated on the progress of the project

- Support in contract interpretation and implementation

- Manage change orders, contractual notices and claims processes

- Participate in contract negotiations and commercial discussions

- Ensure compliance with contractual obligations during project execution

- Develop contract management processes, templates and best practices

- Promote contractual awareness across the organisation


The legal team of Davie Shipyards in Finland works primarily from the Helsinki Shipyard office in southern Helsinki. While the team works flexibly, we are looking for someone who enjoys working mainly on-site and being an active part of the team's day-to-day collaboration. The role requires occasional travel.

You will join a growing team of a handful of legal professionals, and report to the Head of Legal of Davie Shipyards in Finland. You will also have a dotted reporting line to the Head of Sales and get support from your international contract management colleagues based in other Davie office locations.

**This role would be ideal for a contract management professional who:**

- has a relevant degree e.g. in Business, Engineering or Law, combined with 5+ years of experience in contract management, commercial management or project environments;

- has experience in working with complex commercial contracts and a strong understanding of contractual risk management, as well as experience in working with and supporting project organisations;

- works with a practical and commercially minded, customer-centric approach;

- is capable of building processes and best practices, and knows how to raise awareness and influence others across the organization; and

- has great communication skills and excellent working proficiency in both English and Finnish.


Experience in shipbuilding, industrial, construction, infrastructure or EPC projects is considered an advantage.

**Davie Shipyards in Finland offers you:**

- **Independent responsibility:** As the first Contract Manager to join Davie Shipyards in Finland, you will have an independent and integral role in supporting in large-scale, technically complex international projects.

- **Building a Contract Management Function in Finland:** You get to shape the way Davie Shipyards in Finland operates in terms contract management in Finland.

- **Frontline role:** You will have a frontline role working with clients, as well as in close co-operation internally with business, legal, procurement and project teams.

- **International & growth-seeking working environment**: You will be part of world-leading icebreaker and special vessel projects around the world, working with international customers and contractors and alongside colleagues across the Davie organisation in an actively growth-seeking corporate setting.


**Interested?** Send us your CV and cover letter no later than **3 September 2026.** If you would like to discuss the position in more detail, feel free to reach out to Minjon's recruitment consultant Vilma Suomi (+358 50 360 5134 or vilma.suomi@minjon.fi).

_In line with the hiring policies ofDavie Shipyards in Finland, a security clearance based on the Security Clearance Act (726/2014) as well as drug testing will be performed on the selected candidate._

title: Tender Manager
description:
**Join Our Team as Nordic Tender Manager**

Are you looking to join a global market-leading company that is shaping the future of Energy Management and Automation?

Schneider Electric is at the forefront of driving innovative and sustainable technologies across homes, buildings, data centers, infrastructure, and industries.

We believe in the power of great people and are committed to driving innovation, diversity, and sustainability.

Globally we are more than 150,000 people in 100+ countries and among the most sustainable companies in the world.

As a Tender Manager, you will lead the end-to-end tendering process for complex, high-value projects. This role requires a strategic mindset, strong leadership, and the ability to coordinate across multiple business units to leverage synergies for shared customers.

We are looking for a highly motivated, proactive individual who thrives in a fast-paced exciting environment and is driven to deliver winning results.

**What you'll be doing:**

- **Tender Strategy Development**_:_ Define and implement tailored tender strategies that align with business goals and customer needs_._

- **Bid Leadership**: Lead the preparation, coordination, and submission of high-quality bids, ensuring compliance with all requirements and deadlines.

- **Cross-Functional Coordination**: Collaborate with other business units and with zone: sales, engineering, legal, finance, and procurement teams to gather inputs and validate offer components.

- **Risk Management**: Identify and assess commercial, contractual, and technical risks, and develop mitigation strategies.

- **Customer Engagement**: Maintain strong relationships with clients throughout the tendering process, including clarifying requirements and negotiating terms.

- **Process Improvement**: Capture lessons learned and contribute to the development of best practices, tools, and templates to enhance future tendering efficiency.


**What will help you succeed:**

- **Leadership:** Proven ability to lead cross-functional and remote teams, influence without authority, and drive alignment across departments.

- **Ownership:** Energetic and committed to achieving results. You take initiative, overcome obstacles, and pursue opportunities with determination.

- **Strategic Thinking**: Ability to see the broader business context and align tender strategies with long-term objectives.

- **Tender Management**: Strong organizational skills to manage multiple tenders simultaneously under tight deadlines.

- **Commercial Acumen**: Deep understanding of pricing models, contract terms, and financial implications of bids. Ability to assess risks, evaluate scenarios, and make data-driven decisions.

- **Communication**: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for both internal coordination and external client interaction.

- **Resilience**: Comfortable working under pressure and adapting to changing priorities.

- **Education**: Bachelors or Masters degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field.


- **Experience:** Several years of experience in tendering, bid management, or commercial project roles. Experience working in matrix organizations and coordinating across business units is beneficial. Familiarity with public and private sector procurement processes.

- **Language:** Fluent in English; Nordic language is a plus.


**Why Schneider Electric?**

At Schneider Electric, we are committed to fostering a vibrant and inclusive work culture where every employee is empowered to thrive. As part of our team, you can expect:

- **Professional Growth**: Access to continuous learning opportunities, mentorship programs, and career development resources to nurture your potential and drive your career forward.

- **Innovative Environment**: Be part of a dynamic, forward-thinking organization that encourages creativity, innovation, and entrepreneurial spirit as we lead the way in digital transformation and sustainability.

- **Work-Life Balance:** We value your well-being and offer flexible work arrangements, comprehensive wellness programs, and support to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.

- **Global Impact:** Contribute to meaningful projects that address global energy challenges and sustainability, making a positive impact on the world while advancing your career.

- **Inclusive Community:** Join a diverse and inclusive community where your unique perspectives are celebrated, and your voice is heard, fostering an environment of collaboration and belonging.


**Did we get you inspired?**

Apply now to embark on an exciting career journey with us!

Submit your application today as we will fill the position as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

title: Närvårdare
description:
VERKSAMHETEN
Äldreomsorgen i Mariehamns stad sysselsätter omkring 200 medarbetare. Vi erbjuder bland annat hemservice, dagverksamhet, korttidsvård, serviceboende med heldygnsomsorg samt institutionsvård. De aktuella platserna som ska tillsättas är placerade inom Trobergshemmets institutionsvård och serviceboende med heldygnsomsorg.

ARBETET
Arbetet består av att utföra grundläggande omvårdnadsinsatser utifrån klientens behov genom ett rehabiliterande och aktiverande förhållningssätt. Samtliga klienter har en kontaktperson som bland annat ansvarar för planering av insatser, uppföljning och att ge information. Dokumentation är en viktig del av det dagliga arbetet.

KVALIFIKATIONER
För tillsvidare anställning söker vi dig som har formell behörighet som närvårdare med skyddad yrkesbeteckning och är registrerad i Valvira. Om du saknar den formella behörigheten som närvårdare så är du ändå välkommen att söka och kan då vara aktuell för ett vikariat. Du klarar av varierande arbetsuppgifter, har ett fint bemötande och bidrar till arbetsglädje. Du kan arbeta självständigt och samarbeta med kollegor samt de övriga professionerna du kommer i kontakt med. Du har en positiv inställning till, och bidrar till verksamhetens kontinuerliga förbättringsarbete. En del av platserna är för nuvarande placerade inom demensavdelning. Meriterande till dessa platser är specialkunskaper samt erfarenhet av kognitiva sjukdomar.

Vi kan erbjuda följande platser:

- 1 st 100 % tillsvidare med aktuell placering inom demensavdelning
- 2 st 100 % tillsvidare
- 1 st 95 % tillsvidare
- 4 st 91,5 % tillsvidare
- 1 st 83,5 % tillsvidare
- 2 st 75 % tillsvidare

Trobergshemmet serviceboende
- 1 st 91,5% tillsvidare
- 2 st 75 % tillsvidare med aktuell placering inom demensavdelning
- 1 st 100% vikariat för perioden 19.10.2026-31.05.2027
- 1 st 75% vikariat för perioden 19.10.2026-31.05.2027

Samtliga anställningar är i arbetsavtalsförhållande. Arbetet inleds med en prövotid om 6 månader och startar enligt överenskommelse. Grundlönen är 2874,34 euro i månaden för heltidsarbete och uppfyllda behörighetskrav, vidare tillkommer eventuella erfarenhetstillägg och individuella lönetillägg. Staden erbjuder dessutom omfattande företagshälsovård och friskvårdsförmåner.

Anställningen kräver vaccinationsskydd i enlighet med § 48 i Lagen om smittsamma sjukdomar (FFS 1227/2016).

title: Assistant Cafe Manager, Relove Töölö, Helsinki
description:
Relove on kotimainen perheyritys, second hand -alan pioneeri ja rakastettu lifestyle-brändi, joka yhdistää laadukkaan second hand -myymälän ja tunnelmallisen kahvilan saman katon alle. Reloven maailmassa vastuullisuus, yhteisöllisyys ja ensiluokkainen asiakaskokemus kulkevat käsi kädessä. Liikkeissämme asiakkaat voivat tehdä upeita löytöjä, nauttia herkullisesta ruoasta ja kahvista sekä viettää aikaa inspiroivassa ympäristössä. Etsimme nyt Relove Töölön kahvilaan Assistant Cafe Manageria vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

Assistant Cafe Managerina toimit Cafe Managerin tärkeänä työparina kahvilan päivittäisessä johtamisessa ja esihenkilötyössä. Kyseessä on monipuolinen rooli, jossa yhdistyvät vahva operatiivinen tekeminen, henkilöstön johtaminen sekä liiketoiminnan kehittäminen. Työskentelet merkittävän osan työajastasi kahvilan suorittavissa työvuoroissa yhdessä tiimin kanssa ja toimit esimerkkinä asiakaspalvelussa, laadussa ja päivittäisessä tekemisessä. Samalla kannat vastuuta henkilöstöstä, asiakaskokemuksesta sekä toiminnan sujuvuudesta.

Roolissa toimit Cafe Managerin tukena kahvilan johtamisessa ja osallistut muun muassa työvuorosuunnitteluun, henkilöstön perehdytykseen, osaamisen kehittämiseen, rekrytointeihin sekä päivittäisten arkihaasteiden ratkaisemiseen. Tuet Shift Managereita ja muuta tiimiä heidän onnistumisessaan, seuraat myynnin kehittymistä sekä osallistut aktiivisesti toiminnan ja asiakaskokemuksen kehittämiseen yhdessä Cafe Managerin kanssa. Assistant Cafe Managerilta odotetaan riittävää osaamista ja itsenäisyyttä, jotta pystyt tarvittaessa vastaamaan kahvilan toiminnasta myös Cafe Managerin poissa ollessa.

Olet näkyvästi läsnä arjen tekemisessä ja johdat esimerkilläsi. Hahmotat kokonaisuuksia, pystyt tekemään päätöksiä muuttuvissa tilanteissa ja huolehdit siitä, että sekä asiakkaat että työntekijät saavat parhaan mahdollisen kokemuksen Relovessa. Ymmärrät, miten laadukas asiakaskokemus, hyvinvoiva henkilöstö, myynti, resursointi ja kannattavuus muodostavat yhdessä toimivan liiketoiminnan perustan.

Tarjoamme sinulle

- Vakituisen työsuhteen, sopimustunnit 90h/3vko
- Vaihtelevat työajat kahvilan aukioloaikoja mukaillen maanantaista sunnuntaihin, sisältäen sekä aamu- että iltavuoroja
- Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen esihenkilöroolin, jossa pääset kehittämään sekä ihmisiä että liiketoimintaa
- Mahdollisuuden kasvaa ja kehittyä esihenkilötehtävissä
- Tiiviin yhteistyön Cafe Managerin sekä muun Reloven organisaation kanssa
- Lämminhenkisen työyhteisön ja Reloven arvoihin perustuvan ihmisläheisen yrityskulttuurin
- Palkkauksen perustuen Marava:n työehtosopimukseen sekä aiempaan kokemukseesi ja osaamiseesi; sopimuksen mukaan 16-18 €/h.
- Hyvät työsuhde-edut (mm. työterveyshuolto, ePassi flex, jopa -50 % alennus Relovessa ja -20 % Rue Madamessa ruoka- ja juomatuotteista itselle ja pöytäseurueelle)

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Assistant Cafe Managerin roolissa menestyminen edellyttää kykyä yhdistää käytännönkahvilatyö, ihmisten johtaminen sekä kaupallinen ajattelu.

Osaaminen ja kokemus

- Useamman vuoden kokemusta kahvila- tai ravintola-alalta
- Aiempaa esihenkilökokemusta esim. vuoropäällikkönä kahvila- tai ravintola-alalta, lisäksi tarvitset vahvaa valmiutta ottaa seuraava askel vastuullisempaan esihenkilörooliin
- Kokemusta henkilöstön ohjaamisesta, palautteen antamisesta ja perehdyttämisestä
- Kykyä tehdä itsenäisiä päätöksiä ja ratkaista päivittäisiä tilanteita vastuullisesti
- Kiinnostusta liiketoimintaan, myynnin seuraamiseen ja toiminnan kehittämiseen
- Ymmärrystä erinomaisen asiakaskokemuksen merkityksestä

Persoona, joka menestyy tässä roolissa

- Olet energinen, innostava ja käytännönläheinen sekä haluat työskennellä osana tiimiä
- Nautit vauhdikkaasta arjesta, osaat priorisoida ja pystyt säilyttämään kokonaiskuvan kirkkaana myös kiireen keskellä
- Johdat esimerkilläsi positiivisella, mutta samalla jämäkällä otteella, aidosti välittäen
- Sinulla on vahvat organisointi- ja yhteistyötaidot sekä kyky innostaa ihmisiä yhteisten tavoitteiden saavuttamiseen
- Tartut rohkeasti arjen tilanteisiin etkä jää odottamaan valmiita ratkaisuja
- Arvostat ihmisläheistä yrityskulttuuria ja haluat olla mukana rakentamassa avoimen vuorovaikutuksen työyhteisöä, jossa ihmiset voivat ja viihtyvät hyvin, kehittyvät ja sitoutuvat yhteisiin tavoitteisiin

Tehtävä edellyttää täysi-ikäisyyttä, hygienia- ja anniskelupassia sekä sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa. Terveydentilan selvitys salmonellatartunnasta on esitettävä ennen työn aloitusta.

Me Relovessa uskomme siihen, että parhaat asiakaskohtaamiset syntyvät hyvinvoivista tiimeistä. Assistant Cafe Managerina pääset vaikuttamaan sekä työntekijöiden että asiakkaiden kokemukseen päivittäin ja rakentamaan yhdessä tiimin kanssa kahvilaa, jossa on ilo työskennellä ja asioida.

Kuulostaako hyvältä, kiinnostuitko? Jos nautit ihmisten johtamisesta, haluat olla näkyvä osa kahvilan arkea ja olet valmis ottamaan seuraavan askeleen esihenkilöurallasi, haluamme kuulla sinusta. Lähetä hakemuksesi meille mahdollisimman pian, sillä käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Rekrytoinnista vastaa yhteistyökumppanimme Barona, ja valittu henkilö työllistyy suoraan Relovelle.

**********************

Jätäthän hakemuksen hakulomakkeen kautta, sillä emme voi tietoturvasyistä huomioida sähköpostitse jätettyjä hakemuksia. Hakeaksesi avoimia työpaikkoja, sinun tulee luoda työnhakuprofiili Barona Careersiin. Täytät profiilisi vain kerran, minkä jälkeen voit hakea kaikkia Baronan työpaikkoja samalla profiililla.

title: Liikunnanohjaaja / Uinninvalvoja
description:
Raahen kaupungin liikuntapalvelut vastaa kaupungin liikuntapaikoista, -alueista ja -rakennuksista sekä tuottaa näihin liittyviä liikuntapalveluita. Luomme päivittäisellä työllämme liikkumiselle ja harrastamiselle hyvät ja turvalliset puitteet.

Haemme moniammatilliseen joukkoomme LIIKUNNANOHJAAJAA/UINNINVALVOJAA määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen 1.9.2026 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Liikunnanohjaaja/uinninvalvoja työskentelee Kuntokeidas Vesipekan liikunnanohjaus- ja uinninvalvojatiimissä. Pääasialliset työtehtävät ovat koululaisten uimaopetus, uinninvalvonta ja vesiliikunnanohjaus. Työhön liittyy myös uusien kurssien ja tapahtumien suunnittelua ja järjestämistä.

Odotamme liikunnanohjaaja/uinninvalvojalta vähintään Suomen uimaopetus- ja hengenpelastusliiton uimaopetuskurssia ja/tai uinninvalvojan kurssia. Tehtävässä eduksi katostaan aiempi työkokemus vastaavista tehtävistä. Sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja viestintätaidot, suomenkielen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito sekä osaat hyödyntää niitä työssäsi. Toimintatavoiltasi olet suunnitelmallinen, itseohjautuva ja yhteistyökykyinen.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on SUH:n uimaopetuskurssi ja/tai uinninvalvojakurssi.

Työ on kaksivuorotyötä, joka sisältää viikonlopputyötä, työaika 30h/vko. Valitulla on kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaika. Ennen työtehtävän vastaanottamista valitun on esitettävä lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan sekä rikosrekisteriote lasten kanssa työskentelyyn.

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
We are looking for two

**Electrical Engineers**

In this position, you will do engineering feedback handling including electric schema and wiring harness drawing updates and small-scale design work. The final job content will be adjusted according to your skills and interests. The role is based in Iisalmi, Finland, with the possibility to work also remotely from our remote work office in Kuopio. The position includes occasional evening shifts in Iisalmi.

**Main responsibilities and tasks:**

- Maintenance engineering and on-call support

- Management, prioritization, and processing of ECR (EngineeringChangeRequest) feedback related to electrical design.


**To shine in this position, we hope you to have:**

- Electrical design skills and already some relevant experience

- Experience in Zuken E3 -electrical design software, AutoCad, Autodesk Inventor (3D). Sovelia PDM or MS AX ERP-systems are advantage.

- Understanding of underground machines or similar heavy machinery, experience in machinery industry and in product management are an asset

- Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field

- Strong desire and motivation to develop and work within electrical design

- Can do -attitude and proactive approach to work

- Communication skills, ability to collaborate and customer orientated approach

- Efficient ability in problem solving and pressure handling skills – you are able to prioritize even under pressure

- A self-driven working style, willing to take responsibility and ownership

- Safety first mindset

- Fluent written and spoken Finnish and English


**As an employer, we support your well-being with benefits such as:** ePassi for lunch and Flex benefits (sports, wellness, and culture), occupational health care and specialist-level treatment through our work ability insurance, access to Aunties mental well-being services and more.

We also support degree-oriented studies that benefit Normet with 10 paid working days per year.

In addition, we have an active HYVÄ Normet leisure committee, which organizes various leisure and sports-related events throughout the year.

Read more about working at Normet: https://www.normet.com/en/discover-normet/careers

title: Sales Executive
description:
The Sales Executive will be responsible for generating new business, maintaining client relationships, promoting company services, and achieving sales targets. The role requires strong communication skills, customer-focused thinking, and the ability to work independently.

Key Responsibilities

Identify and approach potential customers, corporate clients, travel agencies, hotels, and partners

Promote Rocking Tours services including transport, tours, airport transfers, and travel packages

Develop and maintain long-term customer relationships

Prepare quotations, offers, and follow up on leads

Manage sales pipeline and meet monthly targets

Attend networking events, exhibitions, and meetings when required

Coordinate with operations team to ensure smooth service delivery

Maintain CRM records and customer database

Monitor market trends and competitor activities

Support digital sales campaigns and online inquiries

Requirements

Previous experience in sales, customer service, tourism, or transport industry preferred

Strong communication and negotiation skills

Self-motivated and target-driven personality

Good computer skills (Email, MS Office, CRM systems, social media)

Ability to work independently and as part of a team

Valid driving licence is an advantage

Good English skills required

Finnish language is an advantage

Additional languages (Urdu, Arabic, Swedish, etc.) are a plus

What We Offer

Competitive salary + performance-based commission

Opportunity to grow with an expanding company

Friendly and multicultural working environment

Flexible working model

Training and career development opportunities

How to Apply

Please send your CV and short introduction to: admin@rockingtours.fi

Subject: Application Sales Executive

**Instructions for application**

Rocking Tours is a growing travel and transport company in Finland, offering airport transfers, private tours, group transport, Umrah/Hajj travel support, and customized tourism services for local and international clients. We are looking for a motivated and energetic Sales Executive to help grow our customer base and build strong business relationships.

Application period ends 15.09.2026

**More information about the company**

Rocking Tours is a growing travel and transport company in Finland, offering airport transfers, private tours, group transport, Umrah/Hajj travel support, and customized tourism services for local and international clients. We are looking for a motivated and energetic Sales Executive to help grow our customer base and build strong business relationships.

title: Medarbetare till Haraldsbyfabrikens Logistikavdelning
description:
**Vill du bli en del av ett engagerat team i livsmedelsindustrin?**

Vi söker nu en noggrann och ansvarstagande medarbetare till vår ompacksavdelning.

Hos oss får du arbeta i en viktig del av produktionen där kvalitet, effektivitet och samarbete står i fokus.

**Om tjänsten**

Som medarbetare på ompacksavdelningen arbetar du med ompacketering av specialorders från kund, sortering, och agerar även ibland stöd åt vår produktionsavdelning.

Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med kollegor från både produktion och lager.

Tjänsten innefattar även lättare lyft och fysiskt arbete, vilket gör att du trivs med att vara i rörelse under arbetsdagen.

Denna tjänst innebär skiftesarbete

**Vi söker dig som**

- Har god samarbetsförmåga och en positiv inställning

- Trivs med praktiskt arbete

- Är ansvarstagande och flexibel

- Kan följa instruktioner och rutiner inom livsmedelssäkerhet och kvalitet


Tidigare erfarenhet från produktion, lager eller livsmedelsindustri är meriterande, men inget krav.

**Vi erbjuder**

- En trygg arbetsplats med trevliga kollegor

- Introduktion och upplärning på plats i verksamheten

- Möjlighet att utvecklas inom verksamheten

- Ett arbete där du bidrar till att leverera produkter av hög kvalitet till våra kunder


**Låter detta intressant?**

Tjänsten är tidsbestämd fram till och med 23.12.2026 med viss möjlighet till förlängning

Närmare uppgifter om tjänsten ger vår Logistikchef Stefan Nyman på telefon 040 743 7234 Vi behandlar ansökningarna i den takt de kommer in, så lämna in din ansökan redan idag till job.ocs@orkla.fi, **sista ansökningsdag är 11:e september**

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!
