title: Senior Sales Analyst
description:
Our Sales Operations team is looking for a Senior Sales Analyst to help transform data into insights that support business decisions and drive commercial success. In this role, you will work closely with sales leadership and other stakeholders across the organization, turning sales performance, pipeline, and forecasting data into meaningful recommendations that help guide our growth. Rather than building reporting foundations from scratch, you will build on the strong processes and tools already in place and play a key role in strengthening data-driven decision-making across the business. Interested? Keep reading!

As a Senior Sales Analyst, you will lead our sales forecasting activities by gathering and analyzing data, identifying trends, and providing consolidated input for demand planning and S&OP processes. You will be responsible for producing monthly business analyses on bookings, pipeline development, and commercial performance, helping sales leadership understand what is happening in the business and why. In addition, you will own CRM data quality, ensuring that our sales data remains reliable, actionable, and aligned with business needs. You will proactively identify opportunities to improve sales processes, recommend development initiatives, and collaborate with stakeholders across functions to implement improvements. As a trusted partner to sales leadership, you will provide insightful analyses rather than simply reporting numbers, enabling informed decision-making throughout the organization.

To succeed in this role, you have +5 years of experience working in sales analytics, sales operations, business analytics, or a similar commercial analytics role and have a strong track record of translating complex data into clear business insights. You have experience supporting sales forecasting, pipeline management, KPI tracking, and commercial reporting, and you understand how sales organizations operate. You are comfortable working with CRM systems and have a strong understanding of data quality management and governance. You communicate clearly and confidently, both verbally and in writing, and are able to explain your recommendations and influence stakeholders at different organizational levels. You enjoy collaborating with sales leaders and are confident enough to challenge existing ways of working when improvements are needed.

Experience from a manufacturing company and/or a fast-growing international organization is considered an advantage. Salesforce administration experience and relevant certifications are also a plus. We value individuals who combine strong analytical capabilities with initiative, curiosity, and the confidence to independently drive improvements and development projects.

We offer you an interesting, challenging, and responsible position in a highly skilled and growing organization. This is an excellent opportunity to work closely with sales leadership, influence business decisions, and further develop your expertise in sales operations and analytics. You will be supported by a collaborative work community where continuous improvement, learning, and teamwork are part of everyday work.

Main responsibilities:

* Lead sales forecasting activities, including data gathering, analysis, and insight generation

* Provide consolidated sales input for demand planning and S&OP processes

* Deliver monthly business analyses and reports on bookings, pipeline development, and commercial performance

* Own CRM sales data quality and drive continuous improvement of data accuracy and consistency

* Maintain and further develop sales KPIs and performance tracking

* Produce insights and recommendations that support data-driven decision-making for sales leadership

* Identify, propose, and drive initiatives that improve sales processes and ways of working

* Support CRM adoption and provide guidance and training to sales teams when needed

* Lead sales process development projects and collaborate with stakeholders across functions

What we expect from you

* Bachelors or Masters degree in business administration, finance, economics, analytics, or another relevant field

* More than 5 years of experience in sales analytics, sales operations, business analytics, or a similar commercial analytics role

* Strong experience in sales analytics, forecasting, KPI management, business reporting, and CRM-driven sales processes

* Ability to transform data into actionable business insights and recommendations that support commercial decision-making

* Solid understanding of sales processes and commercial operations, combined with strong analytical and problem-solving skills

* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with confidence to work independently across organizational levels and to train and guide users on CRM best practices

* Experience leading cross-functional development projects and driving process improvements

* Excellent command of English, both written and spoken

We also appreciate

* Experience from a manufacturing company

* Experience from a fast-growing international organization

* Salesforce administration experience and relevant certifications

* Power BI or other business intelligence tool experience

Please apply as soon as possible on September 13, 2026 at the latest through our recruitment system at BLUEFORS.COM [http://BLUEFORS.COM]. We will review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

For more information, please contact Matilda Säde, Head of Sales Operations, matilda.sade@bluefors.com [matilda.sade@bluefors.com] . Matilda can also be reached at +358 40 7196 360 during the following times: Fri 28 Aug, 10:00-11:30 and Mon 31 Aug, 10:00-11:30.

title: Keikkalaiseksi Honkalammen asumispalveluihin (lähihoitaja, sosionomi, sairaanhoitaja)
description:
Etsitkö joustavaa ja elämääsi sopivaa tapaa tehdä merkityksellistä työtä? Haemme keikkalaisia **ohjaajan tehtäviin**Honkalampi-säätiön asumispalveluihin. Taustaltasi voit olla esimerkiksi lääkeluvallinen**lähihoitaja, sosionomi tai sairaanhoitaja.**

Honkalampi-säätiöllä tarjoamme ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista aikuisille, jotka tarvitsevat tukea arkeensa. Tuen tarpeen taustalla voi olla esimerkiksi kehitysvamma. Meillä on koteja **ympäri Pohjois-Karjalaa**: Ilomantsissa, Lieksassa, Polvijärvellä, Outokummussa, Liperissä, Kontiolahdella, Hammaslahdessa ja Joensuussa. Haemme keikkalaisia kaikkiin koteihimme, tällä hetkellä erityisesti **Lieksaan ja Polvijärvelle**.

Meillä arki rakentuu osallisuudesta, turvallisuudesta ja oikeudesta elää oman näköistä elämää. Huolehdimme turvallisesta ympäristöstä, jossa vuorovaikutus ja monipuoliset kommunikaation keinot ovat keskiössä. Haluamme, että kotimme on paikka, jossa jokainen tulee kuulluksi, ymmärretyksi ja kohdatuksi omana itsenään. Meillä koti on koti.

**Millaista työ on?**

Ohjaajana tuet ja mahdollistat asukkaidemme arkea heidän omien toiveidensa, tarpeidensa ja tavoitteidensa mukaisesti. Työhösi kuuluu hoitotyötä ja hyvinvoinnin tukemista sekä asukkaiden avustamista arjen askareissa, kuten kodinhoidossa, kaupassa käynnissä ja ulkoilussa.

Lisäksi suunnittelet ja toteutat yhdessä asukkaiden kanssa heidän toiveistaan lähtevää yhteistä toimintaa, joka voi olla esimerkiksi liikkumista, leivontaa, pelaamista, retkiä, digitaitojen harjoittelua tai ihan vain yhdessä olemista ja jutustelua.

Keikkalaisena toimit ohjaajan sijaisuuksissa tarpeen mukaan. Keikat voivat olla äkillisiä ja lyhyitä poissaolojen tuurauksia, mutta tarjoamme myös pidempiä sijaisuuksia ensisijaisesti keikkalaisillemme. Voit itse päättää, mitkä keikkapyynnöt hyväksyt.

**Millaista työkaveria etsimme?**

Etsimme kehitysvamma-alasta kiinnostuneita, ihmisläheisiä ja vastuullisia keikkalaisia. Työssä menestyminen edellyttää hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja työyhteisötaitoja sekä valmiutta ottaa vastaan sijaisuuksia myös lyhyellä varoitusajalla. Odotamme sinulta:

- Soveltuvaa sote-alan koulutusta (esim. lähihoitaja, sairaanhoitaja, sosionomi) tai vähintään 2/3 alan opinnoista suoritettuna

- lääkehoidon koulutusta ja voimassa olevia lääkelupia

- tartuntatautilain 48 § mukaista rokotesuojaa

- hygieniapassia ja elintarviketyötä tekevän terveydentilaselvitystä.


Valitun työntekijän tulee esittää voimassa oleva rikosrekisteriote ennen työsuhteen alkua.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- joustavan, elämääsi sopivan tavan tehdä töitä keikkalaisena

- Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n mukaisen tuntipalkan (kelpoisuusehdot täyttävän ohjaajan palkkaluokka G20C)

- huolellisen perehdytyksen keikkalaisen tehtäviin

- kokeneen ja helposti lähestyttävän esihenkilön ja työyhteisön tuen.


Pääset osaksi ainutlaatuisten asukkaidemme arkea, saat arvokasta kokemusta kehitysvamma-alalta ja ympärillesi ammattitaitoiset työkaverit - meillä et jää yksin.

**Näin haet meille töihin**

Täytä hakemuslomake nettisivuillamme: https://www.honkalampi.fi/avoin-hakemus/

Lisätietoja tehtävistä voit kysyä osoitteesta rekrytointi@hl-s.fi .

Voit tutustua asumispalveluiden arkeen Facebookissa: @Honkalampi Asumispalvelut tai Instagramissa: @honkalampiasumispalvelut .

_Honkalampi on yhteiskuntavastuullinen yritys, jonka tavoitteena on pykälää parempi maailma. Käytämme taloudelliset voittovaramme asiakkaidemme palveluiden kehittämiseen ja yhteiskunnallisten haasteiden ratkaisemiseen. Tutustu meihin lisää osoitteessa www.honkalampi.fi ._

_Honkalammen asumispalvelut on savuton työpaikka._

title: Senior Research Fellow (Information and knowledge management) / Yliopistotutkija (tietojohtaminen)
description:
Tampere University aims at scientific excellence and societal impact in research. Its focus areas are technology, health, and society. The university regards the competence of staff as its most important strategic asset and supports its development. For further information, please visit www.tuni.fi/en.

[The Unit of Information and Knowledge Management](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/information-and-knowledge-management) in the Faculty of Management and Business was established in 2001. The unit operates in the broad field of information and knowledge management, ranging from information technology and business to people, organisations and society.The unit currently has eight professors and approximately 45 staff members who conduct research, teach and create societal impact in many ways.

We are now seeking a new Senior Research Fellow to strengthen high-quality research and teaching, contribute to the acquisition of competitive research funding, and foster national and international research collaboration.

The units research activities are organized around three strategic focus areas that generate new knowledge and value, often through multidisciplinary research activities. The first focus area, knowledge-based management, includes classical knowledge management, intellectual capital, and business and data analytics, complemented by a perspective on data-driven decision-making. The second area, management of information systems, covers various topics related to information systems, from their management and use to their implementation, deployment and impacts, as well as details related to IT governance. The third area, management of digital business, addresses the digitalization of processes and services, the development and utilization of business models, the data economy, ecosystems, various business support platforms and platform technologies. Depending on the applicants profile, the open position may be located in any of these three focus areas.

Job description

A Senior Research Fellow in information and knowledge management conducts high-quality research and provides teaching in the field of information and knowledge management. The Senior Research Fellow conducts independent research on internationally and nationally relevant themes in information and knowledge management, plans research projects, actively participates in applying for research funding and leading projects, and contributes to other university activities, societal interaction in the field and international collaboration. The Senior Research Fellow will also supervise theses of degree students and participate in the supervision of doctoral students.

Requirements

- an applicable doctoral degree
- evidence of high-quality independent scientific research
- strong evidence of acquiring external research funding
- strong and versatile evidence of research collaboration
- evidence of high-level, high-quality research-based teaching and supervision in some of the above-mentioned three strategic focus areas of the unit of Information and knowledge management
- good command of English

University pedagogical studies and other pedagogical merits and experience will also be taken into account. Skills of Finnish language is considered as an advantage.

The selected person is expected to acquire external research funding to cover at least 35% of the salary costs related to the position.

The selection process may include different forms of interviews, aptitude assessments and teaching skills assessments.

We offer

The position is fixed-term and its duration is four years. A six-month trial period applies to all new employees at Tampere University. The starting date is negotiable and will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

The salary will be based on the [salary system for teaching and research staff at Finnish universities.](https://sivista.fi/in-english/general-collective-agreement-for-universities/) The preliminary requirement level for the University Researcher position is 6–7. In addition, a salary component based on personal performance will be paid. The starting salary (level 6) is approximately EUR 4,700-4,900 per month.

Read more about working at Tampere University: https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/work-with-us

How to apply

Please submit your application using the universitys electronic application form. The application period for the position ends on 17 September 2026 at 23.59 (EEST / UTC +3).

Please attach the following documents to your application in PDF format:

- Curriculum vitae in accordance with the template of the [Finnish National Board on Research Integrity (TENK)](https://tenk.fi/en/advice-and-materials/template-researchers-curriculum-vitae)
- List of publications in accordance with the guidelines of the [Research Council of Finland](https://www.aka.fi/en/research-funding/apply-for-funding/how-to-apply-for-funding/az-index-of-application-guidelines/list-of-publications/). Mark the five most important publications in the list and add links to them. If the publications cannot be accessed via links, include them as separate PDF files.
- Research plan (max. 5 pages)
- Teaching portfolio, for example in accordance with [Tampere Universitys guidelines](https://content-webapi.tuni.fi/proxy/public/2022-05/tau2020guideline20for20applicants20teaching20portfolio.pdf)
- An appendix in which you explain why you would be suitable for the position and how you would develop your own research and the teaching related to the position.

Further information of the position:

Information Systems Management focus area: Professor Henri Pirkkalainen

Digital Business Management focus area: Professor Hannu Kärkkäinen

Knowledge-Based Management focus area: University Lecturer Pasi Hellsten

Email addresses are in the format: firstname.lastname(at)tuni.fi

For questions concerning the recruitment process, please contact HR Specialist Ilona Pekuri, ilona.pekuri(at)tuni.fi.

title: Solution Engineer, Wave
description:
Cadmatic is a leading global developer of digital and intelligent 3D-based design, engineering, and information management solutions for the marine, process, and construction industries. Our journey started in the 1980s. Over the past decade, we have grown by 20 percent annually, and it's all about talent. We truly value our people – many stay with us for years, with an average tenure of 10 years. Today we have over 330 proactive, engaged, and growth-minded people in 20 countries around the world. Over 6000 customers are using our software solutions in 60 countries. In the marine industry, our technology supports around 40 percent of the worlds shipyards. We continue strong growth.

We are looking for a Solution Engineer to help marine industry customers get more value from their PLM solutions. In this role, you will configure, customize, and develop Cadmatic Wave to support customer-specific requirements and business processes.

You are based in Finland, Germany, or the Netherlands and can work remotely or in a hybrid model. The role includes regular visits to customer sites across Central Europe, giving you the opportunity to work closely with customers and support them in their day-to-day use of Cadmatic solutions.

What you will work on:

- Support technical deployment of Cadmatic Wave in customer environments.
- Develop customer-specific enhancements that extend system capabilities beyond the core product.
- Configure and customize Cadmatic Wave to align with customer workflows and business goals.
- Collaborate with clients and solution consultants to gather requirements and deliver solutions.
- Act as the technical point of contact, ensuring clear communication and trusted partnerships.
- Oversee system rollouts and data migrations, ensuring minimal disruption and data integrity.
- Provide valuable feedback to R&D based on customer insights and project experiences.

We wish you to bring:

- Bachelors or masters degree in IT, engineering, or a related field.
- Solid experience in PLM implementation, consulting, or software configuration.
- Experience in software customization, aligning solutions to client-specific needs.
- Knowledge in requirements engineering, creating requirement specifications and writing user stories.
- Proficiency in Python, SQL, and database management.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail.
- A customer-focused approach and an interest in solving practical business and technical challenges.
- Willingness to travel to customer sites when needed.

We are especially glad if you have:

- Hands-on experience with PLM solutions, CONTACT PLM seen as advantage.
- Know-how of industry business processes related to product/project
- Experience with API integrations, cloud-based PLM solutions, and data migration methodologies.
- Exposure to software deployment, integration methodologies, and custom application development.

Cadmatic as an employer:

- A stable, global company with a long history, strong future, and advanced software solutions.
- A friendly, supportive, and truly multicultural work environment where we succeed together.
- Autonomy, ownership, and trust: youre encouraged to do your best work and develop professionally.

title: Kotisiivooja Joensuu
description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden, kuten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi? Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii? Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."


Helpperinä saat:

- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana

- Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan.

- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.

- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!


Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

title: Cook / Chef
description:
**Chef / Cook – Japanese Restaurant in Helsinki**

We are looking for an experienced Chef/Cook to join our Japanese restaurant in Helsinki. The position requires extensive professional knowledge and practical experience in Japanese cuisine.

The main responsibilities include preparing ingredients, preparing and cooking Japanese dishes during restaurant service, maintaining consistent quality and presentation standards, and contributing to the development of new menu items. The employee will also be expected to provide guidance and instructions to other kitchen staff when necessary and may assist with general restaurant operations and restaurant-related events as required.

**Requirements**

- At least ten (10) years of professional experience as a chef/cook in specialized Japanese restaurants (Teishoku restaurant, Izakaya restaurant, etc.) other than sushi restaurants.

- Experience in a supervisory or senior kitchen role, including providing guidance and instructions to other chefs and kitchen staff

- Strong knowledge of Japanese ingredients, food preparation methods, cooking techniques, and culinary terminology

- Ability to prepare Japanese dishes consistently to professional standards

- Ability to contribute to menu development

- Ability to communicate effectively in Japanese in a professional kitchen environment, particularly regarding food preparation, cooking techniques, kitchen operations, and menu development

- **A Japanese Cooks License and/or a diploma or certificate from a culinary school in Japan is considered an advantage.**

- A valid Finnish Hygiene Passport, or the ability to obtain one as required

title: Kotisiivooja
description:
Kehäkukka siivouspalvelu Oy on Turun seudulla toimiva yksityinen siivousalan yritys, joka tarjoaa ammattitaitoista siivouspalvelua sekä muita kodinhoitopalveluita kotitalouksille. Tarjoamme palveluitamme Turussa ja sen ympäristö kunnissa ja tyypillisiä asiakkaitamme ovat ikäihmiset ja lapsiperheet.

Haemme joukkoomme reipasta ja luotettavaa asiakaspalveluhenkistä työntekijää, joka olisi joustava ja jolla olisi kyky itsenäiseen työskentelyyn. Yrityksemme tarjoaa perusteellisen perehdytyksen työtehtäviin, joten aikaisempi kokemus tai koulutus siivousalalta ei ole välttämätöntä. Kyseessä on kokoaikainen työ tammikuusta 2027 alkaen, osa-aikaisena sovitusti, mahdollisuus aloittaa jo aikaisemmin.

Työ on pääsääntöisesti asiakkaiden luona tapahtuvaa kotisiivousta ja ajoittuu arkisin klo 8-17 välille. Työn toimeenkuvaan kuuluu siivouksen lisäksi muun muassa ikkunoiden pesu. Kohteesta toiseen siirrytään omalla autolla. Työ tehdään useimmiten yksin, mutta ajoittain myös parityöskentelynä. Yrityksemme tarjoaa työhön tarvittavat siivousvälineet.

Kyseessä on vakituinen kokoaikatyö. Jos kiinostuit ja koet olevasi hakemamme henkilö, jätä vapaamuotoinen hakemus sähköpostiin maira.kukkula@gmail.com

title: IT Application Specialist
description:
Are you an experienced IT professional with a passion for reliable application services and continuous improvement? We are looking for an IT Application Specialist to support and develop business-critical applications in a manufacturing environment.

In this role, you will ensure safe, stable and efficient application services for the site(s) in scope and act as a trusted partner for business stakeholders. You will work closely with local business teams, OT, IT colleagues and external service providers to support daily operations and drive improvements through standardization, automation and development initiatives.

Your key responsibilities

Ensure safe and reliable application support in line with agreed service levels

Manage the lifecycle of software applications, including implementation, maintenance, upgrades and retirement

Support end-users, resolve incidents and maintain high-quality documentation and tickets in ITSM tools

Configure and customize applications to meet manufacturing business needs

Collaborate with IT, OT, vendors and business stakeholders to ensure smooth integrations and data flows

Support application testing, deployment and validation activities

Ensure applications comply with IT security policies and relevant regulations

Identify opportunities to improve processes and application functionality

Provide training and guidance to users on application features and best practices

What we are looking for

B.Sc. in Information Systems, IT or equivalent industry experience

Several years of experience in IT application support, preferably in a manufacturing environment

Experience with ERP and/or MES systems

Intermediate skills in server operating systems and cloud technologies

Intermediate skills in database administration, such as Oracle, MS SQL or MySQL

Basic programming skills are considered an advantage, for example Java, Python, C/C++, .NET, COBOL or Microsoft technologies

Good problem-solving skills and a quality-focused way of working

Strong collaboration and communication skills in Finnish and English, both written and spoken

If you enjoy working close to business operations and want to contribute to reliable, secure and continuously improving IT services, we would like to hear from you.

For more information about the position, please, contact our Service Manager – Christoph Scheib via Christop.Scheib(at)outokumpu.com, or for more information about the status of your application or help to apply: Talent Acquisition Partner – miikka.enbuske(at)Outokumpu.com

To apply, please submit your CV and a cover letter in English till the 20th of September 2026. The position might be filled before the final application date, thus, please do not hesitate to apply earlier!

The selected candidate will be required to pass a security clearance vetting and health check (including drug tests) before commencing employment

title: Project Engineer – Portuguese-speaking | Industrial Projects
description:
About the role

This is a hands-on project role where you will coordinate activities, follow up on purchases and deliveries, communicate with customers and suppliers, and make sure agreed actions progress according to schedule.

The assignment is initially six months, and we hope you can start as soon as possible.

Work tasks

You will work closely with an experienced international project organization and support a Project Manager responsible for several customer projects. The team has recently grown, creating a need for additional project engineering capacity.

A significant part of the role involves projects in Portuguese-speaking markets in South America, which makes fluent Portuguese essential. You will communicate directly with customers and help translate their needs into concrete actions within the project organization.

The projects are related primarily to large industrial engines, engine components and associated technical services. You do not need to be an engine specialist when you join, but you should be comfortable working with technical equipment and industrial projects.

The role combines project coordination, customer communication, procurement and technical understanding. Success requires an organised and proactive approach: when something needs to happen, you take ownership of following it through.

Your responsibilities may include:
- Coordinating international customer and delivery projects
- Communicating with Portuguese-speaking customers in South America
- Following project schedules, open actions and deliveries
- Ensuring agreed tasks progress and proactively following up with stakeholders
- Creating and following purchase orders and procurement activities
- Working with ERP systems, particularly SAP
- Coordinating suppliers and external service providers
- Supporting sourcing and procurement of services such as machining, lifting and specialist field services
- Investigating delivery issues and other project deviations
- Collaborating with Project Managers, procurement, logistics, technical experts, suppliers and customers
- Supporting customer meetings and project-related travel to South America

We are looking for

For this position, you must have:
- A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering
- Professional fluency in Portuguese
- Professional working proficiency in English
- Previous experience in project work where you have independently coordinated activities, followed schedules and ensured actions are completed
- Experience working with purchasing, purchase orders, deliveries or similar ERP-based processes
- Ability to understand technical equipment and communicate effectively in an industrial environment
- Willingness and ability to travel to South America when required
- Experience with SAP
- A valid driving licence

You do not need to speak Finnish.

We consider it a strong advantage if you have experience in one or more of the following areas:
- Marine, maritime or shipbuilding industry
- Engine technology or powertrain systems
- Industrial machinery or equipment
- Technical service or maintenance projects
- Procurement and supplier coordination
- Automation
- Customer-facing technical project roles

Your previous job title could for example be Project Engineer, Project Coordinator, Project Manager, Delivery Engineer, Service Engineer, Technical Project Engineer or Procurement Engineer. More important than the title is that you understand how technical projects work and are comfortable taking responsibility for keeping them on track.

As a person, we believe you are
- Proactive and comfortable taking ownership
- Organised and able to manage several ongoing topics simultaneously
- Confident communicating directly with customers
- Persistent in following up and getting things completed
- Comfortable working across different countries, cultures and functions
- Practical and solution-oriented when plans change

Practical information
- Salary: based on your background and experience about 3500 - 4500 € / month
- Start: As soon as possible
- Duration: 6 months
- Working hours: Full-time
- Location: Flexible within Finland. The role can be performed largely remotely, although occasional presence in Turku is required.
- Travel: The position includes occasional international business travel, primarly to South America.
- Languages: Portuguese and English
- Employment: Fixed-term employment through Academic Work, working as a consultant in our client organisation

About the client

Our client is a globally operating technology company providing advanced solutions and services for demanding marine and industrial environments. Its international project organisation works with customers around the world on large-scale technical equipment, lifecycle services and complex delivery projects.

You will join an experienced international organisation where you will work with technically interesting projects and gain exposure to global customers, suppliers and engineering professionals.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Solution Owner, Data Platforms
description:
Nokian Tyres is a Finnish company that as the first in the world invented the winter tire in 1934. We continue to drive innovation and develop our premium technology from Nokia, where we are rooted. Today, operating in over 60 countries across the world, we are looking for experienced professionals and future talents to join us.

We are looking for a Solution Owner, Data Platforms, to join our IT team.

As the Solution Owner, Data Platforms you will be responsible for the end-to-end ownership, strategy, and evolution of enterprise data platform solutions within the Global Platforms IT organization. The role drives the modernization of the data landscape from legacy solutions to modern cloud-based platforms, with strong emphasis on Snowflake and Microsoft Fabric enabled analytics and reporting.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, data owners, internal teams, and external partners. The Solution Owner ensures the platform evolves in a secure, scalable, and business-value -driven manner while enabling analytics, reporting, data governance, and future AI use cases through a trusted data foundation.

You will report to the Director, Global Platforms. The position can be based either in our Helsinki office or in our Nokia office.

Key responsibilities:

- Own the full lifecycle of the data platform solution, ensuring reliability, scalability, supportability, and continuous improvement.
- Define and maintain the platform roadmap aligned with business priorities, enterprise architecture principles, and IT strategy.
- Lead the transition from legacy data warehouse solutions to modern cloud-based data platforms.
- Ensure platform performance, governance, security, compliance, and cost efficiency.
- Act as the primary IT counterpart for business stakeholders, translating business needs into solution priorities, requirements, and scope.
- Enable trusted and reusable data assets that support analytics, reporting, automation, and future AI initiatives.
- Lead and facilitate the data governance forum together with business data owners and key stakeholders.
- Collaborate with internal development teams, architects, product owners, and external vendors to strengthen platform delivery and adoption.
- Drive continuous improvement and innovation across data platform capabilities and services.
- Monitor technology trends and recommend improvements that increase business value and operational efficiency.

What we expect from you:

- Proven experience in data platform, analytics, or solution ownership roles.
- Strong understanding of modern data platforms, including data warehouses, lakehouses, and data integration technologies.
- Experience with cloud-based data platforms and large-scale modernization initiatives.
- Experience with Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, or comparable modern analytics platforms.
- Understanding of data analytics, reporting, data automation, and data governance practices.
- Knowledge of security, compliance, and governance requirements related to enterprise data platforms.
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across business and IT organizations.
- Experience working with external vendors and service providers.
- Structured, proactive, and collaborative approach to problem solving and decision making.

Our way of working

Our talented people, energizing collaboration, and agile way of working ensure that we achieve great results together. We believe in involvement and active ownership. Nokian Tyres wants everyone to have both the power and the opportunity to influence matters, and we support your professional growth. We value different experiences and competencies. They play a key role in the development of the company as well as our new, innovative solutions.

Please note that prerequisite of the employment is that the selected employee has a valid residence and work permit in Finland.

Are you interested in joining our inspiring team?

Please fill in the application form, including your CV and salary request by 7th September 2026.

For further information, please contact: Pasi Tuutti, tel +358 10 4017755, e-mail pasi.tuutti@nokiantyres.com.

title: Mechanics Supervisor
description:

· Organize and oversee workshop activities, including planning and execution of inspections, repairs, and preventive maintenance.

· Identify and resolve technical issues, initiate and implement improvement actions and continuous improvement projects.

· Collaborate with other departments on downtime planning, implementation of new technical solutions, and process optimization.

· Develop and maintain a constant safety environment and provide necessary training updates while striving for zero incidents

**Our expectations:**

· Relevant technical education, preferably in mechanics or machine construction.

· Experience from industrial maintenance, mechanical systems, or equipment servicing within a manufacturing or production environment.

· Strong leadership, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

· Ability to communicate effectively in English

Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse experiences and perspectives!

**We offer:**

· challenging work in a fast-developing international company,

· opportunities for further professional development,

· competitive salary between 3800 - 4800€ (gross), based on education and professional experience, with a bonus according to the applicable bonus system.

If you find this position interesting - send your application by **6.9.2026.**

title: Japanese speaking Cabin Crew Member Helsinki Base, Finnair
description:
Finnair is a diverse community of professionals who work ambitiously with a big heart and commitment. A strong safety culture is our priority and at the core of our everyday work, never taking it for granted. We are committed to doing our share in solving the climate challenge by determinedly following our science-based pathway to decarbonize our operations. We find meaning in our purpose: With our heart in Finland, we make every journey better, today and tomorrow. Our values - Always Safe, Customer at Heart and Stronger Together - guide us in everything we do.

Finnair Cabin Crew recruitment for 2027 is now open! We are looking to strengthen our group of cabin crew employees with knowledge of Japanese language and culture to join our Helsinki base. This Japanese speaking group will be dedicated to serve our Japanese routes as well as European and domestic scheduled flights. Employment contracts will be full-time permanent. Are you ready to be part of the Finnair team where the sky isn't the limit? Join us as cabin crew member and discover a career that's always uplifting. Your journey to the skies starts here!

As a cabin crew member, you are responsible for ensuring cabin safety and delivering excellent customer service on Finnair flights. Being a part of Finnair cabin crew means that you provide the best possible experience and meaningful encounters for our customers.

What we are looking for and what we expect from you:

- Positive attitude and excellent customer service skills
- Excellent teamwork skills in a diverse environment
- Sales-oriented mindset and good communication skills
- Ability to work according to procedures and guidelines
- Resilience, persistence, and ability to adapt to changing situations

What is required to become a Cabin Crew Member at Finnair?

- Age of at least 18 years old
- Secondary education completed (upper secondary/vocational school)
- Fluency in Japanese and English, additional languages are an advantage
- Knowledge of Japanese culture
- Height minimum 160 cm and ability to reach 218 cm barefoot
- At least 1 year of experience in hospitality or customer service
- Good general health and the ability to work irregular hours and night shifts, including coping with stress related to circadian disruption. Minimum requirement EASA Part Med Cabin Crew and Finnair regulations.
- Normal colour vision and normal hearing, distant visual acuity using both eyes 0.7 or better (with or without corrective lenses)
- Ability to swim 40 meters
- When wearing a uniform, all visible tattoos must be fully covered, and all visible piercings must be removed (excl. earrings)
- Clean criminal record
- Valid Japanese or EU, EEA or Swiss passport allowing free worldwide travel
- Willing to live and work permanently in Finland and arrive to Helsinki Airport within one hour when on stand-by

Working at Finnair:

We offer you an exciting opportunity to work in the fast-changing aviation and international travel industry in a culture that drives and enables professional development and continuous improvement. You will be supported by internally highly rated supervisory work with modern leadership practices that we constantly develop.

We are happy to enable our employees to enrich their lives and fulfil their travel dreams by offering a wideleisuretravel benefit. We also support the health and wellbeing of our employees through our own Sickness Fund insurance benefit,Epassi(sport, culture, wellbeing or commuting benefit), gyms around the Finnair campus and activities organized by our hobby clubs.

Before employment, selected candidates will participate in a non-paid training course of 6-9 weeks. 100% on-site attendance at our training facilities in Vantaa is required. Successfully passed cabin crew training is a prerequisite for employment. Training is unpaid and begins gradually in the beginning of 2027.

Please note that the hiring process includes a pre-employment security clearance and a medical examination, including a drug test.

To make sure you have all the details you need about the recruitment process, training, health requirements and more, please take a moment to visit:https://www.barona.fi/tyopaikat/finnair-japan-avoimet-tyopaikat/

Fasten your seatbelt and apply now but no later than 6.9.2026 23:59 EET. Submit your application through the official application form, as we are unable to consider applications sent by email due to data protection reasons. The employment contract is made with Finnair, and Barona is the recruitment partner in the process. If you have any further questions, please contact finnair@barona.fi.

Our people are key to our success and the foundation that makes Finnair unique. We are committed to creating a safe work environment where all our people can thrive and succeed.We cherish diversity and strive to employ people with different backgrounds and experiences, to bring together multiple views to foster our business success.According to our employee survey, respecting diversity is at a high level in our work community. You are welcome to join Finnair as your authentic self.

You only need to fill in your profile once, and after that, you can apply to any Barona job using the same profile. Based on your work experience, educational background, and skills, well recommend jobs that suit you best. Barona Careers makes job searching easier than ever!

title: Santa Claus
description:
Job description – Santa Claus / Seasonal Freelance Performer

We are looking for authentic, warm-hearted and professional Santa Claus performers to join us for the winter season in Rovaniemi, Finnish Lapland.

This is not an ordinary job where you simply put on a costume and repeat the same performance all day. As a Santa, you will meet people from all over the world and become part of some of their most memorable moments.

Your main responsibility is to create genuine, warm and unforgettable encounters as Santa Claus. Depending on the assignment, your work may include private Santa visits, meetings with families and children, visits to hotels and accommodation properties, Christmas programmes and other Santa-related experiences in the Rovaniemi area.

No two encounters are exactly the same. You may meet excited children, shy children, adults who are experiencing Lapland for the first time, families celebrating a special occasion or guests who simply want to meet the real Santa from the Arctic Circle. Because of this, the ability to read different situations, listen to people and react naturally is an essential part of the work.

We are not looking for someone who simply performs a memorised script.

We are looking for people who understand that even a short meeting can become a lifelong memory.

What we are looking for

You may be a good fit for this role if you:

- Meet people genuinely, respectfully and warmly.

- Enjoy working with people of different ages, backgrounds and cultures.

- Know how to listen and make people feel comfortable.

- Can read changing situations and adapt your approach naturally.

- Are able to create a believable and authentic Santa Claus character.

- Have a natural sense of humour and are comfortable interacting spontaneously with guests.

- Are reliable, punctual and able to work independently.

- Are willing to continuously learn and develop your skills.

- Understand that teamwork and communication are important parts of creating a high-quality guest experience.

- Take pride in your appearance, behaviour and professionalism.

- Want to help create unforgettable moments rather than simply complete a task.


Previous experience as Santa Claus, an actor, performer, tour guide, host or in customer service is beneficial, but the right personality, attitude and willingness to learn are equally important.

The work is highly international, and good spoken English is required. Other language skills are considered an advantage.

The work

The work is seasonal and assignments may vary in duration, location and content. Working hours are flexible and depend on bookings and customer demand. The busiest period is during the Christmas and winter season.

The work requires the ability to move independently between different assignments in the Rovaniemi area. A driving licence and access to transportation may therefore be an advantage, depending on the assignments.

You will receive guidance and support for the role, but we also expect you to take responsibility for your own professionalism and preparation.

Important: freelance and assignment-based work

This position is not a traditional employment relationship.

The selected Santa Claus performers work independently and invoice for the assignments they complete. The work can therefore be carried out, for example, as:

- a freelancer or self-employed person

- a light entrepreneur using an invoicing service

- through your own business


**Compensation is agreed in advance for each assignment. There is no fixed monthly salary, and earnings depend on the number and type of assignments completed.**

More detailed information about the assignments, compensation and practical arrangements will be discussed with suitable applicants.

What matters most to us

We value who you are more than what your CV looks like.

We are looking for people who bring authenticity, reliability, professionalism and a genuine desire to create meaningful encounters.

You do not need to be a finished product.

You need to be someone who wants to learn, develop and become even better.

If you recognise yourself in this description, we would love to hear from you.

**If you think you might be the right person, let's talk.**

title: Keittiön Vuoromestari / Sous Chef, Scandic Simonkenttä & Scandic Helsinki Station
description:
Meillä on paikka sinulle, keittiön vuoromestari!

Haemme keittiön vuoromestaria yhteiseen tiimiimme Scandic Simonkenttään ja Scandic Helsinki Stationiin. Työsuhde on toistaiseksi voimassa olevan ja työtunteja on tarjolla osaamisesi ja toiveidesi mukaan 90-112,5 h / 3 viikkoa. Tässä tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisessa ympäristössä kahdessa vilkkaassa hotellissa, joissa ravintolatoiminta rakentuu sekä laadukkaan à la carte -tarjooman että kokous- ja juhlapalveluiden ympärille. Painotamme erityisesti vahvaa à la carte -osaamista, mutta vastuullasi ovat myös C&B keittiötoiminnot. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan, mutta toivomme, että voit aloittaa mahdollisimman pian.



Työtehtäväsi keittiön vuoromestarina

Keittiön vuoromestarina vastaat vuorosi sujuvuudesta, laadukkaasta ruokatuotannosta sekä tiimin onnistumisesta arjen kiireissä. Olet aktiivisesti mukana päivittäisessä tuotannossa ja johdat tiimiäsi omalla esimerkilläsi.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa:

- Vuoron operatiivinen johtaminen ja keittiön päivittäisen toiminnan organisointi
- À la carte -toiminnan laadusta, tehokkuudesta ja asiakaskokemuksesta huolehtiminen
- Kokous- ja juhlapalveluiden ruokatuotannon toteuttaminen yhdessä tiimin kanssa
- Tiimin ohjaaminen, perehdyttäminen ja valmentaminen
- Scandicin ruokakonseptien, hygieniavaatimusten ja turvallisuusohjeiden noudattamisen varmistaminen
- Tuotannon suunnittelu, hävikin hallinta ja laadun jatkuva kehittäminen
- Tiimin rohkaiseminen myynnilliseen ajatteluun yhteistyössä ravintolan kanssa, jotta vieraille syntyy entistä parempia elämyksiä



Tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja vastuullisen roolin kahdessa kiinnostavassa hotellissa, joissa yksikään päivä ei ole täysin samanlainen. Pääset työskentelemään ammattitaitoisten kollegoiden kanssa ympäristössä, jossa laadukas ruoka, yhteistyö ja vieraskokemus ovat kaiken keskiössä.

Saat käyttöösi myös Scandicin kattavat henkilöstöedut jo kuukauden työsuhteen jälkeen. Etuihin kuuluvat muun muassa ravintoloiden ruoka- ja juoma-alennukset, hotellien majoitusedut, ePassi-edut, työterveyshuolto sekä useiden yhteistyökumppaneidemme tarjoamat edut. Lisäksi tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia kouluttautua ja kehittää osaamistasi osana kansainvälistä hotelliketjua.



Odotamme sinulta

- Vankkaa kokemusta keittiötyöstä, erityisesti à la carte -toiminnasta
- Kokemusta tai valmiutta vuorovastuuseen ja muiden ohjaamiseen
- Osaamista myös kokous- ja juhlapalveluiden ruokatuotannosta
- Hyviä organisointi- ja priorisointitaitoja sekä kykyä toimia kiireessä
- Hygieniapassia
- Hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja
- Sujuvaa suomen ja/tai englannin kielen taitoa
- Myynnillistä ajattelutapaa sekä halua kehittää toimintaa yhdessä tiimin kanssa
- Rohkeutta tarttua uusiin ideoihin ja innostaa myös muita tavoittelemaan entistä parempia tuloksia

Kiinnostuitko? Hienoa! Jätä hakemuksesi verkkosivujemme kautta painamalla Olen kiinnostunut -painiketta. Huomioithan, että hakemuksia ei vastaanoteta sähköpostitse.

Tarvitsetko apua hakemuksen tekemiseen? Katso vinkkimme täältä: Näin rekrytoimme



Toivotamme kaikenlaiset ihmiset tervetulleeksi Scandic-hotelliin!



We have a position for you, Sous Chef!

We are looking for a Sous Chef to join our shared team at Scandic Simonkenttä and Scandic Helsinki Station. We offer a permanent position with working hours ranging from 90-112.5 hours per 3 weeks, depending on your skills and preferences. In this role, you will work in a diverse environment across two busy hotels, where the restaurant operations are built around both a high-quality à la carte offering and conference and banquet services. We place particular emphasis on strong à la carte expertise, but you will also be responsible for C&B kitchen operations. The position starts according to agreement, but we hope you can begin as soon as possible.



Your responsibilities as a Sous Chef

As a Sous Chef, you are responsible for ensuring the smooth flow of your shift, high-quality food production, and the success of your team during busy day-to-day operations. You actively participate in daily production and lead your team by example. Your responsibilities include:
- Operational leadership of the shift and organizing the daily activities of the kitchen - Ensuring the quality, efficiency, and guest experience of the à la carte operation - Delivering food production for conference and banquet services together with the team - Guiding, onboarding, and coaching team members - Ensuring compliance with Scandic food concepts, hygiene requirements, and safety guidelines - Production planning, waste management, and continuous quality improvement - Encouraging a sales-oriented mindset within the team in cooperation with the restaurant to create even better guest experiences
We offer you

We offer you a varied and responsible role in two exciting hotels where no two days are exactly alike. You will work alongside skilled colleagues in an environment where quality food, teamwork, and guest experience are at the heart of everything we do. You will also gain access to Scandic's extensive employee benefits. These include restaurant food and beverage discounts, hotel accommodation benefits, ePassi benefits, occupational healthcare, and a wide range of offers from our partner companies. In addition, we provide opportunities for training and professional development as part of an international hotel group.

We expect from you
- Solid experience in kitchen work, especially in à la carte operations - Experience in, or readiness to take on, shift responsibility and guide others - Knowledge of food production for conference and banquet services - Strong organizational and prioritization skills, and the ability to perform well under pressure - A valid Hygiene Passport - Strong teamwork and communication skills - Fluent Finnish and/or English language skills - A sales-oriented mindset and a desire to develop operations together with the team - The courage to embrace new ideas and inspire others to achieve even better results
Interested? Great! Submit your application through our website by clicking the "Olen kiinnostunut" button. Please note that applications are not accepted via email.

Need help with your application? Check out our tips here: scandichotels.com/fi/ura/nain-rekrytoimme

title: Lähihoitaja
description:
**Etsimme alihankintakumppania kotihoitoon**

Haluatko yrityksesi kanssa aidosti vaikuttaa ihmisten hyvinvointiin ja tehdä jokaisesta työpäivästä merkityksellisen? Tule mukaan kotihoitoon osaksi lämminhenkistä ja ammattitaitoista verkostoamme, jossa arvostetaan osaamistasi, itsenäistä työotettasi ja halua kohdata ihmiset yksilöinä.

**Tehtävä**

Alihankintana toteutettavassa kotihoidon lähihoitajan työssä tuet asiakkaidemme turvallista ja hyvää arkea heidän omissa kodeissaan. Työ on monipuolista, vastuullista ja vaihtelevaa, eikä yksikään päivä ole samanlainen. Tehtäviin kuuluvat muun muassa:

- asiakkaiden kokonaisvaltainen hoito ja päivittäisissä toiminnoissa avustaminen

- lääkehoidon toteuttaminen ja voinnin seuranta

- toimintakyvyn ylläpitäminen ja kuntouttavan työotteen hyödyntäminen

- asiakkaiden, omaisten ja moniammatillisen tiimin kanssa tehtävä yhteistyö

- hoidon suunnittelu, arviointi ja kirjaaminen


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Toivomme, että olet lähihoitaja tai edustat lähihoitajan pätevyyden omaavaa yritystä, jolla on aito halu kohdata ihmiset arvostavasti ja tarjota laadukasta hoitoa. Toimit vastuullisesti ja oma-aloitteisesti sekä työskentelet luontevasti itsenäisesti. Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot, positiivinen asenne ja joustavuus auttavat sinua onnistumaan yhteistyössä kanssamme. Edellytämme voimassa olevaa Y-tunnusta ja tarvittavia vakuutuksia.

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden käyttää ammattitaitoasi monipuolisesti ja kehittyä jatkuvasti yhteistyössä kanssamme. Et jää yksin, sillä tukenasi on osaava ja välittävä verkosto. Meiltä saat:

- merkityksellisen toimeksiannon asiakkaiden hyvinvoinnin edistämiseksi

- kattavan perehdytyksen ja tuen yhteistyön alkuun

- monipuoliset ja vaihtelevat toimeksiannot

- mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi

- kannustavan, avoimen ja arvostavan yhteistyöilmapiirin

- mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa omaan työhösi ja hyödyntää vahvuuksiasi


Jos haluat tehdä yhteistyötä, jossa kohtaamisilla on merkitystä ja jokainen toimeksianto tarjoaa mahdollisuuden auttaa, kuulemme sinusta mielellämme. Tule mukaan rakentamaan turvallista ja laadukasta kotihoitoa. Yhdessä teemme asiakkaidemme arjesta parempaa.

title: Cabin Crew Member Helsinki Base, Finnair
description:
Finnair is a diverse community of professionals who work ambitiously with a big heart and commitment. A strong safety culture is our priority and at the core of our everyday work, never taking it for granted. We are committed to doing our share in solving the climate challenge by determinedly following our science-based pathway to decarbonize our operations. We find meaning in our purpose: With our heart in Finland, we make every journey better, today and tomorrow. Our values - Always Safe, Customer at Heart and Stronger Together - guide us in everything we do.

Finnair Cabin Crew recruitment for 2027 is now open! Are you ready to be part of the Finnair team where the sky isn't the limit? We offer both permanent and fixed-term full-time employment opportunities. Join us as cabin crew member and discover a career that's always uplifting. Your journey to the skies starts here!

As a cabin crew member, you are responsible for ensuring cabin safety and delivering excellent customer service on Finnair flights. Being a part of Finnair cabin crew means that you provide the best possible experience and meaningful encounters for our customers.

What we are looking for and what we expect from you:

- Positive attitude and excellent customer service skills
- Excellent teamwork skills in a diverse environment
- Sales-oriented mindset and good communication skills
- Ability to work according to procedures and guidelines
- Resilience, persistence, and ability to adapt to changing situations

What is required to become a Cabin Crew Member at Finnair?

- Age of at least 18 years old
- Secondary education completed (upper secondary/vocational school)
- Fluency in English
- Fluency in Finnish is highly valued (additional languages are an advantage)
- Height minimum 160 cm and ability to reach 218 cm barefoot
- At least 1 year of experience in hospitality or customer service
- Good general health and the ability to work irregular hours and night shifts, including coping with stress related to circadian disruption. Minimum requirement EASA Part Med Cabin Crew and Finnair regulations.
- Normal colour vision and normal hearing, distant visual acuity using both eyes 0.7 or better (with or without corrective lenses)
- Ability to swim 40 meters
- When wearing a uniform, all visible tattoos must be fully covered, and all visible piercings must be removed (excl. earrings)
- Clean criminal record
- Valid EU, EEA or Swiss passport allowing free worldwide travel
- Eligible to live and work permanently in Finland and arrive to Helsinki Airport within one hour when on stand-by

Working at Finnair:

We offer you an exciting opportunity to work in the fast-changing aviation and international travel industry in a culture that drives and enables professional development and continuous improvement. You will be supported by internally highly rated supervisory work with modern leadership practices that we constantly develop.

We are happy to enable our employees to enrich their lives and fulfil their travel dreams by offering a wideleisuretravel benefit. We also support the health and wellbeing of our employees through our own Sickness Fund insurance benefit,Epassi(sport, culture, wellbeing or commuting benefit), gyms around the Finnair campus and activities organized by our hobby clubs.

Before employment, selected candidates will participate in a non-paid training course of 6-9 weeks. 100% on-site attendance at our training facilities in Vantaa is required. Successfully passed cabin crew training is a prerequisite for employment. Training is unpaid and begins gradually in the beginning of 2027.

Please note that the hiring process includes a pre-employment security clearance and a medical examination, including a drug test.

To make sure you have all the details you need about the recruitment process, training, health requirements and more, please take a moment to visit: https://www.barona.fi/tyopaikat/finnair/

Fasten your seatbelt and apply now but no later than 6.9.2026 23:59 EET. Submit your application through the official application form, as we are unable to consider applications sent by email due to data protection reasons. The employment contract is made with Finnair, and Barona is the recruitment partner in the process. If you have any further questions, please contact finnair@barona.fi.

Our people are key to our success and the foundation that makes Finnair unique. We are committed to creating a safe work environment where all our people can thrive and succeed.We cherish diversity and strive to employ people with different backgrounds and experiences, to bring together multiple views to foster our business success.According to our employee survey, respecting diversity is at a high level in our work community. You are welcome to join Finnair as your authentic self.

To apply for open positions, youll need to create a job seeker profile in Barona Careers. You only need to fill in your profile once, and after that, you can apply to any Barona job using the same profile. Based on your work experience, educational background, and skills, well recommend jobs that suit you best. Barona Careers makes job searching easier than ever!

title: CSRD Reporting Expert, (Project Manager)
description:
Tokmannin halvat hinnat tuottavat iloa ja hyötyä, sekä helpottavat asiakkaan elämää. Työskentelemme yhdessä tämän tavoitteen puolesta ja tarjoamme asiakkaillemme halvan hinnan lisäksi myös sujuvan ja nopean asioinnin myymälöissämme sekä laajan ja vastuullisesti hankitun ja tuotetun tuotevalikoiman. Tokmanni Group Oyj on yksi Pohjoismaiden johtavista halpakauppakonserneista. Onnistuneen asiakaskokemuksen takaamiseksi työskentelemme yli 6000 työntekijän voimin yhteensä yli 370:ssä Tokmanni-, Dollarstore-, Bigdollar-, Miny-, Click Shoes- ja Shoe House -myymälässämme sekä verkkokaupoissamme. Vuonna 2023 Tokmanni-konsernin liikevaihto oli 1 392,7 miljoonaa euroa ja vertailukelpoinen liikevoitto 98,8 miljoonaa euroa. Tokmanni Group Oyj:n osakkeet on listattu Nasdaq Helsingin pörssilistalle. Meille tokmannilaisille on tärkeää, että toimimme vastuullisesti ja tehokkaasti ympäristöstä ja ihmisistä välittäen. Kannustamme sekä autamme henkilöstöämme kehittämään osaamistaan ja panostamme hyvään yhteishenkeen. Avaamme jatkuvasti uusia myymälöitä ja rekrytoimme uusia osaajia. Etsimme joukkoomme erilaisilla osaamistaustoilla varustettuja henkilöitä monenlaisiin työtehtäviin. www.tokmanni.fi https://tyopaikat.tokmanni.fi/

Would you like to play a key role in shaping and delivering sustainability reporting in a leading Nordic retail group? We are looking for an experienced CSRD Reporting Expert to lead our CSRD reporting and reporting development projects. Position is in Tokmanni Group's Sustainability team and for a one-year parental leave replacement.

In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating and delivering Tokmanni Group's CSRD reporting and supporting the continuous development of reporting processes and practices. The position plays a key role in ensuring high-quality sustainability disclosures and compliance with evolving reporting requirements.

While the title includes project management responsibilities, we are primarily looking for a hands-on sustainability reporting professional. You have personally worked on CSRD reporting, collected and validated sustainability data, interpreted reporting requirements, and written report content. We are primarily looking for candidates who have hands-on experience preparing CSRD reports for listed companies, either in-house or in a consulting role. Success in this role requires both project leadership skills in cross company network and extensive hands-on experience in sustainability reporting, combined with deep practical expertise in the European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS) and their application in corporate reporting.



Your key responsibilities

- Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of Tokmanni Group's CSRD reporting process
- Collect, analyze, validate, and manage sustainability-related data across the organization
- Prepare and develop sustainability report content in line with ESRS requirements
- Interpret sustainability reporting regulations and translate regulatory requirements into practical reporting actions
- Support the update and further development of the Group's Double Materiality Assessment
- Develop reporting processes, data management practices, and reporting tools
- Produce and review reporting materials in both Finnish and English
- Coordinate and review translations between Finnish and English to ensure consistency and quality
- Work closely with stakeholders across sustainability, finance, HR, procurement, legal, marketing, business operations, and external assurance providers.



What we expect from you

- Hands-on experience preparing CSRD reporting in a listed company or as a consultant supporting listed companies
- Proven track record in sustainability data collection, data management and drafting CSRD-compliant sustainability report content
- Deep and comprehensive expertise in the ESRS standards and demonstrated ability to apply them in practice within CSRD reporting
- Strong understanding of the sustainability reporting regulatory landscape and reporting frameworks
- Excellent written communication skills and experience drafting reporting content
- Fluency in both Finnish and English, with the ability to translate and adapt content between the two languages. Proficiency in Swedish is considered an asset.
- Strong analytical skills and exceptional attention to detail
- A structured, self-driven, and solution-oriented way of working
- Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to drive progress without formal authority. - Ability to start working as soon as possible.

We also value experience in double materiality assessments, reporting system development, and knowledge of the retail or consumer goods industry.



What we offer

We offer you a unique opportunity to work at the heart of sustainability reporting in one of Finland's leading retail groups. You will have a visible and impactful role, working with a broad range of stakeholders and contributing to the development of Tokmanni Group's sustainability reporting and reporting capabilities.

You will join a friendly and supportive team where collaboration is valued and success is achieved together. We offer a flexible hybrid working model that combines office and remote working, enabling both effective teamwork and focused individual work.

In addition, we provide a competitive package of employee benefits, including ePassi, staff discounts, and a wide range of partner benefits.



Application instructions and further information

The position is a fixed-term parental leave replacement for one year. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found. The weekly working hours are 37.5 h/week. The primary workplace is Tokmanni Group's Head Office in Mäntsälä, Finland, and the role follows the Group's hybrid working model. Occasional travel within the Group may be required.

Please submit your application, CV, and salary expectation as soon as possible or at the latest on August 28th. We will review applications during the application period and fill the position immediately once the right candidate is found.

Further information will be given by Kaisa Matsson, Group Head of Sustainability tel. 040 6734948 or by email kaisa.mattson@tokmanni.fi. Please call on Wednesday Aug 19th 9-12 and Friday Aug 21st 10-13.

title: Technicien / Technicienne d'intervention en froid et climatisatio (H/F)
description:

En entreprise, vous participerez progressivement aux missions suivantes :

- Conseil auprès des clients sur l'utilisation et la maintenance de leurs équipements

Vous avez des connaissances de base dans la manipulation des fluides frigorigènes et en sécurité;
Vous faites preuve de rigueur, d'autonomie et d'une habileté manuelle;
Vous avez un bon relationnel, le sens du service client et l'esprit d'équipe;

Vous bénéficierez durant votre période d'apprentissage:
- Un encadrement personnalisé par une équipe expérimentée
- Des missions concrètes sur le terrain, sur toute l'île
- Des perspectives d'évolution ou d'embauche à l'issue de la formation
- Une entreprise à taille humaine, bienveillante et dynamique

title: Chargé / Chargée d'études espaces et milieux naturels
description:

Les missions principales :
Analyse et préparation des consultations

Identifier les exigences administratives, techniques et contractuelles.
Élaborer les fiches de synthèse des consultations.
Vérifier la cohérence des pièces de marché.
Participer aux réunions de lancement des dossiers.
Réalisation des études techniques
Effectuer ou contrôler les métrés nécessaires à l'étude.
Préparer les prémontages techniques des dossiers.
Recueillir les informations techniques auprès des responsables opérationnels.
Centraliser les données nécessaires aux chiffrages réalisés par les responsables concernés.
Participer à la préparation des DQE, BPU et autres documents techniques.
Rédaction des dossiers de réponse
Rédiger les mémoires techniques et mettre en forme les pièces techniques.
Adapter les trames aux spécificités de chaque consultation.
Élaborer les plannings prévisionnels et diagrammes de Gantt.
Vérifier la cohérence des documents avant transmission.
Coordination et suivi des consultations
Organiser les visites de site.
Assurer le suivi des demandes de renseignements.
Relancer les différents contributeurs afin de garantir le respect des délais.

Veiller au respect du planning de production des offres et assurer le suivi des consultations

Participer à la mise en forme visuelle des dossiers de candidature et d'offres.

title: Frigoriste (H/F)
description:
Vous ferez toutes les tâches en lien avec cette activité : Mise en service de chambres froides, diagnostic, réparations et conseils.
Transport assuré par l'entreprise depuis le siège.

- Corriger un dysfonctionnement
- Démarrer l'installation, ajuster les réglages (paramètres de fonctionnement, de régulation, températures, pressions, ...)

title: Collaborateur / Collaboratrice d'expertise comptable (H/F)
description:
Description du poste:

    Missions:
  Il accompagne le client dans la gestion de son entreprise
Sous la supervision d'un chef de mission et/ou de l'expert-comptable, il assure en autonomie la gestion de son portefeuille client en gérant
la production des dossiers d'expertise comptable
En relation avec les clients, il apporte un premier niveau de conseil et est chargé de faire remonter à l'expert-comptable toute difficulté rencontrée, toute
information portée à sa connaissance ou toute demande du client.
Il porte les valeurs et les engagements du cabinet auprès de l'ensemble de ses interlocuteurs.

    CE QUE LE POSTE NECESSITE :

o Connaissances approfondies en comptabilité

o Connaissance du logiciel comptable

o Connaissances informatiques : logiciel clients, logiciel prise en
main à distance

o Rendre compte

    TRAVAILLER CHEZ NOUS CA VEUT DIRE QUOI ?:
    
      S'inscrir et partager les valeur de l'entreprise à travers nos 5 valeurs :

> L'éthique
> L'innovation
> L'expertise

    LE PROCESS DE RECRUTEMENT:

title: Chef comptable (H/F)
description:
Description du poste:

    Missions:
  Nous recherchons un-e Chef.fe de Mission Senior Expertise Comptable pour renforcer son équipe parisienne.
Vous intervenez sur un portefeuille diversifié composé notamment d'entreprises du secteur audiovisuel, de groupes industriels, de family offices et de professions libérales. Véritable référent-e technique, vous accompagnez les équipes tout en développant une relation de proximité avec les clients.
Ce poste offre une forte autonomie, un positionnement stratégique auprès des clients et la possibilité de contribuer activement à l'amélioration continue des pratiques et des outils du cabinet.
Vos principales missions
- Piloter en autonomie un portefeuille clients et assurer un accompagnement personnalisé.
- Développer et fidéliser les relations clients.
- Superviser les travaux comptables et fiscaux réalisés par les équipes.
- Réviser les dossiers préparés par les collaborateur-rice-s.
- Garantir la qualité et la conformité des productions.
- Encadrer et accompagner les collaborateur-rice-s dans leur développement professionnel.
- Organiser et coordonner la planification des missions.
- Participer à l'optimisation des outils et des processus internes.
- Intervenir en tant que référent-e technique sur les problématiques comptables et fiscales.
- Réaliser et superviser l'établissement de comptes consolidés pour certains groupes.
Ce que nous vous proposons
- Un poste à responsabilités avec un fort niveau d'autonomie.
- Des missions variées à forte valeur ajoutée.
- Une relation directe avec les dirigeant-e-s et décideur-euse-s de vos clients.
- Des problématiques techniques stimulantes, notamment en consolidation.
- Un environnement favorisant le partage d'expertise et la montée en compétences.
- Une structure à taille humaine bénéficiant de la dynamique d'un groupe reconnu.
Outils utilisés : Sage, Regate, Ingeneo, Dia Client
Avantages sociaux
- Contrat CDI, statut Cadre.
- Temps de travail : 39 heures hebdomadaires.
- Tickets restaurant de 11,50 € avec prise en charge employeur à 60 %.
- Mutuelle avec prise en charge employeur à 75 %.
- Télétravail possible selon les accords en vigueur dans l'entreprise.


    CE QUE LE POSTE NECESSITE :
      
    Formation
- Diplôme supérieur en comptabilité de type DSCG ou équivalent.
- Les profils en cours de stage d'expertise comptable (DEC) sont également étudiés.
Expérience et savoir-faire
- Minimum 8 années d'expérience en expertise comptable, alternance comprise.
- Expérience confirmée en supervision de dossiers et relation clientèle.
- Première expérience significative en management d'équipes.
- Solides connaissances comptables et fiscales.
- Une connaissance de Sage constitue un atout.
- Une expérience en consolidation serait appréciée.
Savoir-être
Nous recherchons une personne :
- Rigoureuse et soucieuse de la qualité du travail rendu.
- Autonome et capable de prendre des initiatives.
- À l'aise sur les sujets techniques et dotée d'une forte capacité d'analyse.
- Curieuse et désireuse d'approfondir ses connaissances.
- Orientée satisfaction client.
- Collaborative dans sa manière de travailler.
- Attachée à transmettre ses connaissances et à accompagner le développement des équipes.

title: Collaborateur / Collaboratrice d'expertise comptable (H/F)
description:
Description du poste:

    Missions:
  Le Cabinet ACC : Plus que de la comptabilité

Acteur reconnu de l'expertise comptable dans l'Est Varois (7 bureaux, 6 associés), nous cultivons une vision moderne de notre métier : produire de la donnée UTILE, pour un conseil JUSTE, au profit de nos CLIENTS.
Nous accompagnons nos partenaires sur l'ensemble de leurs besoins (comptabilité, fiscalité, social, juridique, commissariat aux comptes et domiciliation). Notre succès repose sur un équilibre unique : l'alliance entre expérience et innovation. C'est pourquoi nos équipes mixent l'énergie des jeunes talents et l'expertise de profils aguerris).


Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Collaborateur(trice) comptable pour notre bureau de Brignoles.

Vous cherchez à rejoindre un cabinet attentif à vos attentes et à vos besoins ?

Alors rejoignez notre équipe de Brignoles en tant que collaborateur(trice) comptable confirmé(e) et assurer la gestion complète des dossiers clients sous la supervision de votre chef de mission !

Vos 3 missions principales seront les suivantes :
- Enregistrement des pièces comptables, des déclarations fiscales, des bilans et des documents intermédiaires ou prévisionnels,
- Prise en charge des aspects fiscaux (IR,IFI) et sociaux (TNS)
- Etablissement des bilans et liasses fiscales, sou la supervision de votre chef de mission.

La gestion sociale liée aux salariés est prise en charge par notre service social interne. Le juridique quant à lui est géré par notre service juridique.

    CE QUE LE POSTE NECESSITE :
      
    Vous êtes rigoureux et investi ! Avec un bon contact client. Les challenges ne vous font pas peur, et vous souhaitez vous investir dans une entreprise en mouvement constant. Fort de vos expériences et de vos compétences (5 ans minimum), vous avez brillamment passé plusieurs périodes fiscales et avez pris en autonomie la gestion d'un portefeuille client.
Si vous vous reconnaissez dans cette description c'est que vous êtes sans doute le candidat idéal!

    TRAVAILLER CHEZ NOUS CA VEUT DIRE QUOI ?:
    
      - Rémunération attractive: en fonction du profil et/ou de l'expérience et prime de participation
- Équilibre : Un contrat de 35h, en modulation à partir de janvier N+1 (période haute/période creuse)
- Évolution : Une structure qui encourage la montée en compétences et la spécialisation
- Santé: mutuelle/prévoyance
- CSE d'entreprise : carte Swipe, Cadeaux de Noël du CSE, Réduction Leeto
- Egalité femmes/hommes : une entreprise attachée à la diversité.
- Évènements : Journée détente et Soirée de fin d'année, des rendez-vous annuels pour partager des moments de convivialité

    LES PERSPECTIVES:
      
    Votre évolution, notre priorité

Au sein du cabinet ACC, nous ne proposons pas seulement un poste, mais une carrière. Nous vous offrons les moyens d'atteindre vos objectifs, que vous visiez :
- Une spécialisation technique pointue.
- Une évolution vers des rôles de gestion ou de management.
- Le renforcement de vos compétences à votre propre rythme

    LE PROCESS DE RECRUTEMENT:

    1. Échange téléphonique de découverte avec Sandra, notre assistante du bureau de Roquebrune.
2. Entretien au cabinet avec un associé et si possible, un membre de l'équipe.

Puis nous vous faisons une proposition par téléphone, et une promesse d'embauche dès votre accord.

Rejoignez un cabinet qui valorise votre expertise. Postulez dès maintenant ! :)

title: INSTRUMENTISTE (H/F)
description:
Nous recherchons pour le compte de notre client un INSTRUMENTISTE F/H.Sous la responsabilité du préparateur électricité-instrumentation, vous implantez ou vous remplacez des éléments sur des installations industrielles dans l'Energie.

affaires, de lire des plans techniques, d'identifier des modalités d'intervention, de diagnostiquer un élément défaillant, d'installer un équipement électronique, de réparer l'installation par le remplacement et la remise en état des dispositifs électriques,
électroniques, mécaniques, pneumatiques, hydrauliques.
