title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

Deep game engine expertise across runtime systems, rendering or graphics, and developer tooling.

title: Associate Development Director and Advisor
description:
About Contradictum Advisory ehf.

Contradictum Advisory ehf. is a startup dedicated to advising international intellectual property holders in the management and licensing their assets with the objective to steer part of that revenue stream into underfunded projects in Iceland.  Particular emphasis is placed on projects that both serve an immediate domestic need in Iceland and that would meet eligibility requirements under the European Union Green Bond Standard and qualify for the Nordic Swan ecolabel.
Associate Development Director and Advisor.

This is a client-facing position comprised of two primary areas of competence.  The first is in providing advisory and consulting services to intellectual property owners in the North American Market with respect to the use, management, and monetization of their IP portfolios.  The second is in facilitating the investment of IP derived revenue into Iceland-based projects.  Our customer base is comprised of individuals, privately held companies, and family offices who are open diversifying their holdings in EEA and EFTA jurisdictions.  Your role will be to effectively assist clients with maximizing IP derived revenue and presenting opportunities to invest that revenue into target projects in Iceland.  A solid understanding of intellectual property, contracts, procurement processes is essential.  

Main tasks and Responsibilities:
•    Provide strategic direction to clients with respect to intellectual property licensing within the relevant jurisdictional frameworks of each client portfolio.
•    Prepare and present pitch decks to potential investment partners.  
•    Develop investment-ready Iceland-based project proposals.
•    Manage and develop local network of interested counterpart stakeholder and professional service providers related to each project proposal.
•    Identify and liaise with potential new high-net-worth individual investors and small-midsized family office clients in North, Central, and South American markets.
•    Demonstrate extraordinary discretion in all interactions with clients, maintaining the utmost in confidentiality and candor.

Education and licensing:
•    Advanced university-level business or legal education required.  Doctorate of Jurisprudence or Masters of Business Administration with coursework in contracts or international transactions from a top university strongly preferred.
•    Educational coursework in environmental or natural resources usage from an Icelandic University preferred.
•    Admittance to practice before to any US Federal Court.
•    Membership in any North America-based First Nation or Tribal Bar Association strongly preferred.

Qualification Requirements:
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in intellectual property licensing.
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in real property development or prime-contractor representation is highly desirable
•    Minimum 3years of experience in international transactions is highly desirable.
•    Solid Understanding of USPTO and EUIPO standards and procedures.
•    Knowledge of securities and BizOp regulatory standards and requirements is highly desirable.
•    Ability to operate effectively in a multi-time-zone framework convenient to international client domestic work hours.

Language Skills:  Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation English skills are essential.  Additional languages are beneficial.
English [Required] Expert Level
Icelandic [Optional] Intermediate
Spanish [Optional] Intermediate

Compensation:
Compensation is chiefly commission based plus a minimum base salary of 500,000 ISK per month.

Work Hours:
Flexible working hours generally overlapping with the North American Market.  Schedule is expected to vary based on specific client/project needs.

Job Title: Sheet Metal Worker Reports to: Structures Crew Leader Location: Atlantic Aviation Group, Shannon Airport, Shannon, Co Clare Apply: Email your up-to-date CV together with any supporting qualifications to careers@atlanticaviation.ie Atlantic Aviation Group With over 55 years of experience, Shannon based Atlantic Aviation Group (AAG) is one of Europe's leading independent aviation solution providers. The company has a strong reputation of providing customers with a complete range of solutions including; aircraft maintenance modifications, technical, engineering and design services, logistics and material solutions and international training and consultancy. This reputation is built on a proud history and tradition of superior craftsmanship, technical expertise and continuous training, which is supported by our flexible, open and partnership-based customer relationships. Repair, rework, install and fabricate the complex aircraft structural assemblies, both internal and external. Remove and disassemble defective parts of the aircraft Adhere to company procedures, maintaining Safety and Quality standards at all times, reporting any discrepancies to respective Manager/Team Leader, generating SMS reports as necessary Carry out all repairs and tasks using the relevant approved Repair Manuals, Drawings/Technical Instructions as provided by the OEM Maintain a safe, organized and clean work environment according to in house 5S principles, including proper usage of tooling Ensures relevant repair documentation is completed accurately and in a timely manner Working collaboratively with your Crew Leader, inspector and the Production team. Integration of our values and pillars as a constant way of operating including compliance with the organisational policies and procedures detailed in the Atlantic Aviation Group MOE and Supporting manuals. Candidate Requirements Candidates must have a minimum of 4 years’ experience in Aircraft Structures repair/modification. Heavy maintenance experience is an advantage but not essential. Must be proficient in the use of Aircraft manuals, Boeing Engine Atlantic Aviation Group is an equal opportunities employer. description:

About the role Contract Manager Location: Republic of Ireland – Multi-Site Location Salary: €65,000 per annum Contract: Full-time, Permanent Are you an experienced Facilities Management professional looking to take the next step in your career? Sodexo is seeking an experienced Contract Manager to lead the delivery of integrated Facilities Management services across two higher education buildings in Dublin. Reporting to the Contract Director, you'll take ownership of the day-to-day operational delivery of both hard and soft FM services, leading multidisciplinary teams while ensuring exceptional service delivery, compliance, financial performance and client satisfaction. What you'll be doing As Contract Manager, you will: Lead the delivery of integrated Facilities Management services across a prestigious PPP contract. Manage multidisciplinary teams, including managers, technicians and frontline colleagues. Oversee both hard and soft services, ensuring contractual KPIs and Service Level Agreements are consistently achieved. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, stakeholders, contractors and service partners. Manage operational budgets, financial performance and cost efficiencies. Ensure legislative compliance, health & safety standards and contractor management processes are maintained. Oversee planned preventative maintenance, reactive works and lifecycle projects. Drive continuous improvement, innovation and operational excellence across the contract. Lead performance management, coaching and development of site management teams. Support emergency response, business continuity planning and incident management. What we're looking for We're looking for a confident and commercially minded Facilities Management professional with: Previous experience managing Facilities Management contracts within a customer-facing environment. Experience leading multidisciplinary operational teams. Strong knowledge of hard and soft FM services, including contractor management. An understanding of HVAC, Mechanical & Electrical systems, Fire Protection and Building Management Systems (BMS). Experience managing budgets, KPIs, SLAs and contract performance. Excellent stakeholder management, communication and leadership skills. A recognised qualification in Facilities Management, Engineering, Building Services or a related discipline. IOSH or NEBOSH qualification and professional membership (BIFM, CIBSE or equivalent) are highly desirable. Ability to satisfy Garda Vetting requirements. Sodexo reserves the right to close this advert early if we are in receipt of a high number of applications.

title: Welders
description:

Our client, Gravity Construction Limited, based in Barntown, Co. Wexford, is currently seeking Welders for immediate start at their facility in Barntown, Co. Wexford. Qualifications: 1-3 years’ of previous welding experience required. Welding Certification preferred but not essential. There are no minimum academic requirements. Further training will be provided on-the-job as required. Candidates must be able to mig weld, perform fillet welds and read drawings General Duties / Responsibilities / Experience: - To operate welding equipment in order to join metalwork pieces together - To use fusion welding processes based on various techniques and materials - To perform simple visual inspection of welds - To perform fillet welds, mig welding and to read drawings - To wear appropriate protective gear and adhere to safety standards - To smooth burred surfaces and recognise metal imperfections - This role requires knowledge of welding techniques, torch temperature for metal processes, metal thermal conductivity and fuel gas - Essential knowledge includes welding from drawings (2D and 3D), mig welding and fillet welds - Essential skills include aligning components, joining metals and operating welding equipment, including oxy-fuel torch - Candidates must be competent to apply arc welding techniques and precision metalworking techniques - Candidates must be competent to ensure correct metal temperature and handle fuels - Candidates must have experience in recognising signs of corrosion and removing inadequate workpieces - Candidates must have experience in performing metal active gas welding and inert gas welding - Candidates must have 1-3 years’ of relevant experience as a Welder - Experience as a Welder in the construction or demolition industry is a plus Annual Remuneration: €36,605.00; Pay Rate €18.05 per hour Work Location: Gravity Construction Limited, Barntown, Co. Wexford, Y35 V4AA. Number of hours work each week: 39 If you're interested in this role, please apply with an up-to-date CV to info@crewitresourcing.com or call 019020688 to enquire for more details.

title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)

description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e portare a mercato l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture, ossia servizi per il monitoraggio e la tracciabilità di asset e sistemi (IoT/asset tracking/remote monitoring) e una linea di business di connettività satellitare in logica wholesale (offerte rivendibili tramite partner, con livelli di servizio e prezzi chiari). La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con il founder space per trasformare i bisogni dei clienti in scelte di prodotto e di servizio (copertura, prestazioni attese, priorità di sviluppo). Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale Location: Milano, Italia (ibrido valutabile) Package: RAL 70-100K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. title: Fahrer (m/w/divers) für Showtruck gesucht (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
description:
.....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....

Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.

Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.

Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:

- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt
- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich
- leichter Auf- und Abbau von Gerätschaften während der Tour
- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort
- Terminplanung Tour
- Ausschankbetrieb
- Führerschein Klasse CE

Persönliche Voraussetzungen:

- Unabhängigkeit
- Altersvorgabe 30-58
- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik
- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen
- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusst

Interesse? Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben oder wenn Sie sich für diese Stelle interessieren.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Grundkenntnisse: Gästebetreuung, Fahrzeugführung, Getränke zubereiten und anrichten, Technisches Verständnis

title: Database and network professionals
description: Vuoi essere parte del cambiamento digitale e della trasformazione tecnologica? Hai esperienza in ambito ICT e vuoi lavorare su progetti innovativi? Potremmo avere l'opportunità giusta per te! Grafton ICT* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito AI, Data, Cybersecurity, Cloud, ERP & CRM, Sistemi e Infrastrutture, IMAC e Sviluppo. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per conto di CISALFA GROUP, azienda italiana presente in Italia e in Germania con 7 società e le insegne Calafa Sport, INTERSPORT Voswinkel e SportScheck, con più di 240 negozi e 5.500 persone, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di: CYBER SECURITY ENGINEER La risorsa opererà in stretta collaborazione con il Cyber Security Architect, il SOC e i team IT, contribuendo all'implementazione, alla gestione operativa e al continuo miglioramento delle soluzioni di sicurezza aziendali. Il ruolo ha una forte componente tecnico-operativa e prevede la responsabilità diretta sull'esecuzione dei controlli di sicurezza, sul monitoraggio degli eventi e sul supporto alle attività di incident management, in ambienti sia on-premise sia cloud. Cosa farai: - Implementare, configurare e gestire operativamente soluzioni di sicurezza enterprise (EDR/XDR, SIEM, firewall, IDS/IPS, IAM) - Monitorare gli eventi di sicurezza e analizzare i log per individuare anomalie e potenziali minacce - Supportare le attività di incident response, investigazione tecnica e contenimento degli incidenti - Gestire endpoint, server e infrastrutture dal punto di vista della sicurezza - Collaborare con il SOC e con fornitori esterni per l'analisi e la risoluzione degli alert - Supportare le attività di vulnerability assessment e la remediation delle vulnerabilità - Contribuire all'implementazione delle misure di sicurezza definite dall'architettura (security by design) - Fornire supporto operativo su temi di backup, disaster recovery e continuità operativa Competenze tecniche richieste: - Esperienza pratica con soluzioni EDR/XDR, SIEM e sistemi di logging centralizzato - Conoscenza dei principali meccanismi di sicurezza di rete (firewall, VPN, IDS/IPS) - Capacità di analisi di log ed eventi di sicurezza - Conoscenza dello stack TCP/IP e dei principali protocolli di rete - Comprensione dei principi di crittografia, gestione dei certificati e protocolli sicuri (TLS, SSH) - Esperienza o familiarità con soluzioni di Identity & Access Management - Familiarità con ambienti cloud Orario di lavoro: 8 ore al giorno, dal lunedì al venerdì con flessibilità in entrata dalle 8:30 alle 10:00 e pausa pranzo obbligatoria di 1 ora( tra 12:30 e 15:00). description: Wyser Srl è la società internazionale di Gi Group che si occupa di ricerca e selezione di middle e senior management specializzato. Per cliente leader di mercato, posizionato a Bologna, ricerchiamo un/una CLOUD OPERATION/SPECIALISTA PIATTAFORMA GEN AI La risorsa fornirà supporto alle operazioni e alla governance delle piattaforme aziendali di IA generativa (ad esempio, Microsoft Azure, Copilot Studio), garantendo l'affidabilità, la sicurezza e la qualità del servizio degli agenti di IA in produzione. l ruolo, all'interno dell'area di Enterprise Systems Management, lavorerà a stretto contatto con i team di IA, i team di Technology Enterprise Solutions & Services e Cloud Operations, contribuendo all'abilitazione operativa delle piattaforme GenAI, al monitoraggio dei servizi e al miglioramento continuo dei processi operativi. Responsabilità - Gestire la configurazione operativa delle piattaforme GenAI (Azure / Copilot), comprese le impostazioni dei tenant, i servizi, le integrazioni e le connessioni necessarie per l'adozione degli agenti di IA; - Supportare i team di IA durante le fasi di onboarding e configurazione, fornendo indicazioni sui prerequisiti tecnici, sulle configurazioni e sulle migliori pratiche operative; - Collaborare con i team di sicurezza e conformità per mitigare i rischi legati all'accesso ai dati tramite gli agenti di IA; - Contribuire alla distribuzione degli agenti AI, garantendo la prontezza operativa, le checklist di go-live e il supporto nella definizione di SLA/SLO; - Implementare e gestire le attività di monitoraggio e osservabilità (metriche, dashboard, avvisi), supportando l'analisi delle anomalie e del degrado del servizio; - Partecipare alla gestione del ciclo di vita operativo (incidenti, problemi, modifiche, rilasci), in linea con i processi aziendali di IT Operations; - Collaborare con i team Cloud Ops / FinOps sulla pianificazione della capacità e la consapevolezza dei costi, monitorando le tendenze di utilizzo e i potenziali rischi; - Mantenere e aggiornare la documentazione operativa (runbook, procedure, FAQ tecniche), favorendo la condivisione delle conoscenze. Requisiti - Esperienza in ruoli legati alle operazioni IT, alle operazioni cloud in contesti aziendali o multinazionali - Buona conoscenza di Microsoft Azure (gestione tenant/identità, servizi di base, registrazione e monitoraggio) e familiarità con le piattaforme Copilot 365 / Copilot Studio; - Buona conoscenza di Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps); - Esperienza nelle operazioni di servizi IT: gestione degli incidenti, risoluzione dei problemi, analisi delle cause alla radice (RCA) e gestione degli SLA; - Mentalità collaborativa e orientata al servizio, con la capacità di lavorare con team interfunzionali e tradurre le esigenze tecniche e aziendali in azioni operative; - Approccio strutturato, con particolare attenzione alla stabilità del servizio e al miglioramento continuo. Competenze gradite - Esperienza operativa di base con AWS o ambienti multi-cloud; - Familiarità con strumenti di osservabilità (ad es. Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights o soluzioni simili); - Conoscenza dei principi SRE / di affidabilità del servizio (SLO, indicatori di qualità del servizio); - Esperienza con piattaforme low-code, automazione dei flussi di lavoro o piattaforme di IA/agenti, anche al di fuori di contesti puramente di sviluppo. Questa potrebbe essere l'opportunità giusta per te! Gi Group SpA, Agenzia per il Lavoro Filiale di Mirano organizza un corso di formazione GRATUITO per la figura di: Operatore/Operatrice di Cucina Di cosa si tratta? Il corso ha una durata di 80 ore e approfondirà le seguenti tematiche: Organizzazione e funzionamento delle mense scolastiche e ospedaliere, tavole calde e self-service Struttura della mensa, principali mansioni e ruolo dell'addetto mensa Allestimento e pulizia degli ambienti, delle attrezzature e degli utensili di cucina nel rispetto delle norme HACCP Pulizia, sanificazione, disinfezione e disinfestazione igienico sanitaria di ambienti, attrezzature e utensili da cucina Operare la preparazione e somministrazione dei piatti nel rispetto delle norme HACCP Scodellamento, sporzionamento e gestione della sala Le muffe, i funghi e i lieviti: gli ambienti favorenti e processi di evitamento e prevenzione Controllare lo stato di conservazione delle materie prime e dei semilavorati alimentari stoccati Identificare ed utilizzare i materiali e le confezioni più indicate per proteggere gli alimenti da contaminazioni di tipo chimico e fisico, allungarne la conservazione e trasmettere le informazioni sul prodotto Tipologie di imballo e caratteristiche di utilizzo per il settore alimentare e celle frigorifere Requisiti: Requisito per la partecipazione al corso è il possesso dell'Assegno Gol rilasciato dal Centro per l'Impiego. Per ogni ora di frequenza verrà riconosciuta un'indennità di frequenza, previa partecipazione ad almeno il 70% del Monte ore totale. Il corso è finanziato con fondi del PNRR nell'ambito del Programma GOL ed è rivolto a persone disoccupate domiciliate in Veneto. Al termine del corso di formazione i partecipanti saranno seguiti e supportati da un Consulente Gi Group esperto nel Mercato del Lavoro che li accompagnerà nel reinserimento nel mondo del lavoro. Mailand

Gesucht wird für den Privathaushalt einer Unternehmerfamilie in Mailand eine liebenswerte, zuverlässige **Rota-Nanny / Kinderfrau (m/w/d)** zur Betreuung von drei Kindern im Alter von 3, 4 und 9 Jahren (im 14 Tage frei / 14 Tage arbeiten- Rhythmus). Im Mittelpunkt der Position steht die liebevolle und verantwortungsbewusste Begleitung der Kinder durch ihren abwechslungsreichen Alltag. Dazu gehören die Betreuung, die Begleitung zu Freizeitaktivitäten sowie die Gestaltung gemeinsamer Aktivitäten – insbesondere im Freien. Die Familie reist regelmäßig und verbringt unter anderem Zeit in ihrem Feriendomizil in St. Moritz sowie im Sommerhaus in Österreich. Reisebereitschaft und Freude an einem internationalen Familienumfeld sind daher wichtige Voraussetzungen. Neben der Kinderbetreuung gehören leichte Tätigkeiten im Haushalt sowie eine gelegentliche, kindgerechte Zubereitung von Mahlzeiten zum Aufgabenbereich. Die gesuchte Fachkraft arbeitet dabei in einem bereits gut organisierten Privathaushalt mit einer weiteren Rota-Nanny, einem Haushälter, einem Koch und einer Reinigungskraft. Gesucht wird eine Persönlichkeit, die warmherzig, diskret, verantwortungsbewusst und flexibel ist und Freude daran hat, Teil eines anspruchsvollen familiären Umfelds zu sein. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind erwünscht; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil, jedoch keine Voraussetzung. Vorausgesetzt werden fundierte und nachweisbare Berufserfahrung in der Betreuung mehrerer Kinder, idealerweise in einem vergleichbaren gehobenen Privathaushalt; eine ca. 35 m² große separate Unterkunft wird gestellt. Die Position ist nach Absprache zu besetzen und bietet eine überdurchschnittlich attraktive Vergütung. Geboten wird ein langfristiges, professionelles Arbeitsumfeld mit einem hohen Anspruch an Qualität, Diskretion und persönlicher Betreuung.

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: SSAB - Technical Development Manager Italy
description:
Your qualifications
•    Master’s degree in Mechanical engineering, Metallurgy or Mining
•    Fluent Italian and English written and spoken, German is a merit
•    Experience from the steel industry is a merit
•    Analytical skills
We are currently looking for a Technical Development Manager to SSAB Special Steels in Italy.

About the position
SSAB is a highly-specialized global steel company driven by close customer relationships. SSAB Develops high-strength steels and provides services for better perfomance and sustainability. The company is a leading producer on the global market for Advanced High-Strength Steels (AHSS) and Quenched & Tempered Steel (Q&T), strip, plate and tubular products, as well as construction solutions.
As Technical Development Manager, you are playing an important role of supporting SSAB’s customers with your technical competence and support in order to build customer value and profitability. The role also includes close collaboration with Tech support, product development, production and quality. Your geographical business area will be Italy, Greece and Switzerland. You will be traveling approximately 3-4 days a week to meet customers and also to visit SSAB’s mill in Oxelösund, Sweden.

Application
Send your application no later than 24th of September 2018

In this recruitment we collaborate with Hudson.

For more information, please contact
Fredrik Ålund, Researcher, 076-631 94 44

We decline contacts from recruitment agencies and ad sellers regarding this advertisement.
SSAB is a Nordic and US-based steel company. SSAB offers value added products and services developed in close cooperation with its customers to create a stronger, lighter and more sustainable world. SSAB has employees in over 50 countries. SSAB has production facilities in Sweden, Finland and the US. SSAB is listed on the NASDAQ OMX Nordic Exchange in Stockholm and has a secondary listing on the NASDAQ OMX in Helsinki. www.ssab.com

title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: Elektrikas
description:
1. Šias pareigas einantis darbuotojas vykdo šias funkcijas:
1.1. Sugeba savarankiškai atlikti pavestą darbą, nepažeisdamas tiesioginio vadovo teisėtų nurodymų;
1.2. Parengia arba sukomplektuoja įstaigos objektų elektros energijos tiekimo schemas, pažymi eksploatacijos metu atsiradusius pakeitimus.
1.3. Parengia arba sukomplektuoja įstaigos objektuose esančių elektros spintų schemas, pažymi eksploatacijos metu atsiradusius pakeitimus.
1.4. Sukomplektuoja arba naujai parengia įstaigoje eksploatuojamų įžeminimo įrenginių brėžinius, jų įrengimo vietos planus.
1.5. Kontroliuoja įstaigoje eksploatuojamų elektros įrenginių bandymų ir matavimų galiojimo terminus, organizuoja bandymų ir matavimų atlikimą, vertina (ar tinkamos vertės) ir tikrina atliktų matavimų teisingumą (ar išmatuoti visi įrenginiai ir t.t.).
1.6. Dalyvauja rengiant įstaigoje įgyvendinamų projektų (remontų, rekonstrukcijų ir t.t.) elektros įrenginių technines sąlygas, techninius reikalavimus.
1.7. Kontroliuoja įstaigoje įgyvendinamų projektų (remontų, rekonstrukcijų ir t.t.) elektros įrenginių montavimo metu atliekamų elektrotechnikos darbų atitiktį techninėms sąlygoms, projektams, aprašams ir norminių aktų reikalavimas, apie neatitikimus informuoti atsakingą įstaigos asmenį.
1.8. Dalyvauja įstaigoje įgyvendinamų projektų (remontų, rekonstrukcijų ir t.t.) pripažinimo, vertinimo komisijų darbe, vertina darbų atlikimo atitiktį projektui, techninėms sąlygoms, aprašams, norminių aktų reikalavimas. Vertinti elektros įrenginių badymų matavimų apimtis, rezultatų teisingumą. Vertinti įrengtų elektros įrenginių funkcionalumą, pateiktos techninės dokumentacijos pakankamumą.
1.9. Kontroliuoja įstaigos objektų suvartotos elektros energijos apimtis, jas analizuoja, teikia atsakingam asmeniui pasiūlymus efektyvesniam elektros energijos vartojimui užtikrinti.
1.10. Kontroliuoja, organizuoja įstaigos elektrotechninio personalo atestacijas.

title: Avarinių paslaugų komandos elektrikas (-ė)
description:
Tavo pagrindinės atsakomybės
•    Avarinių situacijų likvidavimas: operatyviai reaguoti ir šalinti elektros tinklų, įrenginių bei apšvietimo sistemų gedimus Bendrovės prižiūrimose teritorijose ir objektuose (gyvenamuosiuose ir kitos paskirties pastatuose).
•    Planiniai darbai: atlikti elektros instaliacijos, skydų, apšvietimo ir kitų elektros įrenginių iki 1000 V priežiūros, remonto bei montavimo darbus. Prižiūrėti elektros įrangos sklandų bei saugų veikimą.
•    Darbų organizavimas: sukomplektuoti darbams reikalingas eksploatacines medžiagas ir įrankius, vairuoti Bendrovės transporto priemones, saugiai valdyti įrangą bei fiksuoti atliktus darbus informacinėse sistemose.
Ko tikimės iš Tavęs?
•    Ne žemesnis kaip vidurinis išsilavinimas arba profesinė kvalifikacija elektrotechnikos srityje. Galiojantis apsaugos nuo elektros kvalifikacinis pažymėjimas iki 1000 V (darbuotojo / inžinieriaus, VK / AK kategorija – privalumas).
•    Galiojantis B kategorijos vairuotojo pažymėjimas.
•    Darbo patirtis elektros tinklų montavimo, elektros tinklų priežiūros ar avarinių darbų srityje.
•    Puikus elektros tinklų, įrenginių ir instaliacijų veikimo principų, priežiūros bei saugos taisyklių išmanymas.
•    Gebėjimas skaityti elektrotechnines schemas, techninius brėžinius bei naudotis technine dokumentacija.
•    Atsakingumas, savarankiškumas, gebėjimas dirbti komandoje ir greitai priimti sprendimus avarinių situacijų metu.
•    Mokėjimas naudotis išmaniaisiais įrenginiais (telefonu, planšete) ir atlikti paprastas duomenų įvedimo operacijas.

title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

Ce que l'ANA a à vous offrir : L'ANA investit pleinement dans votre développement professionnel. Vous bénéficierez d'une formation spécialisée en météorologie entier/ièrement financée par l'ANA, d'une durée de à mois, auprès d'institutions européennes de référence telles que : Le Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD) à Langen (Allemagne) ; L'École Nationale de la Météorologie de Météo-France à Toulouse (France). Cette formation couvre notamment : La de l'atmosphère ; La thermodynamique ; La dynamique des fluides ; Les mathématiques appliquées ; Les modèles numériques de prévision ; La météorologie aéronautique ; L'analyse scientifique des phénomènes météorologiques. La réussite de cette formation nécessite une réelle appétence pour les disciplines scientifiques ainsi qu'une forte capacité d'apprentissage et d'analyse. title: Analyst, Same Day Topology, LTP (m/f)
description:
Analyst, Same Day Topology, LTP
Job ID: 10486914 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Have you ever ordered a product on the Amazon website and wondered how it got delivered to you via Same Day, and what kinds of topology, demand and capacity processes are running behind the scenes to power the whole operation? If so, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for steering our LTP topology to deliver end-to-end benefits across Customer Experience, Speed, and Cost. This is a role for an exceptionally talented person, with high energy and courage, passionate about ambiguity and delivering concrete improvements for our customers, and who wants to achieve that using data. The role is split 70% analytics and 30% project management.
The key job responsibilities can be split in two buckets:

(1) Data Analytics/Science

- Deep dive complex data to uncover actionable insights for known and unknown problems
- Good expertise with SQL techniques
- Build strong analytics tools to highlight defects and extract actionable insights from our end-to-end supply chain

(2) Project management:

- Lead regular business reviews with partner teams to monitor progress of projects in the roadmap, and help remove bottlenecks
- Use and share your insights with partner teams to influence and build a roadmap of projects that accelerate speed of deliveries in your country
- For the most complex and ambitious opportunities, quickly launch new pilots and build scale-up business cases with benefits, bottlenecks, risks, and resources required
- Consolidate progress into crisp, concise, data-driven status updates. You will own reporting to Amazon senior leadership.

A day in the life

You'll work across First Mile and Last Mile topology teams to shape the physical network that powers Same Day: classifying and sizing node types (Nexus, dedicated Same Day sites, standard fulfillment sites), evaluating RE candidates against coverage and capacity needs, and reconciling demand against what the network can realistically serve at a regional and site level. You'll turn that analysis into a prioritized roadmap and drive it through recurring workshops with Real Estate, Topology, Finance, and Science partners, tracking action items to closure and reporting progress up to senior leadership.

About the team

Long Term Planning Analytics Team

- Same Day Topology LTP is one of those analytical teams. We are obsessed by rethinking our advanced end-to-end supply chain to make our deliveries even faster. Our overall mission is simple: we want Amazon to be the place where our products can be delivered the same-day.
- Long Term Planning analytical teams are transversal centers of expertise, composed of engineers, analysts, and scientists. We are focused on Amazon most complex problems, processes and decisions. We work with fulfillment centers, transportation, finance and retail teams across the world, to improve our logistic infrastructure.

- Operations is at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. Each action we undertake is on behalf of our customers, as surpassing their expectations is our passion. We improve customer experience through continuously optimizing the complex movements of goods from vendors to customers throughout Europe.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Math, Engineering, Science or Business
- Experience in analyzing data to drive decisions
- Experience engaging, verbally and in writing, with internal and external stakeholders to convey complex ideas in a clear, concise manner
- Ability to lead and structure projects, in particular liaising and collaborating with internal partners to influence direction and roadmaps, despite competing priorities
Preferred Qualifications
- Ability to progress autonomously in ambiguous environment

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. title: HealthTech Innovation Project Coordinator (m/f)
description:
Description de tâches:


CDD, full-time, ref: [HTIPC26]
Service: National Business Relationship Management
Hierarchical Superior: Director, Business Relationship Management



About Luxinnovation

Luxinnovation is Luxembourg's national innovation agency. As a semi-public institution set up as an Economic Interest Group (GIE), we empower companies to innovate today to be ready for tomorrow. We also contribute to the development of the economy as a whole by identifying innovation opportunities and fostering collaborative innovation projects that stimulate the development of a sustainable, competitive and digital economy.

Luxinnovation is supported by three ministries — the Ministry of the Economy, the Ministry for Research and Higher Education, and the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs — as well as three semi-public institutions: the Luxembourg Chamber of Commerce, the Luxembourg Chamber of Skilled Crafts, and FEDIL – The Voice of Luxembourg's Industry.


Job mission:


Department description:

The Business Relationship Management division builds and maintains strategic relationships with Luxembourg's innovation ecosystem. Within this division, the HealthTech team supports the development and competitiveness of Luxembourg's health technologies sector — spanning medtech, digital health, biotech and pharmaceutical innovation — by connecting companies to relevant programmes, research organisations and European initiatives.


Job description:

As a HealthTech Innovation Project Coordinator, you will drive the operational management and strategic coordination of healthtech-related projects at national and European level. You will coordinate the activities of the HealthTech team members, ensuring that project milestones are delivered on time and within budget, while fostering collaboration between internal colleagues, consortium partners, research organisations and Luxembourg-based companies across the health technologies value chain.

You will act as a key bridge between national/European initiatives and the Luxembourg business ecosystem, driving innovation and sustainable growth.


Main tasks and responsibilities:

Your responsibilities are structured around Luxinnovation's four core pillars of activity:


Inspire:

Monitor technological, regulatory and market developments across the healthtech landscape (medtech, digital health, biotech, pharma) and translate insights into actionable opportunities for the ecosystem
Contribute to the design and implementation of Luxinnovation's HealthTech strategy and annual work programme, aligned with national health innovation priorities
Represent Luxinnovation in healthtech-related fora, conferences and working groups at national and European level
Promote Luxembourg's healthtech ecosystem and its competitive advantages to international partners and stakeholders


Assess & Accelerate:

Manage the operational delivery of healthtech innovation projects, ensuring alignment with consortium work plans, KPIs and budgets
Coordinate the contributions of the HealthTech team members across active projects, ensuring clarity of roles, coherent planning and timely delivery of individual and collective workstreams
Track project progress through regular reporting (CRM, European project management systems), flag risks and propose corrective actions
Identify companies' innovation needs within the healthtech sector and assess their potential to participate in collaborative R&D projects
Support companies in navigating regulatory frameworks relevant to health technologies (e.g., EU Medical Device Regulation, European Health Data Space)


Connect:

Serve as the central coordination point within the HealthTech team, facilitating information flow, aligning priorities and ensuring synergies between team members' respective activities and project portfolios
Coordinate with consortium partners, research organisations and institutional stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution and knowledge exchange
Facilitate matchmaking between Luxembourg healthtech companies and international partners for collaborative innovation projects
Act as an internal interface, connecting healthtech project activities with other Luxinnovation services (funding, market intelligence, digitalisation)
Develop and maintain professional relationships across the national and European healthtech ecosystem


Fund:

Support Luxembourg companies in accessing European healthtech funding programmes (Horizon Europe Health Cluster, EIT Health, Innovative Health Initiative, Digital Europe Programme)
Ensure compliant budget tracking, timesheet management and financial reporting for all projects under your coordination
Identify synergies between national RDI funding instruments and European healthtech calls to maximise funding opportunities for ecosystem actors
Contribute to the preparation and submission of new collaborative project proposals in the healthtech domain


This list is not exhaustive. Additional tasks may be assigned to the holder of the job.


Required competencies:

Education level and professional experience required:

University degree at Master's level (Bac+4/5) in life sciences, biomedical engineering, health economics, public health, business management or equivalent
Minimum 5 years of professional experience in project coordination or management within the healthtech, life sciences or health innovation sector
Proven experience managing multi-partner collaborative projects (national or European)
Experience coordinating small cross-functional teams or workgroups
Knowledge of European R&D programme structures (Horizon Europe, EIT Health, IHI) is a strong asset
Project management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, IPMA) is desirable


Specific competencies:

Solid understanding of the health technologies landscape, including medtech, digital health, biotech and pharmaceutical innovation
Proven ability to manage complex project portfolios with multiple workstreams, partners and deadlines
Strong team coordination skills, with the ability to align diverse contributors around shared objectives and delivery timelines
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate technical health innovation challenges into structured project plans
Excellent stakeholder engagement and diplomatic skills across institutional, academic and private-sector actors
Knowledge of Luxembourg's socio-economic environment and health innovation ecosystem is an asset
Familiarity with regulatory frameworks relevant to health technologies (EU MDR, IVDR, European Health Data Space) is an advantage


Languages:

Fluent English and French are mandatory (oral and written, minimum C1 level)
German and/or Luxembourgish is considered an asset


IT Skills:

MS Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and MS Project or equivalent
CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics)
European project management platforms (e.g., EC Funding & Tenders Portal, JEMS)
Knowledge of collaboration and reporting tools (Teams, SharePoint)


Why choose this position?

This role places you at the intersection of health innovation, European R&D policy and team leadership. You will coordinate a dedicated team of healthtech specialists while managing high-impact projects that accelerate the adoption of health technologies in Luxembourg. Join a collaborative environment where your expertise in project coordination and your passion for healthtech will contribute directly to strengthening Luxembourg's position as a competitive player in the European health innovation landscape.

title: Risk Assurance - Internal Control Senior Associate (m/f/d)
description:
Risk Assurance - Internal Control Senior Associate (m/f/d)
Job ID: 710704WD
Job location(s): Luxembourg
Line of service: Assurance
Industry/Sector Not Applicable
Specialism Assurance
Management Level Senior Associate

Job Description & Summary

Your mission: Today's business environment is more complex than ever. More automated. More connected. More virtual. With these advances comes opportunity, but also risk.  
  
As an Internal Control Senior Associate, you will:

• Work as part of a team of problem solvers in a highly dynamic environment with international teams, proactively assisting in the management of several projects, while reporting to the managers and above;
• Establish effective working relationships with the clients' representatives;
• Train and lead various teams of associates and trainees;
• You will regularly collaborate with professionals from both business and technology to help advise clients on operational risks related to business processes, applications as well as risk management framework and risk assessments;
• Depending on your background and areas of focus, you will have the chance to be involved in projects where you will:
• Participate in internal control review assignments covering a wide and interesting array of businesses processes for clients in the financial, private and public sector;
• Perform risk assessments, process and internal control reviews in order to improve the operational risk management and internal controls framework of clients;
• Review your work and that of others for quality, accuracy and relevance;
• Submit it for the manager's review within the established deadline;
• Support business development activities to identify and research opportunities for new projects or clients.
  
Be a part of our team where you will have:  

• The possibility to discover and gain a deep expertise in various economic sectors and industries;
• Challenging and rewarding work environment;
• Systematic education process to support professional and personal development and on-the-job training;
• The chance to work in a dynamic environment of multicultural teams while enjoying a competitive remuneration package and contributing to a societal impact;
• A flexible learning and development policy that will enable you to design and schedule your training plan based on your needs and personal aspirations;
• Full support in your plans of upgrading your skills through participation in external relevant courses, drafting of thought leadership publications or network driven working groups;
• Stimulating work environment with workplace flexibility, and an open-minded team for new and innovative ideas.
  
Let's talk about you. If you …  

• You hold a Bachelor or Master degree in a relevant field (e.g.: Accounting, Finance, Management Information Systems, Management Information Systems & Accounting, Computer and Information Science, Computer and Information Science & Accounting, Economics, Economics and Finance, Economics and Finance & Technology, Business Administration/Management, Engineering, Accounting & Technology, Mathematics or other related studies);
• More than 2 years relevant expertise accumulated in one of the following domains: finance, accounting, operational risk management or internal audit;
• Understand internal controls and the external audit process;
• Leadership, interpersonal, communication and good writing skills;
• Demonstrate problem solving skills and the ability to prioritise and handle multiple tasks;
• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment;
• Team player and keen learner;
• You have a good command of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint);
• You are fluent in English and French (the languages commonly spoken by our clients).

…You are the candidate we are looking for!  
  
A final word about us  
At PwC, we believe diversity is the representation of all the characteristics that make us both alike and unique. Our backgrounds, cultures, nationalities, lifestyles, identities, opinions and beliefs, approaches to solving problems, ways of working, and views of personal and professional success, all add value to the services we deliver to our clients. Our objective is to nurture an inclusive environment where a diversity mindset is ingrained, and inclusion is the norm. We constantly focus on respecting and valuing individual differences.  


PwC Luxembourg (www.pwc.lu) is the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg with over 3,600 people employed from 90 different countries. PwC Luxembourg provides audit, tax and advisory services including management consulting, transaction, financing and regulatory advice. The firm provides advice to a wide variety of clients from local and middle market entrepreneurs to large multinational companies operating from Luxembourg and the Greater Region. The firm supports its clients in creating the value they are looking for by contributing to the smooth operation of the capital markets and providing advice through an industry-focused approach.

At PwC, we help clients build trust and reinvent so they can turn complexity into competitive advantage. We're a tech-forward, people-empowered network with more than 364,000 people in 136 countries and 137 territories. Across audit and assurance, tax and legal, deals and consulting, we help clients build, accelerate, and sustain momentum. Find out more at www.pwc.com and www.pwc.lu.

Luxembourg

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!
Join our Luxembourg team where your expertise directly contributes to humanity's greatest adventure, while maintaining the work-life harmony that makes great engineering possible. Be part of a collaborative, inclusive culture where safety and technical excellence drive every decision as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight from the heart of Europe.
At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We're working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!
As part of a hardworking team of supply chain professionals, technicians, and engineers, you will play a crucial role in ensuring our organization adheres to all relevant regulations, develops automated compliance reports, and educates our teams on designing compliant processes. The International Supply Chain Manager manages relationships with non-US external vendors and suppliers, ensuring contractual obligations are fulfilled while protecting the organization's interests, maintaining compliance, and optimizing.

Special Mentions:

Relocation provided
Travel expected up to 25% of the time
Interviews may will include a technical assessment

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Global Supplier Development & Relationship Management

Identify, evaluate, and onboard suppliers across international markets based on quality, capacity, reliability, and cost
Build and nurture cross-cultural business relationships that respect regional practices and communication styles
Monitor supplier performance against KPIs and implement improvement strategies across global operations

International Contract & Financial Management

Negotiate and administer agreements compliant with multiple legal jurisdictions and international standards
Leverage global market intelligence to secure optimal pricing while balancing quality and risk
Manage currency fluctuations, payment terms, and financial controls across international transactions
Maintain comprehensive documentation of all contract activities and changes

Global Compliance & Risk Mitigation

Ensure adherence to international trade regulations, export/import laws, and country-specific requirements
Identify and address risks unique to global procurement (political instability, logistics disruptions, trade disputes)
Implement appropriate risk management strategies through contract terms, insurance requirements, and contingency planning
Coordinate quality assurance across international suppliers to maintain consistent standards

Global Supply Chain Optimization

Manage international logistics, customs clearance, and documentation requirements
Implement efficiency improvements in global procurement processes and inventory management
Generate performance analytics on international supplier metrics and compliance reporting
Stay informed about international market trends and regional business conditions that impact supply chain decisions

Strategic Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with legal, finance, engineering, and logistics teams across global operations
Align international procurement activities with organizational objectives and program requirements
Facilitate effective communication between international suppliers and internal stakeholders
Serve as subject matter expert on global sourcing strategies and international supply markets

Minimum Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, international business, or related field
Experience: 5+ years in international procurement or supplier management
Language Skills: Proficiency in multiple languages relevant to key supplier regions
Knowledge: Understanding of international trade laws, customs regulations, and global logistics
Travel Capability: Willingness to travel internationally (typically 20-30%)
Cultural Competence: Demonstrated ability to work effectively across cultures and business environments
Technical Skills: Proficiency with global procurement systems and international payment platforms
Domain Expertise: Engineering, Manufacturing or Procurement experience across multiple aerospace domains and commodities

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelors degree and/or previous working experience as an Engineer, Apprentice or Technician
Experience working in a multi-cultural environment with both internal and external customers and stakeholders
Experience with ISO 9001, AS9100, or other quality management systems in aerospace
Fluent in multiple languages
