title: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems (m/f)
description:
Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems

Position: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette, Luxembourg
Start Date: Immediate
Type: Full-time

Company Overview

We're LuxQuantum, a Luxembourg-based deep-tech startup developing the next generation of quantum-safe communication systems.

Our mission is to address one of the key challenges in modern cybersecurity: how to combine Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) into a unified, adaptive, and scalable security architecture.

At LuxQuantum, we believe security decisions should not be static. Different data, infrastructures, risks, trust assumptions, and operational conditions may require different protection strategies. That's why we are developing intelligent and adaptive approaches to model these complex environments and support dynamic security and orchestration decisions.

Our work brings together AI, systems modeling, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications, creating research challenges that span multiple scientific and engineering disciplines.

We are a small and ambitious team of researchers, engineers, and innovators who enjoy exploring difficult problems, learning across disciplines, and turning research ideas into real-world technology.

Role Overview

As a Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer, you will contribute to the research and development of the intelligence and decision-making capabilities behind LuxQuantum's adaptive quantum-safe security systems.

You will investigate how complex security and communication systems can adapt to changing risks, uncertainty, trust requirements, infrastructure conditions, and operational constraints. Your work may involve mathematical and computational modeling, optimization, probabilistic methods, AI, or other data-driven and decision-support approaches.

You will work closely with our research and engineering team to formulate research problems, explore and compare different approaches, develop models and algorithms, evaluate them through experiments and simulations, and translate promising results into working prototypes.

The research sits at the intersection of systems modeling, intelligent decision-making, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications.

What You'll Do

• Investigate challenging research problems in intelligent and adaptive security systems
• Formulate research questions, develop new approaches, and design experiments and simulations to evaluate them
• Develop mathematical, computational, and AI-based models for decision-making under uncertainty, risk, and changing operational conditions
• Explore adaptive approaches for the orchestration and optimization of hybrid quantum-safe systems
• Design and evaluate methods that help security systems dynamically respond to changing infrastructure, trust, and operational requirements
• Translate research ideas, models, and algorithms into working prototypes and validate them in realistic scenarios
• Collaborate closely with researchers and engineers across software, AI, cybersecurity, and quantum technologies
• Contribute to the technical direction, architecture, and documentation of LuxQuantum's research and development activities

What We're Looking For

• PhD in a quantitative, scientific, engineering, or computing-related field; or a Master's degree with strong relevant research or R&D experience
• Strong research and analytical abilities, with the capacity to investigate complex problems, develop new approaches, and evaluate them systematically
• Experience with quantitative, computational, modeling, optimization, AI/ML, or related research methods
• Good programming and computational skills in one or more languages such as Python, C++, Rust, or similar
• Ability to translate research ideas, mathematical models, or algorithms into working prototypes
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a small multidisciplinary team
• Curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn and work across different technical domains
• Understanding of startup environments and research-driven innovation
• Fluent written and verbal communication in English

We welcome candidates from different scientific, engineering, and computational backgrounds, including PhD graduates, postdoctoral researchers, and researchers interested in transitioning from academia to industrial R&D. Prior experience in quantum technologies or quantum-safe cybersecurity is welcome but not required.

Nice to Have

Experience in any of the following is a plus, but not required:

• Cybersecurity, risk modeling, or security-related systems
• Quantum technologies, Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), or Quantum Key Distribution (QKD)
• Complex or distributed systems, simulation, or system orchestration
• Research software development and building experimental prototypes
• APIs, containerization, or ML/MLOps tools such as Docker, FastAPI, MLflow, or similar

Who You Are

• Curious and motivated by difficult problems where the answer is not always known in advance
• An independent thinker who enjoys exploring, testing, and improving new ideas
• Interested in turning research and theory into working systems with real-world impact
• Comfortable taking ownership while collaborating closely with a small multidisciplinary team
• Open to learning across disciplines and applying your expertise to new technical challenges
• Excited by the pace, responsibility, and opportunity to shape technology in an early-stage
deep-tech startup

Why Join LuxQuantum

Research with Real-World Impact

Work on challenging R&D problems and help turn research ideas, models, and algorithms into technologies for next-generation secure communication systems.

High Ownership

Take meaningful ownership of your work and have the opportunity to influence technical decisions and the direction of LuxQuantum's technology.

Work Across Disciplines

Collaborate at the intersection of systems modeling, AI, cybersecurity, software engineering, and quantum-safe communications, with the opportunity to expand your expertise into new areas.

Grow with a Deep-Tech Startup

Join LuxQuantum at an early stage, with the autonomy to explore ideas, take responsibility, and contribute to the development of both our technology and our research-driven engineering culture.

How to Apply

Please send:

• Your CV
• A short cover letter describing your background, relevant research or technical experience, and interest in the role
• Links to relevant projects, technical work, GitHub, or other examples of your work, if available (optional)

to:

contact@luxquantum.lu

Join us in building intelligent, adaptive security systems for the future of quantum-safe communications.

title: Educateur / Educatrice (H/F/X) - Crèche Kidscare Strassen
description:
Description de l'offre

Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recrutons un.e Educateur / Educatrice (F/H) en CDI pour notre crèche située à Strassen.

Présentation :

Le groupe Babilou Family est animé par des valeurs humaines fortes (#peoplefirst).


Nous offrons chaque jour une prise en charge de qualité aux enfants qui nous sont confiés.
Notre mission est de les accompagner afin qu'ils deviennent des citoyens du monde éclairés, épanouis et ouverts aux autres (#positivegrowth)


Nous prônons la valorisation de leurs compétences à travers les approches pédagogiques Montessori et Pikler. Nous incluons aussi la sustainable education, il s'agit d'actions basées sur les avancées dans le domaine des neurosciences, concentré sur des notions clés comme le langage, le multilinguisme, ou encore l'exposition des jeunes enfants aux écrans (#pedagogyfortomorrow).

Nos professionnels.lles de la petite enfance restent attentifs.ves au bon développement socio-émotionnel de chaque enfant en offrant sécurité et affection (#passion). Engagés dans une éducation durable, nous proposons des environnements responsables et une alimentation variée, tournée vers le bio et le locale. Ainsi nous sensibilisons les enfants que nous accueillons au potentiel infini qu'offre la nature (#planetatthecore).

À travers notre application «Kidizz» les parents ont la possibilité de suivre et de partager avec nous les journées de leurs enfants.


Vos principales tâches :

    Assurer l'accueil et l'encadrement des enfants ;
    Accompagner les enfants dans l'apprentissage des gestes de la vie quotidienne et des règles de la vie en communauté ;
    Créer un environnement sécurisé, affectueux et stimulant pour les enfants ;
    Proposer et organiser des activités pédagogiques adaptées au développement des enfants ;
    Veiller en permanence à l'intégrité psychique et physique des enfants ;
    Collaborer avec les autres membres de l'équipe pour assurer le bien-être global des enfants ;
    Soutenir l'enfant dans son développement individuel ;
    Effectuer des tâches de nettoyage courantes : débarrasser et nettoyer les tables, remplir et ranger le lave-vaisselle, … ;
    Observer et évaluer les progrès individuels des enfants, en fournissant des retours aux familles ;
    Entretenir une relation de confiance avec les parents.


Votre profil :

    Vous avez obtenu un diplôme vous donnant accès à la profession d'éducateur/éducatrice à Luxembourg (Diplôme d'Etat d'Educateur, EJE, Educateur spécialisé, Diplôme Educateur A1 et A2 belge, Master MEEF, Diplôme de puériculture belge, Diplôme dans l'éducation, ...) ;
    Vous avez une très bonne maîtrise du français, tout autre langue sera considérée comme un atout ;
    Connaissance des besoins et du développement des jeunes enfants ;
    Capacité à travailler en équipe (#teamspirit) et à communiquer efficacement ;
    Vous faites preuve de bienveillance, de créativité, de curiosité et de respect ;
    Vous êtes flexible, organisé.e et dynamique.

Conditions de travail :

    Poste à temps plein (40 heures par semaine) ;
    Salaire compétitif ;
    Formations tout au long de l'année (#continuouslearning) ;
    Avantages sociaux (tickets restaurant, carte sympass, ...).

Si vous êtes passionné.e par le bien-être et le développement des enfants (#passion), et que vous souhaitez rejoindre une équipe dévouée dans un environnement stimulant, nous serions ravis de vous rencontrer. Merci de nous envoyer votre candidature et les documents du Ministère :)

Processus documents auprès du Ministère si vous ne les avez pas.

description:
Description de l'offre

Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recrutons un.e Chargé.e de Direction Adjoint (F/H) en CDI pour notre crèche située à Strassen (Bellevue).

Présentation :

Le groupe Babilou Family est animé par des valeurs humaines fortes (#peoplefirst). Nous offrons chaque jour une prise en charge de qualité aux enfants qui nous sont confiés.

Notre mission est de les accompagner afin qu'ils deviennent des citoyens du monde éclairés, épanouis et ouverts aux autres (#positivegrowth)

Nous prônons la valorisation de leurs compétences à travers les approches pédagogiques Montessori et Pikler. Nous incluons aussi la sustainable education, il s'agit d'actions basées sur les avancées dans le domaine des neurosciences, concentré sur des notions clés comme le langage, le multilinguisme, ou encore l'exposition des jeunes enfants aux écrans (#pedagogyfortomorrow).

Nos professionnels.lles de la petite enfance restent attentifs.ves au bon développement socio-émotionnel de chaque enfant en offrant sécurité et affection (#passion). Engagés dans une éducation durable, nous proposons des environnements responsables et une alimentation variée, tournée vers le bio et le locale. Ainsi nous sensibilisons les enfants que nous accueillons au potentiel infini qu'offre la nature (#planetatthecore).

À travers notre application «Kidizz» les parents ont la possibilité de suivre et de partager avec nous les journées de leurs enfants.

Vos principales tâches :

    Assurer l'accueil et l'encadrement des enfants ;

    Observer et évaluer les progrès individuels des enfants, en fournissant des retours aux familles ;
    Entretenir une relation de confiance avec les parents.

Votre profil :

    Vous faites preuve de bienveillance, de créativité, de curiosité et de respect ;

Conditions de travail :

    Formations tout au long de l'année (#continuouslearning) ;
    Avantages sociaux (tickets restaurant, carte sympass, ...).

Si vous êtes passionné.e par le bien-être et le développement des enfants (#passion), et que vous souhaitez rejoindre une équipe dévouée dans un environnement stimulant, nous serions ravis de vous rencontrer.

Une culture d'entreprise solide qui fait des collaborateurs sa priorité. Joignez-vous à nous.

title: Tuyauteur (m/f/x)
description:
DESCRIPTION DE FONCTION


Identification du poste

Titre du poste : Tuyauteur

Département : Industry

Cette fonction rapportera à : Brigadier


Mission

En tant que tuyauteur, tu es en charge de la préfabrication et de la pose de lignes de tuyauterie en acier et en inox. Tu participes à la préparation, au développement et à l'assemblage des tubes en suivant les plans et les normes de sécurité en vigueur.

Responsabilités générales

• Effectuer des travaux généraux de prémontage, montage et démontage de lignes de tuyauterie selon un cahier des charges.
• Prendre des mesures précises, assembler, réparer et contrôler l'état des tuyauteries.
• Réaliser différents types de raccords et proposer des modifications si nécessaire.
• Déterminer la procédure de soudage la plus adaptée.
• Assurer la découpe de tuyaux au chalumeau et la pose des tuyauteries sur site.
• Superviser les opérations de soudage et assurer le remplacement de joints et le décapage des conduites.
• Appliquer rigoureusement les consignes de sécurité, de qualité et environnementales.
• Veiller à la propreté et à l'organisation de ton environnement de travail après chaque intervention.
• Maintenir une relation commerciale de premier niveau avec nos clients.

Spécificités

☐ Tube en polypropylène

• Assembler les tubes par thermosoudage, électrofusion ou emboîtement.
• Vérifier la qualité des soudures et réaliser des essais d'étanchéité.
• Installer les supports adaptés pour éviter la déformation.

☐ Tube en acier

• Découper les tubes au chalumeau ou à la meuleuse.
• Assembler les pièces par soudage (TIG, MIG, à l'arc).
• Vérifier la résistance mécanique et effectuer des tests sous pression.

☐ Tube inox

• Découper et assembler les tubes avec précision (TIG/MIG).
• Vérifier la qualité des soudures et effectuer un polissage.
• Respecter les normes sanitaires en vérifiant la conformité des installations.

Compétences requises

Techniques

• Maîtrise de la lecture de plans isométriques et des schémas de tuyauterie.
• Connaissance des différents matériaux (acier, inox, etc.) et de leurs spécificités.
• Expérience dans la découpe, l'assemblage et le soudage de tuyauteries.
• Capacité à réaliser des contrôles de conformité et des essais d'étanchéité.

Comportementales

• Rigueur et sens de l'organisation.
• Esprit d'équipe et capacité d'adaptation.
• Orientation client et respect des engagements.
• Proactivité et autonomie dans le travail.
• Respect strict des consignes de sécurité sur site.

Qualifications et expériences

• Diplôme en tuyauterie industrielle ou expérience équivalente.
• Expérience significative en tant que tuyauteur.

title: Mécanicien industriel (h/f)
description:
DESCRIPTION DE FONCTION


Identification du poste

Titre du poste : Mécanicien

Département : Industry

Cette fonction rapportera à : -

Mission

Le mécanicien industriel est en charge de l'installation, de la maintenance et de la réparation des équipements mécaniques utilisés dans un environnement industriel. Il veille au bon fonctionnement des machines en réalisant des interventions préventives et correctives.

Responsabilités générales

• Assurer l'entretien, la réparation et le nettoyage des équipements mécaniques.
• Détecter et diagnostiquer les pannes et remplacer les pièces défectueuses.
• Lire et interpréter les plans et schémas techniques.
• Remplacer ou ajuster les pièces mécaniques défectueuses.
• Vérifier le fonctionnement des installations après intervention.
• Contrôler la conformité des pièces/produits par rapport aux spécifications techniques.
• Contribuer à la qualité de service attendue par nos clients et assurer la relation commerciale.
• Veiller au respect des procédures de sécurité et des normes industrielles.
• Rédiger les comptes rendus d'intervention afin d'assurer une traçabilité.

Spécificités

☐ Alimentaire

• Assurer la maintenance préventive et curative des machines de production agroalimentaires.
• Diagnostiquer et réparer les pannes mécaniques sur convoyeurs, mélangeurs, doseurs et embouteilleurs.
• Travailler sur des équipements en milieu humide et respecter les normes sanitaires (HACCP, ISO 22000).

• Remplacer et ajuster les pièces d'usure (roulements, joints, courroies, chaînes, engrenages).

☐ Levage

• Travailler en conformité avec les normes de levage et de sécurité en vigueur (EN 13155, ISO 9927).

☐ Pharmaceutique

• Travailler sur des équipements nécessitant une haute précision (mélangeurs, granulateurs, presses à comprimés).

Techniques

• Diplôme en mécanique industrielle ou expérience équivalente.

title: Soudeur industriel (m/f)
description:
DESCRIPTION DE FONCTION


Identification du poste

Titre du poste : Soudeur industriel

Département : Industry

Cette fonction rapportera à : Brigadier, Contremaître ou Project Coordinator

Mission

Le soudeur industriel est en charge de l'assemblage et de la réparation des structures métalliques en appliquant les différentes techniques de soudage selon les besoins du projet.

Responsabilités générales

• Lire et interpréter les plans techniques et les spécifications de soudage.
• Préparer les pièces à souder en effectuant les découpes et ajustements nécessaires.
• Contrôler la conformité des travaux de soudure et entretenir les installations selon les standards de qualité.
• Effectuer l'entretien et la maintenance préventive de son matériel de soudage.
• Respecter les consignes de sécurité et les normes environnementales.
• Travailler en coordination avec les autres membres de l'équipe de production.
• Être responsable de la propreté de son environnement pendant et après les travaux effectués.
• Contribuer à la qualité de service attendu par nos clients et assurer la relation commerciale.

Spécificités

Soudeur MIG

• Réaliser des soudures sur des structures métalliques de grande envergure.
• Travailler principalement sur l'assemblage d'acier et d'aluminium.
• Assurer une pénétration optimale et une soudure homogène sur différents types de pièces.

Soudeur MAG

• Utiliser le procédé MAG pour souder des pièces en acier nécessitant une forte résistance mécanique.
• Assurer des assemblages métalliques robustes adaptés aux contraintes industrielles.

Soudeur TIG

• Effectuer des soudures précises sur des matériaux sensibles comme l'inox et l'aluminium.
• Travailler sur des pièces nécessitant une finition soignée et une soudure propre.
• Contrôler les déformations et ajuster les paramètres de soudage en conséquence.

Chalumeau

• Réaliser des soudures sur divers métaux en utilisant un chalumeau oxyacétylénique ou oxypropane.
• Assembler et souder des pièces en respectant les réglages de flamme adaptés aux matériaux.
• Maîtriser les techniques de soudage, brasage et soudo-brasage pour garantir des assemblages solides et durables.

Aluminothermie

• Réaliser des soudures par aluminothermie, principalement pour l'assemblage de rails ou de structures métalliques.
• Préparer les moules, doser et allumer le mélange aluminothermique en respectant les consignes de sécurité.
• Assurer le contrôle de la solidité et de la qualité des soudures après refroidissement.
☐ Soudeur à l'arc électrique

• Réaliser des soudures sur des structures métalliques épaisses.
• Travailler en extérieur ou en environnement industriel spécifique.
• Assurer une fixation robuste et durable des pièces soudées.

Positions

Arc électrique, TIG, MIG/MAG

☐ À plat (1G ou PA)

• La soudure est réalisée sur une pièce horizontale.
• C'est la position la plus facile et courante.

☐ En angle ou en corniche (2F ou PB)

• Soudage sur un angle formé par deux pièces perpendiculaires.
• Courant en chaudronnerie et en structures métalliques.

☐ Horizontale (2G ou PC)

• Le joint est vertical, mais la soudure se fait horizontalement.
• Demande plus de maîtrise pour éviter les défauts d'écoulement.

☐ Verticale (3G ou PF/PG)

• Le joint est vertical, et la soudure peut être réalisée :

- Montante (PF) : meilleure pénétration, plus stable.
- Descendante (PG) : plus rapide mais moins de pénétration.

☐ Plafond (4G ou PE)

• La soudure se fait sous la pièce.
• Très technique, car la gravité complique la tenue du bain de fusion.

☐ Tube horizontal, rotation (1G et PA)

• Le tube tourne pendant le soudage.
• Facile à exécuter.

☐ Tube vertical, soudage horizontal (2G et PC)

• Le tube ne bouge pas, la soudure se fait sur le côté.

☐ Tube horizontal, sans rotation (5G et PF ou PG)

• Soudage en progression montante (PF) ou descendante (PG).
• Plus complexe, car l'angle change constamment.

description:
Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Risk Manager

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung
- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten
- Du übernimmst Coaching / Weiterbildungsaufgaben im Risikomanagement sowie die Ausbildung von Nachwuchskräften

Profil:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (auch berufsintegriertes) Studium mit der Fachrichtung Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Rechtswissenschaften, idealerweise im Schwerpunkt Risikomanagement
- Langjährige fachbezogene Berufserfahrung im Bereich Risikomanagement eines Asset-Managers, eines Fondsemissionshauses oder eines Kreditinstitutes,
- Umfassende Kenntnisse und mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Assetklasse Infrastructure, idealerweise auch in Private Equity und Debt Strukturen. Grundkenntnisse und Interesse an den Assetklassen Renewable Energies, sowie Real Estate runden Deine Erfahrung ab.
- Erweiterte betriebswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse insbesondere im Bereich Risikomanagement, Bilanzanalyse, Discounted Cash-Flow-Analyse, Sensitivitätsanalyse, Cash-Flow-Modellierung, Liquiditätsrisikomanagement und Portfoliosteuerung
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze bzgl. AIFMD, u.a.)
- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr sicherer Umgang mit MS Office
- Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, idealerweise auch gute Französischkenntnisse
- Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Hohes Maß an Zielstrebigkeit und Eigeninitiative sowie unternehmerisches Denken und Flexibilität

Sur un marché en constant/ante évolution, le Groupe Foyer reste fidèle à ses valeurs : Confiance, Excellence, Innovation, Intégrité et Indépendance. Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, nous recherchons un(e) Conseiller Clientèle pour renforcer notre agence relais. Véritable ambassadeur de notre entreprise, vous êtes le premier point de contact de nos clients. Vous traitez leurs demandes relatives aux contrats, à l'encaissement et aux sinistres, identifiez leurs besoins et proposez des solutions d'assurance adaptées. Grâce à votre sens du service et à votre expertise, vous contribuez à leur satisfaction, à leur fidélisation ainsi qu'au développement du portefeuille de l'agence. Une expérience dans le secteur des assurances constitue un atout Vous maîtrisez le luxembourgeois, le français, l'allemand et l'anglais Vous possédez ou êtes prêt(e) à obtenir l'agrément d'agent d'assurances durant votre période d'essai Vous disposez d'excellentes qualités relationnelles et d'une forte orientation client Vous avez un sens aigu du service et veillez à offrir une expérience de qualité à chaque interaction Vous faites preuve d'organisation, de rigueur et d'autonomie dans la gestion de vos dossiers Vous possédez de bonnes connaissances générales et êtes à l'aise avec les outils informatiques courants. Nous offrons Un contrat à durée indéterminée au sein d'un groupe solide et reconnu Une fonction variée combinant conseil, gestion administrative et relation client Un environnement de travail stimulant et orienté vers le développement des compétences Une équipe dynamique et collaborative Des opportunités de formation et d'évolution professionnelle Un package salarial attractif complété par des avantages extra-légaux. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? L'opportunité d'exercer une fonction clé au contact direct des clients Un métier riche alliant conseil, accompagnement et développement commercial La possibilité de développer votre expertise dans le secteur de l'assurance Une entreprise qui valorise l'autonomie, l'engagement et l'esprit d'équipe L'opportunité de contribuer activement à la satisfaction et à la fidélisation de nos clients.

title: Cartographe (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? La Bibliothèque nationale du Luxembourg (BnL) s'engage dans un nouveau programme visant à améliorer l'accessibilité de ses collections, en particulier celles des Fonds spéciaux, qui abritent des trésors patrimoniaux uniques : cartes historiques, plans, atlas, vues topographiques et documents cartographiques rares. Avec cartes et plans couvrant des représentations du monde, du Luxembourg et de ses territoires, cette collection se distingue comme l'une des plus remarquables du pays. Pourtant, cette collection reste non cataloguée, donc inaccessible en ligne. La BnL cherche à renforcer l'équipe patrimoniale avec un expert polyvalent, capable de gérer des tâches complexes liées à la préservation et à l'accessibilité du patrimoine. Missions Catalogage et valorisation des collections: Enrichir les métadonnées, référencer, cataloguer, indexer et exemplariser les documents des Fonds spéciaux, surtout les cartes, plans, atlas, vues, selon les normes en vigueur (SIGB Alma, RDA, Rameau, DDC); Structurer les critères de collection pour les documents cartographiques, en collaboration avec l'équipe patrimoniale; Établir une charte d'acquisition et une politique de conservation adaptées aux spécificités des fonds cartographiques; Contrôler la cohérence du développement du Fonds des cartes, plans et atlas, en veillant à son alignement avec les objectifs stratégiques de la BnL. Gestion et accessibilité numérique: Piloter la numérisation des collections cartographiques; Valoriser les collections à l'aide des nouvelles technologies (humanités numériques, outils de recherche scientifique) pour en faciliter l'accès au public et aux chercheurs; Collaborer avec les services IT pour intégrer les données cartographiques dans les plateformes numériques de la BnL (eluxemburgensia). Conservation et expertise: Assurer la préservation des documents (conditions de stockage, restauration si nécessaire); Participer à des projets de recherche en lien avec les collections, en collaboration avec des institutions nationales ou internationales. Profil Compétences techniques Expérience avérée en: Catalogage de documents patrimoniaux (normes RDA, Rameau, DDC); Gestion de SIGB (idéalement Alma); Numérisation et valorisation de collections spéciales; Maîtrise des outils de traitement d'images, de métadonnées et de bases de données bibliographiques; Connaissances en conservation préventive des documents anciens et fragiles; Rigueur et précision : capacité à travailler avec des documents uniques et parfois fragiles; Esprit d'initiative : proposition de solutions innovant/antes pour améliorer l'accessibilité des collections; Collaboration : travail en équipe avec les autres services de la BnL (patrimoine, IT, communication); Sens de la médiation : aptitude à rendre les collections compréhensibles et attractives pour le public. Compétences comportementales Conceptualiser : Vous pensez de façon abstraite à l'aide de concepts, vous modélisez et simulez le futur pour concevoir des solutions réalistes; Gérer les activités : Vous gérez les activités courant/antes au travers d'objectifs opérationnels clairs, vous gérez les ressources et suivez la mise en oeuvre des activités; Soutenir : Vous agissez comme référence, vous accompagnez les collègues, vous les guidez et les soutenez en stimulant la coopération autour de l'objectif commun; Conseiller : Vous fournissez des conseils et développez une relation de confiance basée sur votre crédibilité, vous faites des recommandations dans l'intérêt de l'organisation et du client-usager; Faire preuve d'ouverture : Vous êtes ouvert au changement et à l'innovation, vous vous ouvrez à la diversité et vous vous intéressez à d'autres disciplines que les vôtres; Gérer le stress : Vous gardez votre calme face à la pression, vous restez constructif face à la critique et vous agissez de façon constant/ante malgré les difficultés; S'autodévelopper : Vous vous remettez en question de façon régulier/ière, vous apprenez de vos erreurs et vous apprenez continuellement; S'impliquer : Vous vous engagez pour générer des résultats, vous assumez la responsabilité et la qualité des actions entreprises, vous vous engagez pour le bien commun. Atouts Connaissance du contexte luxembourgeois (histoire, géographie, institutions culturelles); Expérience dans la gestion de projets liés au patrimoine ou à la numérisation. Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut du fonctionnaire de l'État ou de l'employé de l'État. Il est ouvert au changement d'administration des fonctionnaires. Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission : Pour devenir fonctionnaire de l'État Pour changer d'administration en tant que fonctionnaire Pour devenir employé de l'État. We are looking for a Lead Buyer (m/f/d) for our Procurement team

As a Lead Buyer reporting to the Procurement Manager, you will play a key role in supporting and developing the procurement function at KPMG Luxembourg. You will be responsible for managing end-to-end sourcing and purchasing activities across your assigned procurement categories while working closely with internal stakeholders to understand business needs and deliver value through strategic procurement initiatives.
In this role, you will contribute to the development of purchasing strategies, supplier optimization initiatives and cost-saving opportunities. You will also ensure compliance with procurement policies, maintain strong supplier relationships and support the continuous evolution of the procurement function.

What you will be working on

• Propose and develop purchasing strategies for assigned procurement categories.
• Analyze spend allocation, supplier portfolios and procurement opportunities.
• Develop short-, medium- and long-term action plans including spend optimization, contract renewal strategies, supplier rationalization and risk mitigation initiatives.
• Participate in defining savings targets and identifying opportunities for improvement.
• Identify, evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost and reliability.
• Lead sourcing activities including RFPs, RFQs and supplier negotiations.
• Manage purchase orders and monitor delivery performance.
• Build and maintain strong supplier relationships and monitor supplier performance.
• Ensure compliance with procurement policies, internal controls and regulatory requirements.
• Prepare procurement reports and contribute to cost control initiatives.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders and provide guidance regarding procurement processes and procedures.

What we look for

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Logistics or a related field.
• Several years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, purchasing or supply chain management.
• Experience in supplier sourcing, contract negotiation and supplier relationship management.
• Good understanding of procurement processes, sourcing methodologies and procurement best practices.
• Ability to identify cost-saving opportunities and drive procurement efficiencies.
• Experience working with procurement systems and ERP tools (SAP, Oracle, Coupa or similar).
• Strong analytical and reporting skills, including advanced Excel capabilities.
• Excellent stakeholder management, communication and negotiation skills.
• Ability to build collaborative relationships and influence outcomes across the organization.
• Fluent English is required; French is considered an asset.

What you will get

We offer more than just a job. With our flexible work model, you can work, rest and recharge. Our competitive compensation packages, paid time off, recognition bonuses and dedicated programs for personal development and well-being help to keep you refreshed and motivated.

title: Senior Business Development Manager - Multi Family Offices & Professional Intermediaries (M/F)
description:
Senior Business Development Manager - Multi Family Offices & Professional Intermediaries (M/F)
Luxembourg
req786
Save Job

Founded in 1856, Banque Internationale à Luxembourg is the oldest multi-business bank in the Grand Duchy. From its foundation, the BIL has always played an active role in the development of the Luxembourg economy. It currently operates in retail, private and corporate banking, as well as on major capital markets. Employing more than 2 000 people, BIL is present in the financial hotspots that are Luxembourg, Switzerland, and China.

As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Business Developer to join our team, focusing on Multi/Single Family Offices & Professional Intermediaries. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying and cultivating relationships with professional intermediaries and clients, driving business growth, and ensuring the delivery of exceptional service. The position is based in Luxembourg and you will report to the Head of Multi Family Offices & Professional Intermediaries.

Your next challenge:

• Contribute to the growth strategy and to the development of the value proposition of the bank
• Conduct research to identify business opportunities with new customers
• Develop a growth strategy, foster and build both long-term and trustworthy customer relationships with professional intermediaries, including law firms, fiduciaries, and family offices (B2B and B2C)
• Maintain an extensive knowledge of the current market conditions to detect and/or anticipate possible commercial opportunities for the customers
• Collaborate across business lines to help you develop new business leads
• Attend and coordinate events (seminars, conferences)
• Make use of the internal CRM to keep track on your business development activities

Your skills:

• Minimum of 10 years of experience in a front function within the banking or financial services sector
• A strong international network of MFO/SFO & Professional Intermediaries
• Strong analytical skills, particularly in KYC/AML compliance
• Solid understanding of wealth structuring, wealth management product and services
• Excellent interpersonal skills, an entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to build sustainable relationships
• Proven negotiation skills and the ability to close deals
• A high level of integrity and ethics
• Strong analytical skills, particularly in KYC/AML compliance.
• A relevant University background in Finance
• Fluent in English and French, any other language is seen as an advantage (for example : German, Italian)
• Strongly client- and results-oriented
• Rigorous, organized and methodical in customer approach actions
• Motivated to be part of a great team
• Willing and able to travel

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

• Execute and monitor financial market transactions, ranging from day-to-day Nostro cash optimisation to longer-dated interest rate swaps used to hedge the bank against adverse market moves.
• Validate and challenge risk and P&L reporting, working closely with Market Risk Management, Finance and Group Treasury Head Office.
• Contribute to transformation initiatives, including changes to the Target Operating Model, system migrations and future book integrity.
• Support colleagues across the bank in understanding interest rate risk, IRRBB requirements and treasury architecture by translating technical concepts into clear business messages.

In other words, you strive to bring fresh ideas to life and embrace challenges in a fast changing and complex environment. • Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in banking, treasury, financial markets or interest rate risk management.
• Strong experience with Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book (IRRBB) and related mechanics.

description:
Information Security Officer

About Luxtrust

We are a multicultural and forward-thinking qualiﬁed Trust Services Provider based in Capellen, Luxembourg, with over 110 professionals and actively expanding our business internationally. Join us in our mission to drive innovation and co-create a better future!

We are currently looking for a motivated and driven Information Security Officer.

Summary

This role contributes to improve IT security controls effectiveness, increase ISMS process maturity and keep IT risks exposure under accepted level by assisting the Chief Information Security Officer in its missions.

Missions of the role

• Security Operation activities such as vulnerability management; threats monitoring; threat prevention (phishing tentative, SIEM alerts) and log review. Improve threat detection capabilities by reviewing SIEM use cases on a regular basis in closed collaboration with our SOC partner.
• The security recurring controls annual plan such as access right reviews, suppliers due diligence, Supplier Review Meetings, hardening guide and CIS conformity audits of IT.
• Involved in penetration-testing campaign on corporate environment. Defines pen-testing scope, prepare and coordinate pen-testers activities, review pen-testing results with IT department and manage recommendations action plan.
• LuxTrust security controls: contribute to annual supplier due diligence assessment, represent department in the Compliance and audit exercises and maintain our security controls documentation accordingly.
• Security incident: Involved in security Incident review, problem review and associated KPIs / KRIs reporting.
• Contribute to an ongoing, proactive risk assessment program for all new and existing systems in our corporate environment and ensure that effective controls to manage these risks are in place against the company's goals and business processes.
• Participate in Audit ISO27001 and any other audits applicable to LuxTrust entities.
• Manages security awareness annual program.
• Implements security improvements by assessing current situation; evaluating trends; anticipating requirements; evaluation security incidents.
•  Provide Information Security advisory to both IT and Business units by assisting Legal, Compliance and Sales teams in due diligence exercises, new process flow or use cases and any security questions. Lead supplier due diligence assessment for the security aspects.
•  Maintain and improve ISMS documentation based on knowledge of best practices, regulatory requirements and specific needs of LuxTrust. Involved in procedures development and maintain it on annual basis. Participate to the Policy/Standards document review.
•  Assist the IT team in performing risk assessment related to technology implementation :
o Perform research and coordination with IT to drive security
o Perform research and recommendation of appropriate security protection products and services, such as log management, security event management, and intrusion detection
•  Project management of any related project.

Required skills

Qualifications / diploma(s): Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Information Security or related experience.

Years of experience in the area:

• Experience in developing, documenting and maintaining policies, processes, procedures and standards
• Prior security audit experience would be an asset
• Knowledge of and experience in understanding documentation and regulatory compliance requirements is an asset.

Technical competencies:

• Skills and knowledge of IT, networks and Information security business
• PKI knowledge is an asset

Languages: French and English fluent. Any other language is an asset.

Specific skills:

• Strong analytical skills to analyze information security requirements and relate them to appropriate controls
• Organized, responsive, accountable and highly thorough of problem solving oriented and solution driven
• Ability to synthesize
• Proactive attitude
• Good team player and positive attitude in a challenging environment
• Strong communication and writing skills
• Foster teamwork and collaboration

Core competencies at LuxTrust:

• Analytical mindset & decision making
• Organizational fluency
• Personal effectiveness
• Results-driven
• Client service mindset
• Strategic vision
• Leadership

What we offer

• A competitive salary, in accordance with your education and experience.
• Attractive benefits and advantages including an employee benefit plan, a gym, meal vouchers and additional holidays.
• A healthy work-life balance including flex work arrangements.

title: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems (m/f)
description:
Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems

Position: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette, Luxembourg
Start Date: Immediate
Type: Full-time

Company Overview

We're LuxQuantum, a Luxembourg-based deep-tech startup developing the next generation of quantum-safe communication systems.

Our mission is to address one of the key challenges in modern cybersecurity: how to combine Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) into a unified, adaptive, and scalable security architecture.

At LuxQuantum, we believe security decisions should not be static. Different data, infrastructures, risks, trust assumptions, and operational conditions may require different protection strategies. That's why we are developing intelligent and adaptive approaches to model these complex environments and support dynamic security and orchestration decisions.

Our work brings together AI, systems modeling, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications, creating research challenges that span multiple scientific and engineering disciplines.

We are a small and ambitious team of researchers, engineers, and innovators who enjoy exploring difficult problems, learning across disciplines, and turning research ideas into real-world technology.

Role Overview

As a Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer, you will contribute to the research and development of the intelligence and decision-making capabilities behind LuxQuantum's adaptive quantum-safe security systems.

You will investigate how complex security and communication systems can adapt to changing risks, uncertainty, trust requirements, infrastructure conditions, and operational constraints. Your work may involve mathematical and computational modeling, optimization, probabilistic methods, AI, or other data-driven and decision-support approaches.

You will work closely with our research and engineering team to formulate research problems, explore and compare different approaches, develop models and algorithms, evaluate them through experiments and simulations, and translate promising results into working prototypes.

The research sits at the intersection of systems modeling, intelligent decision-making, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications.

What You'll Do

• Investigate challenging research problems in intelligent and adaptive security systems
• Formulate research questions, develop new approaches, and design experiments and simulations to evaluate them
• Develop mathematical, computational, and AI-based models for decision-making under uncertainty, risk, and changing operational conditions
• Explore adaptive approaches for the orchestration and optimization of hybrid quantum-safe systems
• Design and evaluate methods that help security systems dynamically respond to changing infrastructure, trust, and operational requirements
• Translate research ideas, models, and algorithms into working prototypes and validate them in realistic scenarios
• Collaborate closely with researchers and engineers across software, AI, cybersecurity, and quantum technologies
• Contribute to the technical direction, architecture, and documentation of LuxQuantum's research and development activities

What We're Looking For

• PhD in a quantitative, scientific, engineering, or computing-related field; or a Master's degree with strong relevant research or R&D experience
• Strong research and analytical abilities, with the capacity to investigate complex problems, develop new approaches, and evaluate them systematically
• Experience with quantitative, computational, modeling, optimization, AI/ML, or related research methods
• Good programming and computational skills in one or more languages such as Python, C++, Rust, or similar
• Ability to translate research ideas, mathematical models, or algorithms into working prototypes
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a small multidisciplinary team
• Curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn and work across different technical domains
• Understanding of startup environments and research-driven innovation
• Fluent written and verbal communication in English

We welcome candidates from different scientific, engineering, and computational backgrounds, including PhD graduates, postdoctoral researchers, and researchers interested in transitioning from academia to industrial R&D. Prior experience in quantum technologies or quantum-safe cybersecurity is welcome but not required.

Nice to Have

Experience in any of the following is a plus, but not required:

• Cybersecurity, risk modeling, or security-related systems

description:

Time type Full time

Arendt & Medernach is the leading independent business law firm in Luxembourg with over 800 professionals. The firm's international team of more than 450 legal experts represents Luxembourg and foreign clients in all areas of Luxembourg business law from its main office in Luxembourg and representative offices in Frankfurt, Hong Kong, London, New York, and Paris.

Our service to clients is differentiated by the end-to-end specialist advice we offer, covering all legal, regulatory, taxation, and advisory aspects of doing business in Luxembourg.

Our firm advises international and domestic clients in all areas of business law relevant to their business activities, ranging from fund formation, banking, insurance, private equity, and real estate to corporate and tax matters.

Given the ongoing development of our firm, we are currently recruiting:
‎
Group Financial Controller

As the Group continues to expand geographically, we are creating a new Group Financial Controller position to strengthen the Finance function and support the increasing complexity of an international law firm environment. Reporting directly to the CFO, the role will help build scalable financial governance, robust reporting, and efficient processes across the Group, with a particular focus on foreign offices.
The successful candidate will play a central role in developing the financial infrastructure required to support the Group's international growth, ensuring reliable financial information, strengthening compliance with laws and regulations, and establishing a consistent reporting and control framework. The role will also act as the single Finance point of contact for the partner responsible for the Group's foreign offices.

Your role:

Treasury Management

• Lead and oversee treasury management activities, supported by one full-time team member, including cash flow monitoring, liquidity planning, banking relationships, and related controls.
Financial reporting & consolidation
• Review monthly accounting close activities and ensure the timely and accurate preparation of monthly management reporting across the Group, with a particular focus on foreign offices.
• Implement the group financial consolidation process, including methodology, timetable, reporting framework, and quality controls.

Compliance

• Ensure compliance with all applicable local laws and regulations, including accounting, statutory, and tax obligations.
• Review and redesign the Group's transfer pricing policies, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and evolving business operations.

Internal controls/process

• Optimise finance and accounting processes across the Group, with a particular focus on foreign offices, to improve efficiency, reliability, and scalability.
• Contribute to the development of internal controls, policies, and procedures to support a robust finance governance framework.

Stakeholder & External Provider Management

• Manage relationships with external service providers, including accountants, tax advisers, auditors and other finance-related partners.
• Act as the key Finance contact for the partner responsible for foreign offices, providing financial insight, coordination, and support on cross-border matters.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders across offices to ensure consistent financial processes, reporting standards, and information flows.

Your profile:

• Qualified finance professional, ideally with a degree in finance, accounting, audit, or a related discipline.
• Proven ability to supervise, guide, and develop at least one finance team member while remaining hands-on in day-to-day financial operations.
• Significant experience in financial control, audit or group reporting, preferably in a professional services, law firm, or multi-entity international environment.
• Experience with treasury management, tax compliance, transfer pricing, and financial consolidation in a multi-GAAP environment.
• Strong understanding of internal controls, process improvement, and finance governance frameworks.
• Hands-on, structured, and pragmatic mindset, with the ability to build processes in a newly created role.
• Experience in cross-functional roles, with the ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across offices and seniority levels.
• Excellent communication skills in English; French would be an advantage.
• High standards of integrity, discretion, and professionalism, consistent with a law firm environment.
‎
Within Arendt, we uphold high standards. Our professionals work with clients on engaging projects, empowered from the start. With a strong local presence in Luxembourg and international reach, we support and train our team members to thrive in a culture of excellence. Specialised teams ensure the right skills are available, allowing for a focus on added value. Our leaders are approachable, providing support and mentoring.

We offer a vibrant social life with numerous events, embracing sports and art, our culture encourages openness and discovery beyond the professional realm. With over 50 nationalities represented, Arendt is committed to the well-being of its staff, serving the best interests of its clients, protecting the environment, and supporting education.

Arendt promotes equal opportunities and value each employee for what they bring to the community. For more information, please refer to our diversity and inclusion policy on our website.

All applications will be treated confidentially.

• Ability to synthesize

• Good team player and positive attitude in a challenging environment
• Strong communication and writing skills

• Organizational fluency

title: Sr. Program Manager, Inbound Strategy, Long Term Network Planning (m/f)
description:
Sr. Program Manager, Inbound Strategy, Long Term Network Planning
Job ID: 10498640 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Amazon's Inbound Long Term Planning team owns the topology framework that decides what the EU inbound network looks like in 2–3 years: which node types we build, where we place them, how they interact, and what inventory configuration they unlock. This role owns a critical slice of that framework - taking speed ambitions and placement targets and working backwards into the physical network design across 1DCs, RDCs, and IXDs that makes them achievable. It's the kind of problem where getting the answer right saves hundreds of millions of dollars; getting it wrong means we either over-invest or structurally cap our speed ceiling for years.

You'll work at the intersection of network topology, inventory science, and capital allocation - partnering deeply with Finance, IIPO, AIM, and business teams to determine the optimal long-term node configuration that delivers placement targets per outbound node type and selection cohort. This is a single-threaded role with high ambiguity and regular exposure to senior leadership across SCOT, Operations, and Finance.

Key Job Responsibilities

- Own the long-term inbound topology framework - determine the optimal combination of node types, locations, and capacities that achieves placement targets at minimum total cost.

- Define network configuration per selection cohort - decide velocity demarcations between node types, regional zoning, and upstream storage share. Know when the model breaks and why.
- Build the multi-year inbound build plan - sequence node launches, size them against volume trajectories, and own the placement and inventory commitments that justify the investment.
- Resolve structural trade-offs that don't have clean owners. Frame options, quantify impact, and drive decisions when priorities across teams or geographies conflict.
- Align senior leadership to  single answer. Write the strategy documents that SCOT, Finance, IIPO, and Operations commit to. When priorities diverge, you reconcile.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in program or project management
- Experience in supply chain
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Experience leading process improvements

description:
ADEM DECLARATION OF VACANT POSITION AND JOB DESCRIPTION
General Counsel YIO S.à r.l., Luxembourg

JOB DESCRIPTION

Group General Counsel

Employer: YIO S.à r.l., Luxembourg.

Reporting line: Chief Executive Officer, with dotted reporting line to the Board.
Contract: permanent, full-time (40 hours per week). Location: Luxembourg, hybrid, with regular international
travel.

1 The business and the role

The company operates an international online subscription and creator platform, with exposure to adult content, and which operates across the United Kingdom, the European Union and the US. The Group General Counsel is the most senior legal officer of the group.

2 Main responsibilities

1. Legal function leadership and Board support
• Build, staff and lead the group legal function, including recruitment, budget, external counsel panel and legal operations.
• Act as principal legal adviser to the Board, the founders and the executive team, and attend Board and committee meetings.
• Set and own the group's legal risk appetite, escalation framework and legal reporting to the Board and to investors.
• Manage disputes and litigation across jurisdictions, including instruction and supervision of external counsel.
2. Corporate, M&A and governance
• Lead corporate and M&A transactions end to end, including target assessment, due diligence, transaction documentation, signing, closing and PMI.
• Support fundraising rounds, investor documentation, shareholder arrangements and cap table matters.
• Own corporate governance across a multi-jurisdictional holding structure, including entity management, board and shareholder resolutions, statutory filings, registers of beneficial owners, delegated authority frameworks and group policies.
• Act as secretary to the Board and to group entity boards, or supervise that function.
• Coordinate with finance and tax on group structuring, intragroup agreements, transfer pricing documentation and substance requirements.
3. Data protection, artificial intelligence and digital regulation
• Own the group's data protection compliance programme under the EU GDPR and the UK GDPR, including records of processing, transfer mechanisms, data protection impact assessments, data subject rights, breach response and supervisory authority engagement.
• Advise on US privacy legislation applicable to the group's user base, including state level comprehensive privacy laws and applicable wiretapping and tracking technology claims.
• Own the group's artificial intelligence governance framework, including the classification of AI systems, transparency obligations for synthetic and AI generated content, model and vendor due diligence, training data and intellectual property questions, and readiness for the EU AI Act.
• Advise on the EU Digital Services Act and the UK Online Safety Act, including notice and action mechanisms, trusted flaggers, transparency reporting, risk assessment obligations, illegal content duties and children's access assessments.
• Advise on the EU Digital Markets Act, the audiovisual media services framework and platform to business regulation as applicable to the group's distribution channels.
4. High risk industry, trust and safety, and content compliance
• Advise on the legal and regulatory framework applicable to adult oriented and creator monetization platforms, including age assurance and identity verification, performer consent and record keeping obligations, nonconsensual intimate image takedown, CSAM prevention and reporting, and content moderation and appeals.
• Design and maintain creator terms, model releases, content licences, revenue share arrangements and agency and management arrangements.
• Advise on advertising, affiliate and performance marketing arrangements, influencer marketing rules and consumer protection requirements in the EU, the UK and the US.
• Manage intellectual property, including trademarks, copyright enforcement and anti-piracy programmes.
5. Payments, financial crime and sanctions
• Own the legal side of the group's payments stack, including acquirer and payment service provider agreements, alternative payment methods, payout and creator disbursement arrangements and merchant of record structures.
• Advise on card scheme rules as they apply to high risk and adult merchant categories, including high brand risk and integrity risk registration programmes, prohibited content rules, chargeback thresholds and remediation plans.
• Advise on PSD2 and strong customer authentication, electronic money and payment institution perimeter questions, and the implications of the EU instant payments and payment services reform.
• Own the group's KYC, AML, CTF and sanctions framework, including creator onboarding, transaction monitoring, and screening against EU, UK, US OFAC and other relevant measures. 6. Commercial and employment
• Negotiate the group's material commercial agreements, including technology, content, distribution, partnership and vendor agreements.
• Support the people function on employment law across multiple jurisdictions, including contracts, contractor classification, incentive schemes and internal investigations.

3 Required profile

The following are requirements (must-haves):
• Law degree from an EU or EEA or UK university.
• Admission in good standing to the bar of an EU or EEA Member State or UK.
• A minimum of 20 years of PQE legal experience, of which at least 10 years in a senior in house legal leadership role (General Counsel, Head of Legal or equivalent).
• Demonstrable experience of building and leading an international in house legal team across diverse jurisdictions.
• A track record of leading cross border M&A transactions in the US, UK and/or EU jurisdictions.
• Corporate governance experience in complex international structures.
• Recognised privacy certification (IAPP CIPP/E or equivalent) and hands on ownership of a GDPR compliance programme.
• Direct working knowledge of the EU/UK digital regulatory framework, including DSA, DMA, OSA, the AI Act, AVMS.
• Substantive experience in high risk regulated industries, and specifically in adult entertainment or creator platform compliance.
• Substantive experience of payment processing and billing for high-risk merchant categories.
• Experience in entertainment and media.
• Tax, KYC/AML and sanctions experience in a regulated or high risk environment.
• Experience advising founders, C level executives and Boards in a venture backed, high growth environment.
• English at level C (native/bilingual/proficient user).

The following are advantages (nice to haves):
• Postgraduate business qualification (MBA or equivalent).
• Formal training or certification in AI
• Recognised corporate governance certification (e.g. ILA CGO).
• Qualification or formal training in international taxation and in corporate compliance.
• Experience of a Luxembourg holding structure and of Luxembourg corporate and employment law.
• Additional languages, in particular Spanish, French, Portuguese, German or Luxembourgish.
• Prior experience in a matrix organisation or in the country or regional unit of a multinational group.

4 Personal attributes

• Commercial and pragmatic. Comfortable taking a risk-based position and defending it to the Board.
• Comfortable operating hands on in a lean team while also delegating and developing others.
• Able to work across cultures and time zones, and to hold credibility with founders, investors, regulators and counterparties.
• Willing to work in a business whose content categories include adult material.

title: Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish) Online game presenter Malta!
description:
Do you want to get away from the dark winter in Sweden or cold part of europe? Here is your chance!!

Are you service-minded and want to work abroad?

Are you passionate about being on camera?

Do you want to become the star of your own Game Show?

We are looking for Game Presenters who want to work in a fast-paced and international work environment for our studio in Malta. As a Game Presenter, you will spend most of your working day in front of the camera leading the game and interacting with the players. The job will help you grow your presentation techniques and your ability to multitask. As a Game Presenter / Host, you will take presenting to an entirely different level. You will be engaging in bubbly, robust, and interactive conversations with your players on the table, taking player experience to new heights, not just through your energy and personality but also your ability to entertain.

We do not require any specific previous work experience, but we want you to have worked at least part-time for a year or two, preferably with service-related tasks. We also require that you are fluent in the Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish) language and that you have a conversational level of English. You will spend the first three weeks of your employment with us in our Academy where you will be taught how to lead a game of Blackjack and Roulette as well as how to act in front of the camera.

Apart from a work experience that can give you valuable professional skills for a future career, moving to Malta to work for us provides you with an opportunity for personal growth. For many of our team members in Malta, this is their first experience of living abroad on their own. In addition, we broadcast in 18 languages from our Malta studio and there are more than 40 different nationalities in our teams, so the work environment we offer in Malta is truly dynamic and international.

We offer you:

    Relocation package (flight and accommodation for the first 20 nights - if applicable)
    Monthly bonuses; based on performance, team player attitude and loyalty
    Up to 3 weeks of training in our Academy
    Free Gym Membership
    Workshops in things like; make-up, healthy living, presentation skills and industry knowledge
    Night shift taxi drop off service

Qualifications

To apply you need to be:

    Fluent in Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish), working knowledge of English is essential
    Service-minded with good communications skills
    A fast-learner
    A flexible team player
    Professional, mature and with a natural ability to follow work rules
    An entertainer at heart
    Excellent customer service skills
    Manage Player expectations and behavior
    Minimum 18 years old

Please note that you need to have valid travel documents and that we will ask you to provide a valid Police Conduct Certificate and a written statement from your last employer.

Send your CV to viktorrecruit@gmail.com

title: Machinist
description:
- About Brans - Your partner
BBL training in machining at Brans Metaalbewerking
Learn a technical trade and work directly in practice
Would you like to work in a technical field and get a diploma at the same time? The BBL machining course at Brans Metaalbewerking combines learning and working.
You will gain practical experience in our modern workshop and attend classes one day a week to learn the theory.
This is how you will quickly grow into a skilled machinist.
What is a BBL training program?
BBL stands for Beroeps Begeleidende Leerweg. This is an apprenticeship in which you will: -
Works four days a week at Brans Metalworking -
Attends school one day a week -
Receive a salary during your training
You immediately apply the theory you learn at school in practice. As a result, you learn faster and understand the subject better.
What does machining involve?
Machining involves using tools contained in a (CNC) machine to remove material in a controlled manner until you have created a nice product that has the desired shape and size. The pieces of material removed are also called "chips" (shavings).
Metalworking is a beautiful and interesting profession in which you are busy making a top product from a starting material for your customer. You start by making a drawing or a step file (3D model) using Cad/Cam software to program as many operations as possible (drilling, tapping, milling, deburring) in one go on your CNC machine. Then you put the tools in the machine and start machining the product. BBL opleiding verspanen bij Brans Metaalbewerking
What will you learn during the course?
During your BBL trajectory at Brans Metaalbewerking you will develop step by step the skills you need as a machinist: -
Reading and understanding technical drawings so you know exactly what needs to be made. -

title: Onderhoudstechnieker
description:
Ben jij een techneut die energie krijgt van perfect draaiende machines? Iemand die begrijpt hoe robots, lasers en software naadloos samenwerken — en die graag de regie neemt over een geavanceerd machinepark?

Voor een innovatieve en snelgroeiende productieorganisatie zoeken wij een Maintenance Engineer die wil meebouwen aan de toekomst van slimme maakindustrie. Je krijgt volop ruimte om te pionieren, te optimaliseren en jouw ideeën in de praktijk te brengen. Geen stroperige besluitvorming, maar korte lijnen en zichtbare impact.

Klinkt dit als jouw volgende uitdaging? Lees dan verder.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Maintenance Engineer ben jij eindverantwoordelijk voor het optimaal functioneren van een modern en geautomatiseerd machinepark. Jij zorgt ervoor dat alles blijft draaien — en steeds beter gaat draaien.

Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Preventief onderhoud optimaliseren
  • Je ontwikkelt en bewaakt een slimme onderhoudsstrategie om stilstand tot een minimum te beperken.
  • Storingen analyseren en oplossen
  • Je spoort technische problemen op binnen elektrotechniek, mechatronica en besturingstechniek, en zorgt voor duurzame oplossingen.
  • Continu verbeteren en innoveren
  • Je signaleert kansen voor automatisering en optimalisatie en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteringen.
  • Samenwerken met externe partners
  • Je schakelt met leveranciers en machinebouwers en bewaakt kwaliteit, planning en afspraken.
  • Zorgen voor een veilige werkomgeving
  • Je draagt actief bij aan een veilige en efficiënte werkplek voor jezelf en je collega’s.

Wat breng je mee?

Je bent een praktische en oplossingsgerichte techneut met een passie voor innovatie. Je combineert analytisch vermogen met een hands-on mentaliteit.

Daarnaast heb je:

  • HBO/Professionele bachelor werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur richting Mechatronica, Elektrotechniek of Besturingstechniek
  • Brede technische kennis en interesse in zowel hardware als software
  • Affiniteit met automatisering, robotica en moderne productietechnologie
  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en een proactieve houding
  • De drive om eigenaarschap te nemen en continu te verbeteren

Je voert de eindcontrole van de installatie uit en werkt eventuele restpunten weg, samen met je collega’s. Of het werk nu mechanisch of elektrotechnisch is: jij pakt het probleemloos op. Daarnaast stel je de regeltechniek van het gebouwbeheerssysteem (GBS) correct in en zorg je dat de installatie optimaal functionerend aan de klant wordt opgeleverd. Je communiceert gemakkelijk met zowel klanten als collega’s. Ook het rapporteren van de uitgevoerde werkzaamheden en het geven van adviezen om processen en prestaties verder te verbeteren, vormen een belangrijk onderdeel van je functie. Arbeidsvoorwaarden Een marktconform salaris met een goed arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket volgens de CAO Bouw & Infra. Een prettige werksfeer binnen een gezond, dynamisch bedrijf met een goede naamsbekendheid, waarbinnen mensen zeer belangrijk zijn. Heel Nederland als werkgebied. Functie-eisen Een MBO 3/4 diploma in de richting Energietechniek, Werktuigbouwkunde, Elektrotechniek of Mechatronica. Kennis van Priva (gebouwbeheersystemen) is een pre. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden. Analytisch vermogen. Proactieve en oplossingsgerichte werkhouding. In staat om zelfstandig te werken. Hier kom je te werken Je werkt bij een organisatie die duurzame oplossingen realiseert en daarmee letterlijk het verschil maakt. Al ruim 125 jaar ligt de specialisatie in grondboringen, drinkwater, grondwaterwinning en bodemenergieopslag voor onder meer industrie, drinkwaterbedrijven en utiliteitsbouw. Vanuit de vestiging in Dedemsvaart wordt het volledige traject rond grondwater verzorgd: van ontwerp en installatie tot onderhoud en service, alles onder één dak. Werken hier betekent onderdeel zijn van een hecht bedrijf met vakmensen die trots zijn op hun werk. Dankzij een onafhankelijke organisatiestructuur, waarbij medewerker

via een stichting mede-eigenaar zijn, is de betrokkenheid groot en wordt er samen gebouwd aan de toekomst. Kennis en ervaring, gecombineerd met innovatie en samenwerking, maken deze organisatie tot een betrouwbare werkgever én een gewaardeerde partner binnen de wereld van grondwatertechniek.

title: Migrant Worker
description:
← Back to blog Blog How Do You Apply for Child Benefits or Allowances as a Migrant Worker?
24 November 2025 3 min read
If you work in the Netherlands and your children live here or in your home country, you may be entitled to child benefits or other allowances in some cases. This can be an important financial support for families living in the Netherlands or where a parent works here. But how does it work for migrant workers? And how do you apply for it? In this blog, Charlie works explains it step by step. Child Benefits in the Netherlands
Child benefits are a financial contribution from the Dutch government to help with the costs of raising children. This scheme is administered by the Social Insurance Bank (SVB) .
You are entitled to child benefits if: - You live or work in the Netherlands, - Your children are under 18 years old, - And you pay premiums for Dutch national insurance.
Even if your children live in another EU country, you may often be entitled to (partial) child benefits. This depends on your personal situation and whether your partner also works.
More information can be found at SVB - Child Benefits . How Do You Apply for Child Benefits?
If you work through Charlie works, you are usually automatically registered with the Dutch authorities. However, you must apply for child benefits yourself. Here's how: - Make sure you are registered with the municipality : You need a BSN (Citizen Service Number). - Create a DigiD : With DigiD, you can securely log in to government websites. Learn how it works at www.digid.nl . - Go to the SVB website : Log in via My SVB with your DigiD. - Fill in the child benefits application : Provide the details of your children, even if they live in another country.
After your application, you will receive a notification from the SVB. If you are entitled to child benefits, you will receive it four times a year. Other Allowances in the Netherlands

Climate change is one of the greatest challenges for global food security, requiring new approaches to understand and harness the natural diversity that enables plants and their associated microbiomes to adapt to environmental change. Ancient environmental DNA (eDNA) provides a unique record of past ecosystems, preserving genetic traces of microorganisms and plants that interacted with crops and their wild relatives over thousands of years. In this project, you will develop and apply computational omics approaches to uncover the molecular mechanisms underlying ancient plant-microbiome interactions, with a particular focus on biosynthetic gene clusters and other functional genes involved in chemical communication, defence, and adaptation. You will analyse large-scale ancient metagenomic datasets to identify and characterize microbial and plant-derived biosynthetic pathways, predict their ecological functions, and reconstruct the (co-)evolutionary dynamics of traits such as microbiome recruitment, metabolite-mediated interactions, pathogenicity and disease resistance. This will involve using and further adapting state-of-the-art genome mining approaches, including biosynthetic gene cluster identification, gene cluster family classification, and functional prediction, to work with highly fragmented and complex eDNA datasets.

The PhD Community at the Rudolf Agricola School is a vibrant network of 60 early-career researchers tackling the complex challenges of sustainable development from an inter- and transdisciplinary perspective. It provides a supportive space for collaboration and knowledge exchange.
