title: Technical Support Engineer to a Global Company in Västerås
description:
About the company

Our client is a global industrial company that creates products, solutions, and services within areas including automation and electrification. The group operates in more than 100 countries with over 100,000 employees worldwide. They develop technology that makes industries more efficient, more reliable, and that keeps the world running, every day.

At our client, you'll be part of an organisation where technical expertise, responsibility, and long-term thinking are at the centre. We're looking for people who take ownership and constantly strive to get better at what they do, in an environment with strong support, experienced colleagues, and the opportunity to develop over time.

About the role

As a Technical Support Engineer, you will work in the division working with high voltage rotating machines, ranging from motors and generators to synchronous condensers, for some of the world's most demanding industrial environments. The service organisation in Västerås is responsible for supporting the globally installed base of these machines.

In this role you'll be part of the technical support team and work closely with local service units, external customers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring a high level of service and professionalism in every interaction.

Key responsibilities

    

Provide technical support to local service units, external customers, and internal teams

    

Handle warranty cases for factory products, including technical investigations and root cause analysis

    

Manage and follow up on support cases in a shared case management system

    

Ensure cases and projects are handled in a structured, professional, and high-quality manner

    

Deliver clear and effective communication from both a technical and customer perspective

    

Contribute to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within the team

Who we're looking for

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving technical problems and communicating clearly with customers. To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

    

A vocational education in automation or other related field, or a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, automation, energy systems, or a similar field

    

Experience and knowledge of PLC programming, ideally function block programming

    

Knowledge of testing and troubleshooting

    

Good communication skills in English, as the role involves contact with customers and colleagues globally. Swedish is an advantage but not required

It's an advantage if you have

    

Previous experience in a technical role, preferably within testing and troubleshooting of electrical machines and control cabinets

    

Experience with systems such as Salesforce and SAP

Personal qualities

You're customer-focused and collaborative, with a strong service mindset, and thrive on handling demanding customer dialogues in a global environment. You're a natural team player who also takes initiative, with strong prioritisation skills and a level head when several cases are running in parallel. You're curious, solution-oriented, and genuinely interested in contributing to the team's continuous improvement work.

Practical information

Start: To be discussed Location: Västerås Scope: Full-time Employment: You will initially be employed by A-hub as a consultant, with the ambition of moving to direct employment with our client after 12 months

title: Breakfast and In-Room Dining Associate - Sheraton Stockholm Hotel
description:
Step into a role that redefines excellence at the Sheraton Stockholm Hotel, a hallmark of hospitality since 1971 in the heart of Sweden's bustling capital. Aligned with our innovative owners, Archer Hotel Management and Marriott International, we merge rich cultural history with modern luxury and a deep dedication to sustainability.  

We are now seeking a service-oriented Breakfast and In-Room Dining Associate to join our Food & Beverage team and contribute to delivering exceptional dining experiences for our guests. This position also includes responsibilities in room service and lunch service.

For this role, we are looking for someone who is reliable, guest-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced restaurant environment. You take pride in creating a welcoming atmosphere, enjoy working both independently and with a team, and are motivated by providing attentive, high-quality service that exceeds guest expectations.

As a Breakfast Service Associate, you will ensure that our guests begin their day with an outstanding breakfast experience. You will contribute to maintaining our dining areas, delivering personalized service, and upholding the hotel’s standards of quality and hospitality.

Main responsibilities:

    Welcome guests warmly and ensure they feel comfortable and informed about the breakfast buffet offerings.
    Deliver exceptional breakfast and private dining service while taking guest orders and ensuring timely in-room deliveries.
    Maintain the breakfast buffet throughout the service period, ensuring all items are consistently replenished, fresh, and attractively presented.
    Monitor buffet stations for cleanliness, food levels, and presentation, addressing any issues immediately.
    Prepare the restaurant for breakfast service, including setting up the buffet area, arranging tables, and organizing service stations.
    Clear and reset tables efficiently to ensure smooth guest flow.
    Assist guests with special dietary needs, questions about ingredients, and recommendations from the buffet selection.
    Brew and serve coffee, tea, and other beverages as needed.
    Work closely with the kitchen to communicate replenishment needs and ensure timely refills of food items.
    Maintain hygiene, safety, and food-handling standards at all times.
    Support the transition from breakfast to lunch setup when required.


Qualifications:

    Able to fluently communicate verbally in English. Fluency in Swedish is a plus.
    Previous experience in hospitality or a hotel is an advantage but not required.
    Positive attitude and genuine passion for providing excellent guest service.
    Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
    Strong teamwork and communication skills.
    Comfortable with physical work, including lifting and moving items.

In addition:
You are a reliable and service-oriented team player who enjoys working in a fast-paced, event-focused environment.


What We Offer:

    Full time and part time positions following a 6-month probation period, as well as extra positions, all in accordance with the HRF collective agreement.
    Chance of being part of one of the biggest renovation and re-positioning projects in Stockholm’s hotel scene.
    Great opportunities for career growth.
    A dynamic and inclusive work environment.
    Employee discounted rates at over 10 000 hotels worldwide.


Does this position sound interesting and like a good fit for you?

Selection and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the final application deadline, so please submit your application as soon as possible.

Join our team and play a key role in creating memorable experiences for our guests!

About Sheraton Stockholm Hotel
The Sheraton brand, established in 1937, has been synonymous with excellence in hospitality. The Sheraton Stockholm Hotel, opened in 1971 as the first international 5 star hotel in Stockholm, and it’s an icon in Sweden’s capital city. As part of Marriott International, Sheraton Stockholm Hotel is providing guests with thoughtful amenities, contemporary accommodation, and the best city center location. Our commitment to sustainability aligns with our owner Archer Hotel Managements ethos, making us a unique choice for conscientious travelers.

Redefining the Essence of Hospitality
We are at the end of our renovation journey at Sheraton Stockholm. This marks the beginning of our mission to redefine the essence of hospitality. We have transformed all our spaces, hotel rooms, implemented new food and beverage concepts and expanded our gym and wellness. As we embark on this transformation, we are seeking the best industry people to join our team.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Company description:

Who are we?Volvo Cars is a company on a mission; to bring traditional car manufacturing into a connected, sustainable and smart future.Since 1927, we have been a brand known for our commitment to safety, creating innovative cars that make life less complicated for our consumers. In 2010, we decided to transform our business, resulting in a totally new generation of cars and technologies, as well as steady growth and record sales. Today, we’re expanding our global footprint in Europe, China and the US, and we’re on the lookout for new talent. We are constantly pushing our own skills and abilities to drive change in the automobile industry like never before. We are looking for innovative, committed people to join us in this endeavour and create safe, sustainable and connected cars. We believe in the power of people and will challenge and support you to reach your full potential. Join us and be part of Volvo Cars’ journey into the future.

Job description:   Let's introduce ourselves  

The Head Unit Platform display teams in ConX are connecting Android to the hardware, i.e. develop device drivers, start-up/shut-down procedures, diagnostics/swdl, safety monitoring etc. They optimize and commonize code to be able to deliver the VCC sustainable platform to multiple new displays with speed.

     What you'll do  

Develop and integrate low-level software modules for current and upcoming Infotainment head units running the latest Android Automotive OS. We collaborate closely with our external suppliers and partners to achieve the goals.







Quality is assured by automated unit and integration tests as well as testing and troubleshooting in our prototype cars in the garage.

     What you'll bring  

You are a true developer who is motivated by challenging tasks, have a personal interest in technology and love to make the best software product out there. You enjoy learning from others, as well as sharing your knowledge with your colleagues. You like to see the whole picture and have an overall understanding of the complete system.







You are fluent in embedded C++ development and debugging with proven experience in developing software in Android Platform and an embedded Linux or QNX environment, preferably within automotive. Proven experience in QNX and/or device drivers is considered a plus.







You are a collaborative and responsible team player who considers what is best for the wider company and product. You have the confidence to speak up and trust your own expertise while remaining humble and open to the perspectives of others. You approach your work with an innovative but realistic mindset.







To succeed in the role, you communicate proactively to ensure progress, provide transparent status updates and can clearly explain software-design decisions. You are receptive to technical feedback and are comfortable reviewing colleagues’ code and providing constructive input.







You have experience from the automotive industry and are familiar with unit, component and manual testing, as well as test automation. You have worked in agile teams and are comfortable collaborating with stakeholders and external suppliers. You also have experience in software architecture and hardware-related development.








    QNX/Linux
    Drivers
    Serial communication
    Hardware specifications
    Object-oriented development
    C++
    Python
    Displays

title: Category Buyer for Professional services needed!
description:
Are you a commercially driven buyer looking for a strategic role in the fast-paced automotive industry? As Category Buyer, you will manage sourcing, supplier relationships, and negotiations across a range of professional services while helping drive value for a global organization.

About the position

Perido is looking for a Category Buyer for our client, an automobile company that brings mobility technology and solutions to satisfy the global demand for premium electric vehicles. The position is located in the office in Gothenburg.

Your daily tasks

In the role of Category Buyer for Services, you will manage sourcing and purchasing activities in accordance with company processes and policies for selected service categories, including HR services, facility services, legal services, and other professional services. The role includes developing category strategies, managing supplier relationships, and acting as a Purchasing Business Partner for designated departments. title: IAM Lead Architect
description:
As an IAM Lead Architect, you will play a key role in developing and driving our Identity and Access Management offering. You will become part of a dedicated team of specialists and consultants, covering both technical and GRC-focused areas, where you will lead and develop our capabilities and function within the field. The role primarily involves leading expertise, processes, and strategic initiatives, rather than having direct personnel management responsibility.

We welcome your ambition to help drive our IAM practice forward, both internally and in collaboration with our clients. In this role, you will combine strategic leadership, business understanding, and deep IAM expertise to create long-term value for our clients.

As an IAM Lead Architect, you will be responsible for further developing our capabilities in the field and supporting our clients on their strategic journey within Identity Governance, Access Management, and Privileged Access Management.

Examples of responsibilities

    

Drive and further develop our strategic IAM offering.

    

Act as an advisor to clients on IAM strategy, architecture, and technology selection.

Identify business opportunities and contribute to the development of our client offering within IAM.

Contribute to knowledge sharing, professional development, and the continued growth of the team.

    

Represent the IAM area both internally and externally by presenting solutions and strategic choices to clients and other stakeholders.

Who are you?

You have several years of experience working within IAM and are comfortable operating both strategically and close to the business. You have a strong understanding of how IAM connects security, business requirements, governance, and technology.

We believe you thrive in a role where you can combine advisory work, leadership, and business development. You are experienced in building trust, leading discussions with decision-makers, and helping organizations advance their IAM maturity journey.

Strategic work within Identity and Access Management

Access Management and Privileged Access Management (PAM)

    

Defining target operating models, roadmaps, and governance processes within IAM

Business development, service offering development, or leadership roles within cybersecurity

Relevant certifications in IAM or cybersecurity are considered an advantage.

We value individuals who enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and who actively contribute to knowledge sharing to help us find better solutions for our customers.

Why Join Us?

    

Work alongside some of the industry's most dedicated experts and market-leading technologies.

    

Flexible working environment with opportunities to influence how we work going forward.

    

A Challenger culture that encourages curiosity, innovation, and knowledge sharing.

    

The opportunity to play a central role in the development of our IAM offering.

    

The privilege of helping strengthen the security of major international companies and organizations.

Orange Cyberdefense is Sweden’s leading cybersecurity company. Our vision is to contribute to a secure digital society. Apply through this job advertisement. Recruitment is conducted on an ongoing basis. If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact the responsible recruiter.

title: Cyber Security Analyst
description:
Company description:

Volvo Cars

Job description:   Let's introduce ourselves  

At Volvo Cars, we are on a mission to provide freedom to move in a personal, sustainable, and safe way. As vehicles become increasingly connected and software-defined, cybersecurity is a critical enabler of safety, trust, regulatory compliance, and customer confidence.







We are now looking for a Senior CSMS Engineer to strengthen cybersecurity governance and engineering coordination within ConX / Head Unit Platform. The Head Unit Platform organization provides and maintains the core infotainment platform that powers the in-car experience. It is responsible for platform engineering, software releases, ECU/head unit ownership, and functional safety, ensuring a stable and scalable foundation for all customer-facing applications and vehicle functions.  In this role, you will help ensure that cybersecurity activities are planned, executed, reviewed, traced, and evidenced in line with the Cybersecurity Management System (CSMS), UNECE R155, and ISO/SAE 21434 expectations.







You will work closely with Product Owners, Engineering Managers, software developers, system architects, verification teams, suppliers, Shield / central CSMS stakeholders, CSAP / Quality, and PSIRT to make ConX cybersecurity work products audit-ready and delivery-focused.

     What you'll do  


    Drive CSMS execution and coordination for ConX / Head Unit Platform cybersecurity activities across planning, development, verification, release, and post-development support




    Coordinate creation, review readiness, and lifecycle maintenance of cybersecurity work products such as CSPD, TARA, Cybersecurity Concept, cybersecurity requirements, verification specifications, SWTR, CSPV, CS Case / CAC, CS-SOW, and CSJR evidence




    Ensure traceability from cybersecurity requirements to verification activities, validation evidence, Software Test Reports (SWTR), and cybersecurity case evidence




    Support TARA activities by facilitating risk discussions, aligning security goals and risk treatment decisions, and ensuring outputs are reflected in security concepts and requirements




    Coordinate audit and homologation readiness by tracking evidence completeness, Teamcenter publication/release status, review records, and open gaps before they become certification blockers




    Act as the ConX interface towards Shield / central CSMS support on CSMS questions, templates, process alignment, compliance expectations, and evidence status




    Prepare and maintain CSMS delivery status, governance dashboards, risk summaries, and escalation material for Product Owners, Engineering Managers, ART leadership, and central cybersecurity stakeholders




    Coordinate confirmation review and assessment preparation with CSAP / Quality, ensuring verification review findings are closed and work products are ready for independent review




    Support supplier cybersecurity coordination by following up CS-SOW / CSJR expectations, supplier evidence status, and supplier-related cybersecurity risks or deviations




    Contribute to vulnerability-management and PSIRT-related coordination by ensuring ConX impact assessments, remediation evidence, and updated CSMS work products are aligned when cybersecurity issues affect infotainment scope




    Coach and guide ARTs and feature teams on CSMS expectations, cybersecurity documentation quality, evidence creation, and secure-by-design ways of working




    Continuously improve the local ConX CSMS operating model by identifying bottlenecks, ownership gaps, recurring evidence issues, and opportunities to simplify delivery while maintaining compliance

     What you'll bring  

To succeed in this role, you bring strong cybersecurity process knowledge, engineering judgement, and the ability to coordinate complex technical deliveries across multiple teams:




    University degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent experience




    7+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering, automotive software development, system engineering, compliance engineering, product governance, or related technical roles




    Solid understanding of automotive cybersecurity lifecycle activities, including cybersecurity planning, TARA, cybersecurity concepts, requirements, verification, validation, and cybersecurity cases




    Practical knowledge of CSMS expectations and regulatory frameworks such as UNECE R155 and ISO/SAE 21434




    Experience coordinating cybersecurity work products, evidence chains, review preparation, and audit or certification readiness activities




    Ability to work across organizational boundaries with Product Owners, Engineering Managers, architects, software teams, verification teams, suppliers, and central process stakeholders




    Strong communication skills with the ability to translate cybersecurity compliance needs into practical engineering actions




    Structured way of working, with confidence in tracking deliverables, risks, dependencies, deviations, and decisions




    Ability to challenge unclear ownership, identify traceability gaps, and drive resolution pragmatically without losing stakeholder alignment
    Comfortable working in agile / ART-based development environments where compliance deliverables must be integrated into product planning and release execution

title: Identitetshanteringsförvaltare, IAM
description:
Handlingskraftig och samhällsintresserad? Då tror vi att du kommer att trivas hos oss. Statistikmyndigheten SCB är landets största och främsta kunskapskälla inom statistik. Vår statistik används överallt, hemma vid köksbordet, i nyhetsrapporteringen och av beslutsfattare i riksdag och regering.

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
På SCB hanterar vi dagligen stora mängder data med snabba informationsflöden och vi försöker ständigt hitta bättre lösningar för att förenkla och framtidssäkra vår statistik. SCB:s IT-avdelning finns primärt i Örebro med cirka 100 medarbetare som ansvarar för de IT-system som möjliggör statistikproduktionen.

Vi söker en identitetshanteringsförvaltare, IAM, som får ansvar i ett team för vår Identity Management-plattform. Rollen är central i vår IT-organisation och innebär att du bygger, vidareutvecklar och förvaltar en stabil och säker identitetsplattform som används av flera plattform- och utvecklingsteam.

Du fungerar som länken mellan identitetsplattformen och de team som konsumerar tjänsterna, med fokus på säkerhet, tillgänglighet, standardisering och en effektiv användar- och utvecklarupplevelse.

Vill du arbeta inom Active Directory, Federering (ADFS/Entra ID) och PKI

    • Designa, sätta upp, vidareutveckla och förvalta vår identitetsplattform
    • Säkerställa integration mellan identitetslösningar och konsumerande team (plattformar/utveckling)
    • Ansvara för drift, övervakning, patchning och livscykelhantering av identitetsplattformen
    • Arbeta med federeringslösningar (ADFS och Microsoft Entra ID)
    • Ansvara för och utveckla vår PKI-miljö och certifikathantering
    • Stötta och vägleda plattform- och utvecklingsteam i identitets- och autentiseringsfrågor
    • Bidra till säkerhet, stabilitet och efterlevnad av interna riktlinjer
    • Delta i arkitektur och förbättringsarbete kring identitets- och åtkomsthantering

då tror vi att den här tjänsten kan vara riktigt intressant för dig!

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi vill att du har:

    • Akademisk examen med inriktning mot IT eller motsvarande utbildning/arbetslivserfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig.
    • Minst två år aktuell och gedigen praktisk erfarenhet av Active Directory i produktionsmiljö
    • Minst två år aktuell och gedigen praktisk erfarenhet av Federering och autentisering (ADFS/Entra ID)
    • Aktuell erfarenhet av PKI och certifikathantering
    • Minst två års aktuell erfarenhet av GPO administration på både server- och klientsidan
    • Minst två års aktuell kunskap inom säkerhet, autentisering och katalogtjänster
    • Aktuell erfarenhet av att arbeta i komplexa IT-miljöer och samarbeta med flera team
    • Förmåga att uttrycka dig väl på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av följande:

    • Erfarenhet av Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM)
    • Erfarenhet av Microsoft Defender for Identity
    • Arbete med SAML-baserade Identity Providers (IdP)
    • Scripting/automation (t.ex. PowerShell) inom identitetsområdet
    • Tidigare arbete i plattformsteam eller central identitetsfunktion

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har en god samarbetsförmåga och uppskattar att arbeta tillsammans med andra för att nå gemensamma mål. Du bidrar till ett positivt och konstruktivt samarbetsklimat genom att vara lyhörd, kommunikativ och hjälpsam.

Du arbetar strukturerat och har förmåga att planera, organisera och prioritera dina arbetsuppgifter på ett effektivt sätt. Samtidigt tar du ansvar för att leverera med hög kvalitet och noggrannhet, även i en tekniskt komplex miljö.

Rollen ställer krav på specialistkompetens inom området identitetshantering. Du har ett genuint intresse för teknik, håller dig uppdaterad inom ditt kompetensområde och delar gärna med dig av din kunskap till kollegor och andra team.

Vidare har du en god analytisk förmåga och trivs med att arbeta med komplexa frågeställningar. Du kan identifiera, analysera och bryta ner problem för att hitta långsiktigt hållbara lösningar som bidrar till en säker och stabil IT-miljö.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.

Den här tjänsten finns på sektionen för IT/IOS/PL i Örebro. Utifrån verksamhetens förutsättning finns det möjlighet att även arbeta viss tid hemifrån.

Anställningen är tillsvidare och inleds vanligtvis med sex månaders provanställning. Tillträdesdatum kommer vi överens om.

Den här tjänsten är säkerhetsklassad så därför kommer vi att göra en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll innan vi fattar beslut om anställning.

Hos oss är alla medarbetares kompetens och potential viktig. Vi tror på en inkluderande kultur där vi drar nytta av vår mångfald och våra olikheter. Du som söker delar våra förhållningssätt: mod att agera, tillit till varandras kompetens och goda vilja, handlingskraft att omsätta ord i arbete och var och ens ansvar att bidra till helheten.

Du ansöker genom att registrera ditt CV på svenska. Bifoga ditt examensbevis med kursförteckning. Krav på akademiska poäng som inte ingår i en examen ska verifieras genom studieintyg/registerutdrag. I din ansökan får du besvara ett antal urvalsfrågor i vårt rekryteringssystem som du kommer till när du klickar på Ansök nedan. Vid denna rekrytering kommer vi att lägga stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter, vänligen kontakta HR-partner via SCB:s växel.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Quality & Regulatory Manager
description:
The Role

Rarity Bioscience is looking for a hands-on Quality and Regulatory Manager to help transition our innovative molecular diagnostics technology from research use into clinical practice. This is a broad and operational role for someone who enjoys working close to both the science and the regulatory framework that enables products to reach patients.

As part of a small Quality & Regulatory team, the successful candidate will take ownership of day-to-day quality and regulatory activities across the product lifecycle. The role spans both Regulatory Affairs and Quality Management, with responsibilities including supporting product development projects, maintaining technical documentation, handling interactions with Notified Bodies and authorities, overseeing post-market surveillance activities and ensuring compliance with applicable regulations and standards such as EU IVDR and ISO 13485.

The position offers significant influence and visibility within the company. Working closely with Product Development, Product Management and Operations, the Quality and Regulatory Manager will act as a key business partner, helping shape regulatory strategy, support market access initiatives and ensure that quality and compliance considerations are integrated into decision-making.

The position is based at our office in Uppsala. We work on-site at least three days per week and you will be part of a small Quality & Regulatory team, reporting to the Director of Operations, Quality & Regulatory.

Duties & Responsibilities

    

Represent Quality & Regulatory in new product development and product lifecycle management projects.

    

Provide impact assessments for design, manufacturing, process and supplier changes.

    

Prepare, review and maintain regulatory technical documentation, including documentation required under EU IVDR.

    

Manage interactions with Notified Bodies and regulatory authorities, including submissions and change notifications.

    

Participate in regulatory intelligence activities and monitor global regulatory requirements applicable to our products and operations.

    

Review customer-facing materials, including data sheets, user manuals and website content, for accuracy and regulatory compliance.

    

Represent the Quality & Regulatory function during internal and external audits.

    

Contribute to market access activities supporting expansion into new markets, beginning with CE marking under EU IVDR.

    

Conduct annual product dossier reviews and maintain post-market surveillance documentation.

    

Support Quality Management System processes, including complaint handling, change control, CAPA, management review and audits.

    

Drive the continuous improvement and effectiveness of the Quality Management System, ensuring compliance with ISO 13485 and applicable regulatory requirements.

Your Profile

The ideal candidate has several years of hands-on experience within the medical device or IVD industry, a practical understanding of quality and regulatory requirements, and the ability to translate regulations into workable solutions. Success in the role requires a proactive, self-driven and collaborative mindset, as well as the confidence to operate in a fast-moving scale-up environment where priorities evolve and individuals are expected to take ownership beyond their job description.

Documented hands-on experience in medical device and/or IVD compliance management is a firm requirement for this role.

Competencies & Areas of Expertise

    

BSc degree or higher in life sciences, pharmacy, biomedical engineering, chemistry, or a related field.

    

5+ years of experience in a regulated medical device or IVD environment.

    

Documented hands-on experience in regulatory affairs and/or quality management for medical devices or IVDs.

    

Solid understanding of ISO 13485 and EU MDR/IVDR requirements.

    

Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

It would be an advantage if you also have experience with:

    

FDA regulatory requirements, including 21 CFR Part 820 and QMSR.

    

Analytical reagent development and manufacturing.

How to apply

If this sounds like the right next step for you, submit your application. If you have questions about the role or the process, don't hesitate to reach out to Sandra Bydell Sveder at SallyQ (sandra.sveder@sallyq.se, 0763199688).

About Rarity Bioscience

Our superRCA® technology delivers unmatched sensitivity for detecting low-frequency mutations — enabling deeper insights into disease biology and earlier detection of relapse. A growing portfolio of superRCA kits is already in the hands of researchers and clinicians, with more on the way.

We are about 30 people in Uppsala, working across functions without unnecessary layers. The culture is open, direct and prestige-free. Joining us means becoming part of a mission-driven team working to advance precision medicine through pioneering genetic analysis technologies, with the opportunity to make an impact on patients, healthcare and the future of molecular diagnostics.

You will be leading one or more of our developer teams, communicating with the customers and other internal stakeholders as well as setting the priorities for the team.

Responsibilities:

Customer Program Leadership

    Act as the primary program management contact for assigned OEM and Tier-1 customers, leading meetings, reviews, milestones, and issue resolution.
    Build trusted customer relationships and manage expectations while balancing internal resources and business priorities.
    Ensure clear alignment between customer requirements, commitments, and internal execution.

Program Planning & Execution

    Develop and manage program plans, schedules, deliverables, risks, budgets, and customer commitments.
    Coordinate cross-functional execution across Engineering, Product Owners, Validation, Data Management, and Customer Support.
    Proactively identify execution risks and resource conflicts, driving mitigation and timely delivery of releases, demos, and evaluations.

Risk & Issue Management

    Proactively identify, communicate, and manage program risks, dependencies, and roadblocks.
    Lead customer escalations and drive timely, solution-oriented resolution of issues.
    Facilitate decision-making and ensure closure of critical actions.

Requirements & Change Management

    Coordinate customer requirements, feature requests, and change requests together with Product and Sales.
    Assess impact on scope, schedule, and resources, ensuring commitments and changes are documented and communicated.
    Support configuration management and release planning.

Communication & Reporting

    Provide clear and concise program status updates to customers and internal leadership.
    Translate complex technical topics into business-oriented communication.
    Maintain executive-level reporting and program documentation covering status, risks, opportunities, and key decisions.

Your qualifications:

    At least Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Technical Management, or a related field.
    5+ years of automotive project/program management, including customer-facing software development programs.
    Proven experience working with OEM and Tier-1 customers and managing multiple complex projects.
    Strong understanding of automotive development processes and product lifecycle management.
    Excellent communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
    Ability to perform effectively in fast-paced customer environments and proficiency with project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, MS Project, or similar.

Interviews are held on a continuous basis, so we highly recommend that you submit your application at your earliest convenience. Welcome with your application.

Smart Eye is the global leader in Human Insight AI, technology that understands, supports and predicts human behavior in complex environments. Together with our subsidiaries Affectiva and iMotions, we are bridging the gap between humans and machines for a safe and sustainable future.

Today, our technology is embedded in next-generation vehicles, leading the way towards human-centric mobility through Driver Monitoring Systems and Interior Sensing solutions. Our Research Instruments offer unparalleled insights into automotive, aviation, assistive technology, behavioral science and many more fields.

title: Risk Manager
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will step into a key role in a regulated financial environment where risk, capital and reporting are central to business decisions. The focus is on strengthening risk management capabilities across regulatory development, capital monitoring and ICAAP, while also supporting ongoing initiatives tied to risk classification and reporting.

This is a hands-on role for you who enjoy combining analysis, governance and regulatory interpretation. You will work close to important financial risk topics such as credit risk, capital adequacy and IFRS 9 expected credit losses, and help turn complex data and regulations into practical decision support. It is a great opportunity if you want to work with high-impact risk topics in a setting where your expertise will influence both compliance and business steering.

Job Description

    You will identify, assess and monitor financial risks, with a primary focus on credit risk, capital adequacy and IFRS 9 expected credit losses.
    You will drive analysis related to portfolio performance, capital requirements and profitability, and provide data-driven insights that support portfolio steering, capital efficiency and risk-adjusted business decisions.
    You will contribute to ICAAP work and support capital monitoring activities tied to regulatory requirements and internal risk management.
    You will support ongoing projects connected to risk classification processes and reporting, helping improve structure, quality and consistency.
    You will perform quality controls to ensure that risk data is accurate, complete and consistent.
    You will help develop and strengthen data governance and analytical capabilities that support business needs, regulatory compliance and scalable risk processes.
    You will contribute to the interpretation and implementation of regulatory frameworks and guidelines, including CRR/CRD and IFRS 9.

Requirements

    Experience working as a Risk Manager or in a similar role within financial risk management.
    Strong knowledge of credit risk, capital adequacy and IFRS 9 expected credit losses.
    Experience writing ICAAP and supporting capital monitoring.
    Ability to analyse portfolio performance, capital requirements and profitability, and translate findings into decision support.
    Experience performing quality controls of risk data and working with data accuracy, completeness and consistency.
    Ability to contribute to regulatory interpretation and implementation, including CRR/CRD and IFRS 9 requirements.
    Fluency in Swedish and English, written and spoken.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Wetzikon liegt im Zürcher Oberland und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung via Bahn und Autobahn. Die dynamische Stadt bietet Ihnen ein breites Spektrum an Arbeitsplätzen in Industrie, Handel und Dienstleistungen. Die attraktive Lage zwischen Zürich und dem Appenzellland, kombiniert mit guter Infrastruktur und hoher Lebensqualität, macht Wetzikon zu einem wertvollen Arbeitsort für Pendler und Ortsansässige.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Akutspital

Sie arbeiten im Akutbereich eines Spitals: Patientinnen und Patienten kommen, genesen und gehen – der Rhythmus ist dynamisch. Dabei erleben Sie die ganze Bandbreite der Medizin, arbeiten interdisziplinär und entwickeln Ihre Fachkompetenz laufend weiter.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen in der Region Wetzikon zeigt eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage, insbesondere in Akutspitälern mit flexiblen Pensenmodellen zwischen 80 und 100 Prozent. Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

title: Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment
description:
Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen, Switzerland is part of the Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine (J\&J IM) Supply Chain organization and is currently recruiting for a  
Senior Project Manager Construction Pharma  
The Senior Project Manager serves as a senior technical leader on capital projects, ensuring alignment to J\&J standards and regulatory requirements. This role leads large capital projects, partnering with Quality, EHS, Operations, and external A\&E/CM firms.  
Key Responsibilities  
Strategic Project Leadership \& Delivery  
Lead large capital projects across all project phases (planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning).  
Coordinate multi\-functional engineering strategies to meet schedule, budget, quality, and regulatory requirements.  
Technical Authority \& Governance  
Act as the senior technical authority, review and approve engineering design changes, and technical submittals.  
Ensure engineering solutions align with J\&J standards, industry codes, and regulatory expectations.  
Budget \& Cost Management  
Lead multi‑million‑dollar capital budgets for assigned projects, monitor costs, and support procurement and contractor selection and evaluation.  
Participate in contractor bid reviews and support value\-engineering decisions.  
Scheduling, Risk \& Performance Management  
Lead schedule development and integration with program timelines; identify critical path items and drive mitigation.  
Maintain a proactive risk register, recommend mitigations, and track performance metrics.  
Construction Management \& Field Leadership  
Provide senior owner\-side engineering oversight during construction and commissioning; ensure contractor performance aligns with design intent and J\&J EHS standards.  
Promote a strong safety culture and ensure EHS compliance on site.  
Documentation \& Reporting  
Maintain detailed engineering records, design documentation, and as\-built information.  
Prepare and present executive\-level status updates, technical summaries, and risk briefings.  
Education \& Experience  
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management required; Master’s degree preferred.  
10\+ years of experience leading capital projects, preferably in regulated industries (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or similar).  
Demonstrated owner\-side engineering leadership and experience working with A\&E and Construction Management firms.  
Experience leading multi\-discipline teams and collaborating with quality, EHS, operations, and external consultants.  
Skills \& Competencies  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving skills.  
Excellent communication and leadership skills for multi\-functional and executive interactions.  
Proven track record to lead budgets, schedules, and complex contractor relationships.  
Familiarity with regulatory expectations for facilities in regulated industries.  
Proficiency with project management and engineering documentation tools.  
Additional Requirements  
Location of Role: Primary Location: Schaffhausen, Switzerland  
Language Requirements: Proficiency: English \& German  
Travel Requirements: This position will require limited travel (less than 10%) domestic and international travel jpidfb0434cjm jit0729jm jiy26jm

description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Kaiseraugst sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Entzugsstation.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Kaiseraugst: das Wichtigste in Kürze

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Entzugsstation

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Kaiseraugst liegt strategisch günstig im Kanton Aargau nahe Basel und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung mit direktem Zugang zur Autobahn sowie zu Bahnverbindungen. Die Nähe zu Basel und das Dreiländereck machen die Region für Arbeitnehmende äußerst attraktiv, da Sie von einer stabilen Wirtschaft und vielfältigen Jobmöglichkeiten profitieren. Zugleich bietet Kaiseraugst Ihnen Wohnqualität mit ländlichem Charme und guter Infrastruktur.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Entzugsstation in Kaiseraugst aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Entzugsstation

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Entzugsstation in Kaiseraugst verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für Diplompflegefachfrauen und -fachleute HF/FH in der Entzugsbehandlung rund um Kaiseraugst im Aargau ist geprägt von anhaltender hoher Nachfrage, da spezialisierte Fachkräfte in diesem anspruchsvollen Bereich knapp sind. Sie haben als qualifizierte Fachperson ausgezeichnete Chancen auf eine schnelle Anstellung in etablierten Fachkliniken und Rehabilitationszentren der Region. iPersonal erleichtert Ihnen den Einstieg erheblich, indem wir Sie gezielt mit passenden Arbeitgebern verbinden, umfassend bei der Bewerbung unterstützen und Ihre Fachkompetenz optimal positionieren.

Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

title: Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval
description:
Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen belongs to the group of Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine and manufactures high quality pharmaceutical products, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and medical devices. Today Cilag AG is one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in Switzerland supplying all the major global markets. The Schaffhausen facility is a strategic launch and growth site for parenteral products, and we have an impressive pipeline of new and innovative products.  
The Senior Supervisor, Complaint Quality Approver Team is accountable for leading a team of Complaint Quality Approvers responsible for independent, objective review and approval of complaint records. The role provides people leadership, operational oversight, and quality decision support to ensure complaint investigations are complete, scientifically justified, risk\-based, and compliant with applicable procedures and regulations. The Senior Supervisor ensures consistent approval practices, timely record progression, appropriate escalation of quality risks, and continuous capability development across the team.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
The Senior Supervisor leads the Complaint Quality Approver team and is responsible for assigning, prioritizing, and monitoring work to ensure compliant and timely approval of complaint records. The role provides guidance to approvers on investigation strategy, risk assessment, escalation, evidence requirements, Root Cause Analysis, NC considerations, and alignment of investigation conclusions across products or affiliates when applicable. The Senior Supervisor ensures that approval decisions are made consistently and are supported by objective evidence, applicable procedures, and current regulatory expectations. In addition, the role reviews complex or high\-risk complaint records, supports escalation to Quality leadership, and drives alignment with cross\-functional partners when investigation direction, closure readiness, or quality risk requires leadership input.  
The Senior Supervisor is accountable for developing team capability through coaching, feedback, training, and performance management. The role establishes clear expectations for documentation quality, approval rationale, system usage, and stakeholder communication, and ensures the team applies best practices consistently. The Senior Supervisor monitors workload, cycle time, quality metrics, backlog, and recurring investigation trends to identify improvement opportunities, remove barriers, and support sustainable business continuity. The role also contributes to process improvement initiatives, inspection readiness, audit support, and the implementation of global or site quality system changes impacting complaint record approval.  
KEY INTERFACES  
Complaint Quality Approvers to provide leadership, coaching, work prioritization, and performance feedback.  
Complaint investigation owners and cross\-functional contributors, including Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Supply Chain, Packaging, MSAT, Regulatory, and Medical Safety as applicable.  
Quality leadership for escalation, risk communication, resource planning, operational performance, and decision alignment.  
Other sites and affiliates to align investigation strategy, closure expectations, evidence requirements, and consistent complaint outcomes for site\-manufactured products.  
Audit, inspection readiness, quality systems, and process improvement stakeholders to support compliant execution and continuous improvement.  
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS  
Strong knowledge of quality investigations, complaint handling, CAPA and nonconformance concepts in a regulated pharmaceutical or medical product environment.  
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team in a quality organization, including setting priorities and managing performance.  
Strong understanding of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity expectations, and applicable U.S. and international regulatory requirements.  
Proven ability to assess complex technical data, investigation conclusions, risk assessments, and escalation needs.  
Ability to make sound quality decisions, communicate clear rationale, and ensure consistency in approval standards.  
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional, and global environment.  
Ability to drive sustainable process improvements.  
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide actionable feedback and represent the team in leadership discussions.  
Strong organization, prioritization, and decision\-making skills to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations.  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS  
Master’s degree or PhD in Life Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience, is required.

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Akutspital

**Pensum:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Opfikon

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Opfikon liegt in unmittelbarer Nähe zum Flughafen Zürich und verfügt über eine ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung durch die S-Bahn und Autobahnanschlüsse. Sie finden hier eine dynamische Wirtschaftsregion mit vielen Unternehmen aus Logistik, Dienstleistung und Industrie. Die zentrale Lage zwischen Zürich und Glatttal macht Opfikon zu einem attraktiven Arbeitsort mit guter Erreichbarkeit für Pendler aus der ganzen Region.

### Ihr Aufgabengebiet als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Opfikon

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Das setzen wir für diese Stelle voraus

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

Sie arbeiten im Akutbereich eines Spitals: Patientinnen und Patienten kommen, genesen und gehen – der Rhythmus ist dynamisch. Dabei erleben Sie die ganze Bandbreite der Medizin, arbeiten interdisziplinär und entwickeln Ihre Fachkompetenz laufend weiter.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Opfikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
In der Region Opfikon im Kanton Zürich besteht eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage nach qualifizierten Pflegefachpersonen für Akutspitäler, da der Fachkräftemangel in diesem Bereich weiterhin akut ist. Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau oder -mann HF/FH haben ausgezeichnete Chancen auf attraktive Positionen mit flexiblen Pensumsmodellen, die sich Ihren persönlichen Anforderungen anpassen lassen. iPersonal erleichtert Ihnen den Einstieg durch gezielte Vermittlung in renommierte Spitäler der Region und kompetente Unterstützung bei der Stellensuche.

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Opfikon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

title: Un-e Assistant-e social-e  en CDI
description:
Un\-e Assistant\-e social\-e (100%) en CDI  
Un\-e Assistant\-e social\-e (100%) en CDI \- EVAM  
Un\-e Assistant\-e social\-e (100%) en CDI  
Rejoignez l'EVAM et donnez du sens à votre expertise !  
Et si votre prochain défi professionnel avait un réel impact social ?  
À l'EVAM, chaque collaborateur\-trice contribue à une mission essentielle : accompagner des personnes en situation de migration avec ouverture et responsabilité.  
Dans le cadre d'un remplacement, nous recrutons :  
Un\-e Assistant\-e social\-e en antenne en CDI à 100%  
Lieu : Lausanne  
Entrée en fonction : A convenir  
Le mot de votre futur responsable, Cécile :  
« Notre structure accompagne depuis plusieurs années les personnes migrantes dans leur parcours d'intégration, avec humanité, professionnalisme et engagement.  
Chaque journée est différente : accompagnement social et administratif, accès aux droits, coordination avec nos partenaires\- un travail riche et porteur de sens.  
Vous rejoindrez une équipe pluridisciplinaire et solidaire, où entraide et partage d'expérience sont essentiels.  
Nous cherchons une personne motivée, prête à s'engager pour la et le respect de la dignité humaine.  
Au plaisir de faire votre connaissance ».  
Vos missions clés  
Vous êtes en charge du suivi administratif et entretiens sociaux.  
Vous mettez en place un plan d'action personnalisés.  
Vous soutenez les bénéficiaires dans l'intégration sociale, professionnelle et administrative.  
Vous coordonnez avec les partenaires internes et externes.  
Vous veillez à apporter une expertise et des conseils au guichet social cantonal pour garantir un accompagnement de qualité  
Votre profil  
Vous avez bachelor HES en travail social (reconnaissance SEFRI si diplôme étranger).  
Minimum. 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction similaire.  
Vous avez une bonne connaissance du réseau vaudois et des assurances sociales.  
Vous avez un Français excellent (oral et écrit) ; la maîtrise de l'anglais ou d'autres langues est un atout  
Vous avez un Intérêt marqué pour le domaine de la migration.  
Ce que l'EVAM vous propose  
Un environnement de travail engagé  
5 semaines de vacances (6 dès 50 ans)  
De très bonnes prestations sociales  
Des projets porteurs de sens dans un contexte interculturel stimulant  
Le processus de recrutement en 3 étapes :  
1\. Un entretien avec le responsable d'antenne et la chargée de recrutement.  
2\. Une mise en situation  
3\. Une demi\-journée d'immersion pour découvrir concrètement votre futur environnement de travail.  
À l'issue du processus : demande d'un extrait du casier judiciaire (documents vierges requis).  
Vous vous reconnaissez dans cette mission ?

AI & Security Innovation

- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- MS-102 – Microsoft 365 Administrator

Key stakeholders will be the EEMEA Leadership Team (LT), HHI Commercial Operations, regional Chief Marketing Officers (CMO) & Regional Commercial Leads (RCL), and market Commercial Operations Directors (CODs.)
This is a Band 400 individual-contributor role. The primary location is Switzerland, with secondary locations in the Europe or Middle East time zones may be considered upon further discussion with the hiring manager. The role includes approximately 25% travel within Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa.
Responsibilities:
Commercial Capabilities:  Drive customer engagement evolution in partnership with Digital Engagement teams, ensuring commercial capabilities, segmentation, omnichannel execution and customer insights are translated into improved customer experience and business outcomes.
Relevant focus areas include:
•    Sales Force Effectiveness: Ensure proper Sales Incentive Plan (SIP), target setting, CRM operations and upgrades, and Sales Force of the Future (SFOF) deployment in select markets.  Ensure an ongoing focus on segmentation and targeting and Multichannel Cycle Plans (MCCP) efforts in the region.  Leverage data, analytics and business insights to improve sales force effectiveness in the region.
•    Key Account Management:  Ensure the roll out of Key Account Management and Top Customer programs in the region. Ensure successful capability roll-out and work with Market Access and Franchises to increase access at account level.
•    Commercial Trade Channels: Align with HHI on new capability roll-out and support markets in uncovering Commercial Trade Channel (CTC) opportunities.
Operational Governance & Execution:  Work with all relevant stakeholders to secure the EEMEA Commercial Operations & Strategy (CO&S) vision and business strategies and proactively identify and execute projects and programs of strategic importance to the region and our customers in a timely, effective, and efficient fashion. Be the communicator / connector / catalyst for cross-functional projects managed by extended regional stakeholders. Relevant focus areas include:
•    CO&S Governance: Manage all governance activities for the CO&S department, including setting the agenda for virtual and face-to-face meetings and periodic forum calls with market leads and other relevant stakeholders.
•    Business Impact Measurement: Establish measurement frameworks to evaluate the impact of commercial capability investments, ensuring visibility to adoption, effectiveness, customer outcomes and business value realization.
•    Continuous Improvement: Continue to identify opportunities to drive simplification and harmonization across the region in collaboration with CO&S stakeholders including Digital Human Health (DHH). Support markets and the region in Objective & Key Result (OKR) transformation projects where requested.  Bring external industry best practices and innovative approaches into the region to continuously elevate commercial excellence.
•    Marketing Capabilities: Partner with regional Learning & Development (L&D), CMOs, and RCLs to build and scale marketing capabilities with a focus on L3 next deployment and sustainment.
•    Regional Projects: Ensure the successful deployment of projects associated with regional initiatives, priorities, and experimentations.
Launch Excellence:  Lead commercial-capability readiness that carries our emerging pipeline to flawless launch execution across markets. Relevant focus areas include:
•    Launch Capability Readiness: Partner with RCLs and market teams to ensure markets have the appropriate Go to Market (G2M) planning, segmentation, targeting, field-force sizing, training, forecasting support, and launch playbooks are in place well ahead of launch.
•    Launch Framework & Tracking: Establish a repeatable EEMEA launch-excellence framework and toolkit, with launch tracking that gives leadership visibility to timelines, milestones and risks.
AI-Enabled Commercial Excellence:  Champion the responsible adoption of GenAI across commercial workflows — helping teams work faster and smarter while safeguarding compliance and quality — and explore opportunities to embed AI into sales, marketing, field-force and launch ways of working, in partnership with key stakeholders.
Talent Development:  Build & support commercial-operations talent and capability development across the region.
We are looking for a commercially minded leader with 10+ years across sales, marketing, commercial operations and launch readiness who has successfully deployed commercial excellence capabilities in a complex, multinational environment. Combines strategic thinking with execution discipline, excels at influencing without authority, and has a strong track record of leading change, building capabilities, and translating data and technology into measurable business outcomes.

title: Natural Hazards Mission Lead
description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. The Natural Hazards Mission focuses initially on mass movements, including landslides and rockfalls, with the aim of improving early detection, monitoring, preparedness and decision support for Swiss practitioners, authorities and infrastructure stakeholders. It builds on stakeholder engagement, solution scoping and community-building activities already underway within GeoLab, including contributions from senior domain experts and partners in the Swiss natural hazards community.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, natural hazard organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Natural Hazards Mission Lead, you will lead the research and development portfolio, integration and delivery of GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Mission. Initially focused on landslides and rockfalls, and later expanding to other natural hazards, you will help define the mission vision, translate user needs into research and product requirements, and ensure that GeoLab activities create measurable value for Swiss practice and public decision-making. You will build on ongoing interchange with key stakeholders and solution-scoping activities already underway within GeoLab, and work closely with senior domain-relevant partners, technical teams and experts.

You will report to the Managing Director of ETH Swiss GeoLab and work closely with GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Community & Solutions Lead, other GeoLab mission teams, the Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team and external partners. You will define priorities, milestones and decision points, lead mission delivery and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within your research and development portfolio, the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent research and development portfolio for the Natural Hazards Mission, initially centred on landslides and rockfalls
Translate identified critical operational gaps into measurable outcomes that create value for practitioners, authorities and decision-makers
Engage with local, cantonal and federal authorities, infrastructure operators, practitioners, industry and expert communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Translate operational challenges into research, data, product and technical requirements
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss natural hazard needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones, decision points and success criteria and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with the Geo-Lab’s Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and Earth  observation foundational models - and external performers to drive pilots, field validation, operational testing and integration into user workflows
Assess evidence and performance, and recommend continuation, redirection, scaling, pausing or termination of activities
Identify and mobilise strong ETH groups, research institutions, engineering and geology offices, remote-sensing companies, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab in Swiss natural hazard, scientific, policy and industry communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned to internal and external stakeholders
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support the transfer of resulting capabilities into operational practice
In summary, you understand the needs of practitioners and decision-makers in the field of natural hazards and their relation to Earth observations from space and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research and technology into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in natural hazards, geosciences, engineering, risk management or related fields
Several years of experience in natural hazard practice, applied research, public administration, consulting, engineering or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland
Strong expertise and understanding of natural hazards with demonstrated examples of dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Proven ability to identify important operational problems and translate them into actionable initiatives
With a track-record of successful collaborations in diverse teams and have demonstrated your excitement to not only do research but apply that research to the benefit of others.
Experience in mission, programme or applied R&D portfolio design
Strong project, portfolio and budget management skills with demonstrated examples of transparent reporting, dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse public authorities, academia, industry and expert communities
The ability to work across disciplinary and organisational boundaries and to lead through influence
Strong judgement skills under uncertainty and the willingness to challenge established approaches constructively
Excellent communication and listening skills, and great presentation skills in various modalities
Excellent written and spoken English and German; French is an asset
You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organisation. You have a track-record of successful team participation and leadership and an excitement for hard and impactful work. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, operational relevance and measurable value. In doing so, you want to work on the best idea, not necessarily your best idea.

A rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national initiative for Earth observation
A mission-driven role with high visibility and strong societal relevance
The opportunity to develop solutions for pressing natural hazard challenges in Switzerland, and with broad international impact through transferable methods and lessons learned
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Natural Hazards Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

We look forward to receiving your application!
